articleTitle: Generation and performance investigation of polarization-alternated QPSK format
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A novel binary bit encoder is proposed to generate polarization-alternated (PolAl) QPSK signals, which is experimentally demonstrated having the similar receiver sensitivity and transmission performance as polarization-multiplexed BPSK format.

articleTitle: High-Q single-bandpass photonic RF filter overcoming optical third-order dispersion based on programmable spectrum shaping of a broadband optical source
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate a novel reconfigurable photonic RF filter which can achieve theoretically infinite Q factors. Single sinc-shape passband with Q = 634 and flat-top passband with Q = 76 are demonstrated experimentally when the passband center is tuned at 18 GHz .

articleTitle: Analysis of 32GBaud DP-QPSK transmission over mixed dispersion managed/unmanaged transparent domains
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We consider optical transparent networks where ROADMs enable wavelength routing through dispersion-managed and unmanaged domains of G.652 fiber. The WDM performance of 32 GBaud DP-QPSK signals and the evolution of nonlinear noise are evaluated.

articleTitle: Efficient dynamic wideband model for reflective semiconductor optical amplifier
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A computationally efficient, time-domain model for simulation of spatial-temporal distribution of photons and carriers in a bulk RSOA is presented. Saturation, noise, chirp and signal broadening are successfully predicted for NRZ and QPSK signals.

articleTitle: Amplitude regeneration of 80-Gb/s polarization-multiplexed RZ-DPSK signals in a dual-orthogonal-pump fiber optical parametric amplifier
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Amplitude regeneration of 80-Gb/s polarization-multiplexed RZ-DPSK signals has been demonstrated in an orthogonally pumped fiber optical parametric amplifier. The receiver sensitivities of the two polarization branches are improved by 3.5 and 3.3 dB.

articleTitle: Ultra low power VCSEL for 35-Gbps 500-m OM4 MMF transmissions employing FFE/DFE equalization for optical interconnects
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: By use of optimized design 850-nm VCSELs under OOK modulation and FFE/DFE equalization, high bit-rate distance product (35-Gbps 500-m and 25-Gbps 1000-m) through OM4 MMF transmissions with ultra-low power consumption are successfully achieved.

articleTitle: A fast convergence frequency domain least mean square algorithm for compensation of differential mode group delay in few mode fibers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We investigated the convergence speed of a modified frequency-domain least-mean-square algorithm in few-mode fiber transmission systems. This algorithm improves the convergence speed by about 30% with negligible increase in implementation complexity.

articleTitle: Dynamic packet offload tuning in packet-optical network scenarios
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: In packet-opto scenarios, packet offload towards the optical layer enables transit traffic to avoid packet processing in intermediate nodes saving costs and power. A strategy to dynamically tune the offload level is presented and simulated.

articleTitle: Study of wireless channel characteristics of 2×2 60-GHz MIMO OFDM RoF system employing lattice reduction-aided detection
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We experimentally investigate the wireless channel characteristics of 2×2 60-GHz MIMO OFDM RoF system with 3.5-m wireless distance. With lattice-reduction-aided detection, the achievable data rate can be improved from 0.58Gbps to 12.61Gbps for the worst case.

articleTitle: Record low loss, record high FOM optical fiber with manufacturable process
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Record-low loss of 0.149dB/km at 1550nm is realized by pure-silica-core fiber having optimally enlarged Aeff, which indicates record-high figure-of-merit for digital coherent system. Mass-productivity is verified with 7,000km long fabrication whose averaged loss of 0.154dB/km.

articleTitle: III–V quantum-dot laser growth on silicon and germanium
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We present the studies of the development of room-temperature continuous-wave lasers near 1.3 μm on both silicon and germanium substrates with very low threshold current densities for silicon photonics.

articleTitle: Digital homodyne OTDR with dual polarization optical hybrid for PMD distribution measurement
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Digital homodyne OTDR with dual polarization optical hybrid using M-sequence correlation was demonstrated for PMD distribution measurement without averaging. The relative phase fluctuation of Rayleigh backscattered field were successfully compensated, for the first time.

articleTitle: Direct measurement of broadband FWM induced noise in dispersion uncompensated systems
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We experimentally measured nonlinear noise induced by broadband FWM over different power levels, system lengths, and transmission bandwidths in dispersion uncompensated systems. We confirmed that broadband FWM induced noise is proportional to PSD<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, L<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>, and Log(BW).

articleTitle: Silicon photonic integrated circuits for WDM technology and optical switch
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We describe components we developed in addressing several challenges in silicon photonics, including fiber coupling, demultiplexing, and polarization diversity. We then summarize several circuit examples for WDM transmitter / receiver and optical switch.

articleTitle: Compact ROSA for 100-Gb/s (4 × 25 Gb/s) Ethernet with a PLC-based AWG demultiplexer
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We report a compact receiver optical sub-assembly (ROSA) for 100GbE CFP4 transceivers. All the four channels of fabricated module exhibits wide wavelength passband and high receiver sensitivity enough for 10-km-reach transmission.

articleTitle: First demonstration of hitless wavelength selective switch based on quadruple series coupled multiple quantum well microring resonator
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A hitless wavelength-selective switch using InGaAs multiple quantum well quadruple series-coupled microring resonators is first demonstrated for high-speed and low-voltage operation. The influence of change in coupling efficiency at coupling regions is also discussed.

articleTitle: An ultra-wideband 360° photonic-assisted microwave phase shifter
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: An ultra-wideband microwave photonic phase shifter implemented by a joint use of a polarization modulator and a polarization-maintaining fiber Bragg grating that can provide a full 360° tunable range over 30-40 GHz is demonstrated.

articleTitle: [Tutorial]: NG-PON2 technologies
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Presents a collection of slides covering the following topics: NG-PON2 technology; optical access network; EPON; and TDMA-PON systems.

articleTitle: Quantum dot comb laser with the integrated DBR section for DWDM optical interconnects
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: DBR stabilized InAs/GaAs quantum dot comb laser diode is demonstrated. It generates 4+ low-noise comb lines within the temperature range 25-65°C. The DBR section improves comb spectrum stability in the changing operating conditions.

articleTitle: Practical issues of the tunable dispersion compensation using parametric wavelength conversion
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We report the developments of parametric tunable dispersion compensators based on FWM process in a highly nonlinear fiber for real network uses. Input-polarization insensitivity, input-wavelength transparency, and seamless dispersion tuning are successfully demonstrated.

articleTitle: Coherent 40 Gb/s SP-16QAM and 80 Gb/s PDM-16QAM in an optimal supercomputer optical switch fabric
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate, for the first time, the feasibility of using 40 Gb/s SP-16QAM and 80 Gb/s PDM-16QAM in an optimized cell switching supercomputer optical interconnect architecture based on semiconductor optical amplifiers as ON/OFF gates.

articleTitle: Demonstration of 2.1 photon-per-bit sensitivity for BPSK at 9.94-Gb/s with rate-½ FEC
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Combining optical-phase-locked loop based coherent detection, interleaving, and powerful rate-½ FEC enabled the error-free transmission of BPSK waveforms at information rates of 9.94-Gb/s and 19.88-Gb/s with sensitivities of 2.1 photons-per-bit and 3.9 photons-per-bit, respectively.

articleTitle: An almost-optimal approach for minimizing the number of required wavelengths for large-scale optical networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose a generic multi-iteration-based lightpath routing and wavelength assignment (RWA) approach, which is efficient to achieve an almost-optimal solution for large-scale networks (with up to one hundred links) under various types of static lightpath demands.

articleTitle: Demonstration of ultra-high bit rate fiber wireless transmission system of 108-Gb/s data over 80-km fiber and 2×2 MIMO wireless links at 100GHz W-band frequency
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated the seamless integration of 108-Gb/s 80-km SMF-28 transmission and 1-m 100-GHz wireless delivery over a 2×2 MIMO wireless link adopting PDMQPSK modulation, with BER less than pre-FEC limit of 3.8×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>.

articleTitle: High speed waveguide-integrated Ge/Si avalanche photodetector
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We report waveguide Ge/Si avalanche photodiodes with a high 3-dB bandwidth of ~20 GHz and a high responsivity of 22 A/W. Such device can be monolithically integrated with other silicon photonic components on SOI substrates.

articleTitle: Rayleigh backscattering signatures of optical fibers—Their properties and applications
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: The properties of optical fiber Rayleigh scatter are reviewed from the perspective of high resolution, high sensitivity OFDR measurements. The statistical properties of single mode fiber are reviewed as well as Rayleigh scatter properties of PM fiber and erbium-doped fiber-optic amplifiers.

articleTitle: 28-Gb/s directly modulated InGaAlAs ACPM DFB lasers with high mask margin of 22% at 55°C
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A 1.3-μm directly modulated InGaAlAs-MQW DFB laser, incorporating an asymmetric corrugation-pitch-modulated (ACPM) grating, operating at 28 Gb/s at 55°C experimentally demonstrated high mask margin of 22% for the first time.

articleTitle: Generation of 64-QAM signals using a single dual-drive IQ modulator driven by 4-level and binary electrical signals
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A simple square 64-QAM generation technique using a commercially available dual-drive IQ modulator driven by 4-level and binary electrical signals is proposed. Polarization multiplexed (PM) 64-QAM signals at 20Gbaud/s are experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Ultra-small silicon polarization beam splitter based on cascaded asymmetry directional couplers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A polarization beam splitter with cascaded asymmetrical directional couplers is demonstrated experimentally on a silicon-on-insulator (SOI) platform. The measured extinction ratios of the fabricated PBS are about 11dB and 13dB for TE/TM polarizations.

articleTitle: Blind adaptive equalization algorithm based on constellation transformation for DP 16-QAM systems
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate a novel blind equalizer based on a constellation transformation, where a 16-QAM signal is mapped into a QPSK constellation. Subsequently, the filter coefficients for an adaptive equalizer are updated using a constant modulus or decision-directed cost function.

articleTitle: A novel application of SFP+ 10GBASE-LRM transceiver for a low cost short reach single mode fiber link
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: In this paper we propose a novel low-cost interface to address 10 Gb/s 2 km links over SMF using commercially available 10GBASE-LRM transceivers without any additional redesign nor full-blown EDC on the receiver side.

articleTitle: PAPR reduction and computational complexity analysis of interleaved segmentation in 60GHz OFDM-RoF system
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate that interleaved segmentation technique provides a trade-off between PAPR and computational complexity in 60GHz RoF system with 5Gb/s 16QAM-OFDM downlink. Moreover, the receiver sensitivity is effectively enhanced using this method.

articleTitle: Flexible transceivers using adaptive digital signal processing for single carrier and OFDM
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Advanced DSP algorithms for channel estimation and equalization, carrier phase recovery and nonlinearity mitigation for flexible transceivers are discussed for both single carrier and OFDM systems.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of a symmetric 40-Gb/s TWDM-PON
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate a symmetric 40-Gb/s TWDM-PON system using a single tunable optical filter for both downstream wavelength selection and chirp management of upstream directly modulated laser, which supports 25-km feeder fiber and 1∶256 splitting ratio.

articleTitle: Experimental validation of a multi-layer multi-domain hierarchical PCE architecture for OBS-WSON networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: OBS-based metro-regional networks can be interconnected through WSON networks to offer inter-data center connectivity. This paper validates, in a multi-partner testbed, the application of the H-PCE architecture for path computation in such Multi-layer, Multi-domain networks.

articleTitle: Influence of channel correlation on the scintillation performance of receiver diversity systems for free-space optical communications
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We derive a generalized model for channel correlation in aperture receiver diversity systems and discuss its effect on the scintillation of a dual-receiver system. An approximation for the correlation length under strong turbulence is obtained.

articleTitle: Small-form-factor all-InP integrated laser vector modulator enables the generation and transmission of 256-Gb/s PDM-16QAM Modulation Format
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate, using a compact InP-based integrated assembly of a tunable laser and a double-nested Mach-Zehnder modulator, generation of Nyquist-prefiltered QPSK and 16-QAM signals at 32-Gbaud. We transmitted them over 8000-km and 960-km SSMF, respectively.

articleTitle: A seven-core photonic crystal fiber with high beam quality
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A new type of seven-core photonic crystal fiber was designed and fabricated for high power supercontinuum generation. Such design has the merits of high efficient coupling, and especially high beam quality.

articleTitle: Low-loss fused mode coupler for few-mode transmission
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Spatial-mode couplers (SMC) are critical devices in mode-division-multiplexed systems. We report a fused SMC with a low loss of 1.1~2 dB and high mode-extinction ratio of ≥20dB for a broad wavelength range of 1539-1555 nm.

articleTitle: Temporal focusing of ultrabroadband wireless signals using photonic radio frequency arbitrary waveform generation
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We report the first experimental demonstration of temporal compression of ultra-broadband wireless signals distorted by highly scattering multipath channels over the frequency range of 2 to 18 GHz using photonic radio-frequency arbitrary waveform generation.

articleTitle: Cost-effective, asynchronous 4 × 40Gbps full-duplex OCDMA demonstrator using apodized SSFBGs and a multi-port encoder/decoder
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Cost-effective, asynchronous 4 × 40Gbps full-duplex DPSK-OCDMA PON using 8-level phase-shifted, 320 Gchip/s apodized SSFBG en/decoders at each ONU and a single multi-port en/decoder at OLT is experimentally demonstrated for the first time.

articleTitle: Dynamic multi-path routing in a monolithic active-passive 16×16 optoelectronic switch
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: An active-passive integrated 16×16 SOA-based switch is demonstrated with a control interface for reconfigurable routing and power equalization between multiple connections. 10Gb/s data is routed with 28.3 dB/0.1 nm OSNR and <;10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup> bit error rate.

articleTitle: Feasibility demonstration of flexible Tx/Rx for spectrum defragmentation in elastic optical networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate the feasibility of spectrum defragmentation in a flexible-grid optical network utilizing the flexible transmitter and receiver. According to the defragmentation controller, the flexible transmitter dynamically switches the modulation format/symbol rate/wavelength without hardware modification.

articleTitle: An introduction to routing and wavelength assignment algorithms for fixed and flexgrid
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: ◂General methods to solve optimization problems in networks ◂WDM networks ◂Goal of planning: satisfy traffic and optimize resource usage ◂Physical layer impairments (cross-layer optimization) ◂Network evolution: establish new connections and re-optimize ◂Flexgrid networks ◂Added complexity due to more flexibility degrees Interdependence among reach-rate-spectrum-guardband parameters Traffic variation can be accommodated at different levels ◂Develop novel formulations ◂Network Planning and Operation Tools - Mantis

articleTitle: Subwavelength structures in integrated optics
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Subwavelenth structures offer exciting new opportunities for integrated optics. Effective refractive index can be chosen from a broad range by lithographic patterning using just two materials. Many practical subwavelength engineered devices already demonstrated, with superior performance compared to their conventional counterparts and likely many more to come.

articleTitle: [OFC 2013 Tutorial OW3G.4] Burst-mode Receiver Technology for Short Synchronization
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Review of OLT BM-RX requirements / design guidelines are given here. Optical power budget and network coexistance with deployed PONs. Relaxed timing parameters but still shorter burst overhead for robust design and high yield manufacture. Trade-off between cost effectiveness (die size, packaging, power consumption) and good enough performance. No external time-critical control signals cross PHY & MAC layer for better system interoperability. Overview of IEEE & ITU-T fast synchronization BM-RX development is also given. AC-coupled & DC-coupled BM-RX configurations. Various 2R / 3R BM-RX architectures. Dual-rate and multi-rate operation. (Sub)-system integration and demonstration is also shown. Technology for IEEE 10G-EPON BM-Rx is ready for production, need low cost-engineering work and volume (10G-PON optics synergy with ITU-T NG-PON2 TDMA-BM-RXs). 10G/5G/2.5Gb/s upstream burst-mode transmission demonstrated with excellent performance (elimination of external reset, fast synchronization with fully programmable short overhead, and low power consumption).

articleTitle: A spatially-coupled type LDPC Code with an NCG of 12 dB for optical transmission beyond 100 Gb/s
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose a novel SD-FEC employing the concatenation of a spatially-coupled type irregular LDPC code with a BCH code. Numerical simulations show an NCG of 12.0 dB at a BER of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-15</sup> with 25.5% redundancy.

articleTitle: The LOGON strategy for low-complexity control plane implementation in new-generation flexible networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Recently proposed non-linear propagation models allow to derive simple link optimization rules. We show that local optimization leads to global optimization (LOGO) and propose a network optimization strategy (LOGON) that allows substantial control-plane simplification.

articleTitle: Characterization of space-division multiplexing systems using a swept-wavelength interferometer
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We present single-scan measurements of the transfer matrix of space-division multiplexed systems including the mode-multiplexers and fibers. We obtain the mode-dependent loss, and differential group delay over 110-nm of bandwidth of a 4.7-km 3-mode fiber.

articleTitle: 35-Gb/s VCSEL-Based optical link using 32-nm SOI CMOS circuits
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A VCSEL-based multimode fiber optical link using 32nm SOI CMOS circuits is demonstrated. Record optical link power efficiencies of 1pJ/bit at 25Gb/s and 2.7pJ/bit at 35Gb/s are achieved.

articleTitle: Can we use flexible transponders to reduce margins?
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: The introduction of bit rate variable transceivers is expected to improve network reconfiguration and optimization. The different network margins are discussed along with the related strategies to reduce them.

articleTitle: Fragmentation-aware routing, modulation and spectrum assignment algorithms in elastic optical networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We investigate the principle of how dynamic service provisioning fragments the spectral resources on links along a path, and propose corresponding RMSA algorithms to alleviate spectrum fragmentation in dynamic network environments.

articleTitle: Fault-tolerant virtual network mapping to provide Content Connectivity in optical networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We define Content Connectivity as the reachability of every content from any point of an optical network. We propose a scheme for virtual network mapping and content placement to ensure content connectivity after failures.

articleTitle: Flexible optical comb source for super channel systems
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate a simple method of flexible optical frequency comb generation by gain switching an externally injected DFB laser. The FSR tunability from 25-33GHz renders this transmitter as a potential source for >100Gb/s optical networks.

articleTitle: 112Gb/s DP-QPSK transmission Over 2427km SSMF using small-size silicon photonic IQ modulator and low-power CMOS driver
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We report 2427km, 112Gb/s DP-QPSK optical transmission using the smallest Silicon Photonic modulator and lowest power CMOS MZM driver. BER characterization of this device demonstrates comparable performance relative to a commercial LiNbO3 modulator.

articleTitle: Low DMD four LP mode transmission fiber for wide-band WDM-MIMO system
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A low DMD trench assisted GI-fiber supporting LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</sub>, LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub>, LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">21</sub> and LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">02</sub> mode propagation is proposed. The maximum DMD of a fabricated 10.5 km-long fiber is |50| ps/km within the C+L band for four-mode operation.

articleTitle: Advances in high-speed ADCs, DACs, and DSP for optical transceivers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We discussed DAC, ADC, and DSP in the context of coherent transceivers We reviewed DAC and ADC technology. We discussed ENOB as a figure of merit. We discussed DAC/ADC performance implications. We showed how the technology can be extended if needed We discussed DSP functions: Equalization; Pulse shaping to increase spectral efficiency and the impact of jitter; Frequency offset compensation, carrier recovery, polarization recovery We explained cycle slips and some possible remedies We showed examples of commercial DACs/ADCs as well as DAC/ADC + DSP monolithic ASICs We looked at forward error correction and how it can affect reach Finally, we put all the above in the context of flexible transceivers to meet increased networks capacity.

articleTitle: Reduction of influence of inter-core cross-talk in MCF with bidirectional assignment between neighboring cores
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We evaluated the effects of bidirectional signal assignment between neighboring cores in MCF for the reduction of inter-core cross-talk with 98-km MCF. We clarify its advantage and several specific limiting factors.

articleTitle: 477 Mbit/s visible light transmission based on OOK-NRZ modulation using a single commercially available visible LED and a practical LED driver with a pre-emphasis circuit
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We have first confirmed the maximum bit rate of 477 Mbit/s OOK-NRZ-based transmission using a single commercially available visible LED and a low-cost PIN-PD by adopting a practical LED driver with a simple pre-emphasis circuit.

articleTitle: A 56.1Gb/s NRZ modulated 850nm VCSEL-based optical link
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We report a directly modulated 850nm VCSEL-based optical link operating at 56.1Gb/s (BER < 1E-12). This is the highest modulation rate for a VCSEL-based link of any wavelength. An open eye is obtained at 60Gb/s.

articleTitle: A high end routing platform for core and edge applications based on chip to chip optical interconnect
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A telecom router utilizing a parallel optical interconnect is described with the highest reported aggregate bandwidth 1.34Tb/s, and density 64Gb/s/mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. The device is based on direct assembly of large optoelectronic III-V chips on CMOS.

articleTitle: Software defined optical networks technology and infrastructure: Enabling software-defined optical network operations
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A control plane architecture based on OpenFlow for optical SDN is introduced. Requirements for its implementation are discussed considering emerging optical transport technologies. Two implementations of the architecture and results on their performance are reported.

articleTitle: Demonstration of EDFA cognitive gain control via GMPLS for mixed modulation formats in heterogeneous optical networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate cognitive gain control for EDFA operation in real-time GMPLS controlled heterogeneous optical testbed with 10G/100G/200G/400G lightpaths. Cognitive control maintains the network BER below FEC-limit for up to 6 dB of induced attenuation penalty.

articleTitle: 60 Gbit/s silicon modulators with enhanced electro-optical efficiency
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We present 60 Gbit/s silicon MZI and microring modulators with the PN junctions and electrodes designed for improved modulation efficiency and high speed. WDM modulations of 4×50 Gbit/s have also been demonstrated based on microring modulators.

articleTitle: Narrow linewidth high power thermally tuned sampled-grating distributed Bragg reflector laser
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate a thermally tuned SGDBR laser with high thermal tuning efficiency; 300kHz spectral linewidth, +16dBm fiber-coupled output power, 40dB SMSR, and millisecond timescale tuning are achieved over a 40nm wavelength range across the C-band.

articleTitle: Investigation of crosstalk dependencies on bending radius of heterogeneous multicore fiber
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Crosstalk characteristic of heterogeneous MCF with homogeneous A<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">eff</sub> is investigated. It is experimentally confirmed that radius around which the crosstalk peaks (R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">pk</sub>) of smaller than 50 mm is realizable by Δn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">eff</sub> of larger than 0.0010.

articleTitle: Spectral defragmentation in elastic optical path networks using independent sets
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Spectral fragmentation in elastic optical networks decreases the spectral efficiency and increases the request blocking. We propose a novel auxiliary graph model and spectral defragmentation technique using independent sets to efficiently consolidate the spectrum allocation.

articleTitle: Experimental transmission of Nyquist pulse shaped 4-D coded modulation using dual polarization 16QAM set-partitioning schemes at 28 Gbaud
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We report the experimental transmission of 4-D coded modulation formats based on set-partitioning of two 16QAM 2-D constellations. Using Nyquist-pulse-shaping, 32SP-DP-16QAM and 128SP-DP-16QAM signals are transmitted over long-haul distance and compared with PDM-16QAM.

articleTitle: Software defined code-rate-adaptive Terabit/s based on time-frequency packing
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: This paper demonstrates a software-defined code-adaptive Tb/s based on time-frequency packing technique. Enhanced OpenFlow architecture is proposed to set transmission parameters (e.g., code rate) of 1Tb/s. Several transmission reach values are achieved with adaptive code rate.

articleTitle: Real-time DSP for 100+ Gb/s
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We discuss the commercial context and technical requirements to 100G coherent interfaces and illustrate ASIC design decisions and challenges, looking beyond 100G as well.

articleTitle: Possibility of stack and draw process as fabrication technology for multi-core fiber
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: The merits and drawbacks of stack and draw process and drilling process for a multi-core fiber were discussed. The possibility of the stack and draw process for low-loss transmission line with multi-core fiber was confirmed.

articleTitle: Modified Gardner phase detector for Nyquist coherent optical transmission systems
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We present a novel timing recovery scheme based on a Gardner phase detector performing excellently in spectrally efficient Nyquist coherent optical systems. Good clock tone performance is obtained for QAM modulation formats and roll-off factor (ROF) values close to 0.

articleTitle: Fiber figure of merit based on maximum reach
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose and validate a figure of merit for fibers used in transmission of multilevel modulation formats over uncompensated links. It is based on maximization of reach and considers interaction of linear and nonlinear effects.

articleTitle: 100 Tbit/s free-space data link using orbital angular momentum mode division multiplexing combined with wavelength division multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Multiplexing/demultiplexing of 1008 data channels using orbital angular momentum (OAM) mode-division-multiplexing combined with wavelength-division-multiplexing is demonstrated. 24 OAM modes, each carrying 42 wavelengths, and each wavelength transporting a 100 Gbit/s QPSK signal, are multiplexed, with an aggregated capacity of 100.8 Tbit/s.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of OFDMA-PON uplink-transmission with four individual ONUs
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate the first OFDMA uplink transmission with four individually modulated ONUs with central distribution of the optical carrier and coherent reception at the OLT, showing that OFDMA-PON is viable.

articleTitle: Silicon microring modulators for advanced modulation formats
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Coherent optical transmitters can be implemented on silicon photonic integrated circuits with compact sizes and low cost. Here, we demonstrate a 56-Gb/s quadrature phase-shift keying modulation generated by silicon microring modulators with thermal control elements.

articleTitle: Linear optical IQ modulator for high-order multilevel coherent transmission
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We devised an optical modulator with a high field-response linearity, which is suitable for a DAC-based multilevel coherent transmitter. An advantage over a conventional MZM in terms of the linearity-loss tradeoff was demonstrated.

articleTitle: An integrated stateful PCE / OpenFlow controller for the control and management of flexi-grid optical networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We report the design, implementation and experimental evaluation of a centralized control plane based on a stateful PCE, acting as an OpenFlow controller. We detail the protocol extensions for elastic optical networks and the performance.

articleTitle: On-demand spectrum and core allocation for multi-core fibers in elastic optical network
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose on-demand spectrum resource allocation for elastic optical networks with multi-core fibers. We also introduce a simple crosstalk index and evaluate basic performance for blocking probability and spectrum overlap which causes inter-core crosstalk.

articleTitle: Compact and low power DP-QPSK modulator module with InP-based modulator and driver ICs
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A compact 128 Gbit/s DP-QPSK modulator module including driver ICs and polarization multiplexing micro-optics is demonstrated. A dissipation power of only 3.2 W was achieved with a low differential driver output voltage of 2.5 V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">pp</inf>.

articleTitle: Impact of tight optical filtering on the performance of 28 Gbaud Nyquist-WDM PDM-8QAM over 37.5 GHz grid
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We study the impact of tight optical filtering on the performance of 28 GBaud Nyquist WDM PDM-8QAM. Performance degradation and its mitigation using maximum-a-posteriori (MAP) detection are investigated. System sensitivity to laser frequency detuning, and Gaussianity of statistics are studied as well.

articleTitle: 25.78Gbps data transmission with 850nm multimode VCSEL packaged in QSFP form factor module
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We report 25.78Gbps error-free transmission over 114m OM3-fiber using QSFP modules based on 850nm multimode VCSEL. Error-free (10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-15</sup>) transmission was achieved over entire range of 0°C-85°C module case temperature. Neither equalization nor CDR were used.

articleTitle: Transmitter optimized optical networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Future optical networks will be resource limited and thus optical bandwidth and power must be used sparingly. This paper illustrates the potential network gains available by optimizing the transmitter power, constellation and DWDM channel allocations.

articleTitle: Estimating the energy consumption for packet processing, storage and switching in optical-IP routers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We develop a methodology to empirically quantify the energy consumption associated with packet processing, storage and switching in high-capacity routers. Our approach provides valuable insights for improving the energy efficiency of routing equipment and networks.

articleTitle: Pluggable fan-out realizing physical-contact and low coupling loss for multi-core fiber
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We investigated Physical-contact condition between a multi-core fiber and a fiber bundle fan-out. Based on this, we fabricated a pluggable fan-out and achieved the back-reflection and the coupling-loss lower than -50 dB and 0.3 dB, respectively.

articleTitle: On the impact of optimized guard-band assignment for superchannels in flexible-grid optical networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We present a planning method to find the best compromise between spectral efficiency and 3R regenerator requirements by optimizing the assignment of guard-bands in the deployment of Nx100G superchannels.

articleTitle: RWA for network virtualization in optical WDM networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We jointly consider problems of virtual network mapping and routing and wavelength assignment in WDM networks. Flexible virtual node mapping enabled by network virtualization achieves significant optical network resource savings compared to fixed node mapping.

articleTitle: Spectral shaping for mitigating backreflections in a bidirectional 10 Gbit/s coherent WDM-PON
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Receiver sensitivity penalty due to backreflections in a 10 Gbit/s bidirectional coherent WDM-PON is evaluated for 3 GBd PDM-QPSK. Pulse shaping is applied to reduce the impact of backreflections and enable tolerance to reflections up to -20 dBm.

articleTitle: Service fairness in flexible optical networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: This paper investigates quality of service fairness in grid-less, multi-rate optical networks. By means of analytical modeling and simulation, results show that unfairness arises in absence of suitable control and that trunk reservation policies may solve the issue.

articleTitle: Dynamic cooperative spectrum sharing in elastic networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Spectrum expansion, contraction, and re-allocation policies are proposed for flexible networks. Reductions in blocking probability can be achieved by introducing “neighbor avoidance” mechanisms. Trade-offs between blocking probability and the number of re-allocated connections are quantified.

articleTitle: Ultra-compact coherent receiver based on hybrid integration on silicon
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A coherent receiver based on silicon photonics is presented. Its performance is confirmed by single-channel and WDM transmission tests with PM-QPSK modulation at 28 Gbaud up to 4800 km. The packaged core is very compact with dimensions of 6 mm × 8 mm.

articleTitle: Protection schemes beyond currently defined in FTTx
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: This paper discusses the applicable area for PON protection, and shows N:1 OLT protection with an Nx1 switch is a suitable solution. Another PON protection using N:M redundancy is introduced for flexible OLT protection.

articleTitle: Reflective Silicon Mach Zehnder Modulator With Faraday Rotator Mirror effect for self-coherent transmission
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: An all-Silicon Reflective Mach Zehnder Modulator (Si-R-MZM) is proposed, providing the Faraday Rotator Mirror effect for achieving simple coherent demodulation. The Si-R-MZM is analytically described and measurements are made to assess the transmission performances.

articleTitle: Self-seeded RSOA based WDM-PON transmission capacities
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A self seeded WDM PON solution is evaluated at 1.25Gb/s and 2.5Gb/s in order to address optical budget, rise and fall time and jitter performances issues.

articleTitle: Integration of 112-Gb/s PDM-16QAM wireline and wireless data delivery in millimeter wave RoF system
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We have demonstrated a 112-Gb/s PDM-6QAM transmission over both 400-km SMF-28 wireline and 0.5-m 2×2 MIMO millimeter-wave wireless links. The 112-Gb/s PDM-16QAM after transmission over 400 km is up-converted to 35-GHz mm-wave and delivered over 0.5-m wireless distance before it is detected by a heterodyne coherent receiver.

articleTitle: Advantages of coherent detection in reflective PONs
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We present our recent results on coherent detection technologies applied to upstream transmission in reflective PON, comparing them to other existing architectures and showing a higher resilience to spurious reflections when compared to direct detection.

articleTitle: High bandwidth optical interconnection for densely integrated server
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We developed optical interconnect technologies, i.e., an optical mid-plane, high-density connector, and a compact transceiver for future servers that enable high-bandwidth and dense integration. Using these technologies, 1500 optical connections and 37.5 Tb/s of bandwidth were built in a blade-server form factor.

articleTitle: On the LDPC-coded modulation for ultra-high-speed optical transport in the presence of phase noise
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A Monte Carlo integration based method to calculate symbol log-likelihood ratios for soft iterative decoding in the presence of imperfect carrier phase estimation (CPE) is proposed. The proposed method shows good robustness when CPE is imperfect, in particular for optimum modulation schemes.

articleTitle: Combined SDM and WDM transmission over 700-km Few-Mode Fiber
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate multiple-input multiple-output transmission over a 700-km few-mode fiber of a combined 3-space-, 2-polarization-, and 34-wavelength-division multiplex, using low-loss 3-spot mode couplers.

articleTitle: 100 Gigabit Ethernet transmission enabled by carrierless amplitude and phase modulation using QAM receivers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Simulations have investigated single laser 100G Ethernet links enabled by CAP-16 using QAM receivers that not only lower significantly system timing jitter sensitivity but also outperform PAM and standard CAP in terms of power margin.

articleTitle: Monolithic linewidth narrowing of a tunable SG-DBR laser
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate an InGaAsP/InP widely-tunable SG-DBR laser integrated with an asymmetric Mach-Zehnder interferometer (AMZI) for frequency stabilization. Negative feedback from the AMZI to the laser phase tuning section reduces the linewidth by a factor of 27.

articleTitle: Space-division multiplexed transmission
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: This article consists of a collection of slides from the author's conference presentation. Some of the specific areas/topics discussed include: multicore fibers; MIMO equalization and outage; few-mode fibers and couplers; impulse response characterization; MIMO digital signal processing (DSP); nonlinearity in few-mode fibers; and SMD transmission experiments.

articleTitle: SDN and OpenFlow for converged access/aggregation networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: This paper discusses necessary steps for the migration from today's residential network model to a converged access/aggregation platform based on software defined networks (SDN).

articleTitle: All-optical network coding for DPSK signals
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: All-optical network coding for path protection is experimentally demonstrated using four-wave mixing in SOAs for10 Gbit/s NRZ-DPSK signals with error free performance. The total power penalty after two cascaded XOR stage is only 2 dB.

articleTitle: Transmission of 4-D modulation formats at 28-Gbaud
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Transmission of a 4-D optimized format with the same spectral efficiency as PM-QPSK was experimentally investigated. Decision directed equalizer adaptation and phase estimation enabled detection of this format and PM-QPSK and coded POLQAM as well.

articleTitle: Experimental characterization of a ring-profile few-mode erbium-doped fiber amplifier enabling gain equalization
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We measure the modal gain and noise figure characteristics of a ring-doped few-mode erbium-doped fiber amplifier. We obtained 1 dB higher gain in LP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf> than LP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</inf> at an average of 12.5 dB per mode.

articleTitle: Role of optical network infrastructure virtualization in data center connectivity and cloud computing
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A Datacenter as a Service architecture utilizing coordinated virtualization of distributed datacenters and operator's optical network is proposed. Two Optical network virtualization methods and a datacenter composition mechanism are introduced and their performance is evaluated.

articleTitle: Energy and deployment efficiency of a millimeter-wave Radio-on-Radio-over-fiber system for railways
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose a radio access network for railways employing millimeter-wave Radio-on-Radio-over-fiber and distributed antenna system, and evaluate its energy and deployment efficiency. We show a trade-off relation between the metrics and drive optimum system design.

articleTitle: Extensive fiber comparison and GN-model validation in uncompensated links using DAC-generated Nyquist-WDM PM-16QAM channels
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We report on a comprehensive performance comparison of seven different fiber types: transmission experiments based on of Nyquist-WDM using PM-16QAM modulation over uncompensated links show a perfect agreement with GN model prediction.

articleTitle: Transmission of 50-GHz-spaced single-carrier channels at 516Gb/s over 600km
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We report the first wavelength-division-multiplexed transmission of 50-GHz-spaced single-carrier channels at 400Gb/s effective data-rate, achieving 8-b/s/Hz spectral efficiency. Twenty channels are sent over 600km with PDM-64QAM operating at 43Gbaud and received with cascaded blind equalization.

articleTitle: Analytical OSNR formulation validated with 100G-WDM experiments and optimal subsea fiber proposal
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Analytical OSNR formulation is developed and validated with 100G-DP-QPSK-WDM experiments. Considering EDFA-output limitation, span length is optimized for subsea systems, and fibers with possible low attenuation and Aeff of 110-140μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> are found to be optimal.

articleTitle: Jitter tolerant clock recovery for coherent optical receivers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A novel clock recovery architecture is presented that includes a feed-forward variable delay element. The architecture is resilient to channel distortion and achieves good performance with Nyquist pulse-shaped signals.

articleTitle: Emerging disruptive wireless technologies - Prospects and challenges for integration with optical networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We describe some emerging technologies that are being investigated for the realization of next generation wireless networks capable of supporting multiple standards and meeting capacity demands. The challenges associated with their efficient integration in a converged wireless/optical network are also discussed.

articleTitle: 252 Gbit/s real-time Nyquist pulse generation by reducing the oversampling factor to 1.33
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: By reducing the oversampling factor to 1.33 and dynamically adapting the computational precision we demonstrate real-time 252 Gbit/s PDM-64QAM Nyquist sinc-pulse generation and optical transmission over 100 km ULAF.

articleTitle: Low-loss and broadband PLC-type mode (de)multiplexer for mode-division multiplexing transmission
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Two types of low-loss and broadband mode (de)multiplexer based on PLC are designed and fabricated. Multiplex/demultiplex of LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</sub> and LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub> modes is achieved with a low loss over a wide wavelength range.

articleTitle: Digital multi-wavelength generation and real time video transmission in a coherent ultra dense WDM PON
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Generation of multiple individually modulated wavelengths out of a single laser source is one of the key pre-requisites for an economical UDWDM PON. It is implemented using a 65 GS/s DAC and real time DSP.

articleTitle: Cost optimization of fiber deployment for small cell backhaul
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We discuss an optimization framework for planning a cost-minimized GPON backhaul deployment for small-cell networks. Compared to typical Ethernet based point-to-point fiber backhauling approaches, this technique can save half of the deployment costs.

articleTitle: Up to 45km-long amplified self-seeded RSOA based external cavity for 2.5Gb/s WDM PON transmission
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We present a new WDM-PON architecture based on amplified self-seeded RSOA creating an external cavity source. The SMF cavity length can reach up to 45km. Transmission at 2.5Gb/s are demonstrated.

articleTitle: A baud-rate sampled coherent transceiver with digital pulse shaping and interpolation
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate a baud-rate sampled 3.125GBd QPSK digital coherent transceiver employing pulse shaping and interpolation. Compared to an over-sampled receiver, a fixed penalty of 1.4dB is measured being independent of sampling phase or chromatic dispersion.

articleTitle: Impact of optical modulators in LTE RoF system with nonlinear compensator for enhanced power budget
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Nonlinear propagation compensation for LTE-RoF system is experimentally demonstrated with proposed DMFD and EMFD methods. We discovered that the RoF dithering frequency requirement have to be much smaller with an average improvement of ~5.35 dB.

articleTitle: Heterogeneous photonic integration for microwave photonic applications
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: As the component count rises in photonic systems, photonic integration becomes increasingly attractive from a cost, power consumption, and footprint perspective due to the ability to reduce the on-chip to off-chip interfaces and simplify packaging. Although photonic integration has been investigated in many forms over the last decade, the incompatibility of passive and active devices in standard integration platforms has limited their use in both military and commercial systems. In this talk, we review the advances in a heterogeneous silicon integration platform that provides state of the art active and passive devices integrated on silicon substrates for microwave systems-on-chip.

articleTitle: Autonomous software-defined coherent optical receivers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A new architecture for software-defined coherent intradyne optical receivers that autonomously identifies and decodes OOK, BPSK, QPSK and 16-QAM formats is demonstrated. Experimental 1056km transmission data are decoded without penalty.

articleTitle: Demonstration of WDM OSNR performance monitoring and operating guidelines for pol-muxed 200-Gbit/s 16-QAM and 100-Gbit/s QPSK data channels
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate an optical-signal-to-noise-ratio (OSNR) monitoring scheme of 200-Gbit/s PM-16QAM and 100-Gbit/s QPSK signals using Mach-Zehnder delay-line-interferometer with <;0.5 dB error for signals with up to 22 dB actual OSNR. We have also shown usability of this scheme by varying different parameters and have determined design guidelines to achieve a desired level of accuracy.

articleTitle: Physical-contact conditions for multicore fiber optical connectors
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We clarify the physical-contact conditions for multicore fiber connectors with good optical characteristics, and demonstrate physical-contact multicore fiber connectors with a sufficiently high return loss of more than 40 dB for all cores.

articleTitle: 3 Gbit/s LED-based step index plastic optical fiber link using multilevel pulse amplitude modulation
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Multilevel PAM is investigated for a LED-based SI-POF link. Using PAM-8, transmission at a record 3 Gbit/s is demonstrated for a maximum length of 25 m step index POF with offline post-receiver processing.

articleTitle: WDM channel capacity and its dependence on multichannel adaptation models
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Optical multichannel systems are often characterized by the channel capacity of a single channel, assuming a certain adaptation behavior of the other channels. We investigate some common adaptation models, which lead to dramatically different capacities.

articleTitle: Phase sensitive signal processing using semiconductor optical amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: This paper examines recent progress in the use of semiconductor optical amplifiers for phase sensitive signal processing functions, a discussion of the world's first multi-wavelength regenerative wavelength conversion using semiconductor optical amplifiers for BPSK signals.

articleTitle: Wideband photonic compressive sampling analog-to-digital converter for RF spectrum estimation
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Experimental results of multi-signal unambiguous frequency identification and bandwidth reconstruction are demonstrated using an average sampling rate that is more than an order of magnitude less than the uniform rate dictated by traditional Nyquist sampling.

articleTitle: Weakly-coupled few-mode fibers for single-mode and mode-division-multiplexed transmissions
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We study and optimize weakly-coupled few-mode fibers for single-mode and mode-division-multiplexed operations that allow to increase reach and capacity of transmission systems.

articleTitle: Efficient, non-data-aided chromatic dispersion estimation via generalized, FFT-based sweep
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose a method that eliminates the 2 samples/symbol requirement on FFT-based CD estimation, and generalizes this highly-efficient, non-data-aided, frequency-domain CD estimation approach to systems with η samples/symbol where 1<;η ≤2.

articleTitle: Monolithically integrated silicon nanophotonics receiver in 90nm CMOS technology node
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A monolithically-integrated germanium receiver is fabricated in the IBM's newly established 90nm CMOS-integrated nanophotonics technology node. Technology is promising for cost-effective 10Gbps to 28Gbps optical communications links operating within extended temperature range up to 95°C.

articleTitle: Flexible WDM-PON with Nyquist-FDM and 31.25 Gbit/s per wavelength channel using colorless, low-speed ONUs
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A remotely seeded flexible WDM network solution with 31.25 Gbit/s based on Nyquist sinc-pulses is demonstrated. The low-speed, colorless ONUs use remote heterodyne detection with electrical up- and down-conversion and SOAs for potential cost reduction.

articleTitle: 25 Gb/s operation of 1-GHz bandwidth R-SOA by using DMT and optical equalization
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We report the first experimental demonstration of 25Gb/s operation of 1GHz bandwidth-limited Reflective Semiconductor Optical Amplifier based on DMT modulation and optical equalization. This combination is highly resilient to chromatic dispersion.

articleTitle: Advanced and feasible signal processing algorithm for nonlinear mitigation
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Implementation-efficient nonlinear mitigation algorithms for digital coherent transceivers are introduced. Q-improvement by different algorithm combinations is presented for different transmission scenarios. Expectations on further improvement thorough noise reshaping and cycle slip reduction are also addressed.

articleTitle: Colorless flexible signal generator for elastic networks and rapid prototyping
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a flexible signal generator that can simultaneously generate arbitrary mixes of variable-bandwidth OFDM superchannels, and gridless WDM and OTDM channels. The device is based on reconfigurable multi-input pulse-shaping of data-modulated pulses.

articleTitle: Minimum spectrum block consumption for shared-path protection with joint failure probability in flexible bandwidth optical networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose a minimum-free-spectrum-block-consumption algorithm (MFSB) for shared-path protection with joint failure probability requirements in flexible bandwidth optical networks. Compared with conventional algorithms, MFSB efficiently decreases the spectrum block consumption and achieves higher spectrum utilization.

articleTitle: Demonstration of all-optical network coding by using SOA-MZI based XOR gates
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate all-optical network coding by showing cascaded operation of optical XOR gates. The gate consists of an integrated Mach-Zehnder interferometer which branches contain semiconductor optical amplifier based wavelength converters.

articleTitle: Effective flow protection in OpenFlow rings
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A scalable flow protection mechanism enabling fast resilience in OpenFlow-based ring networks is proposed without involving the controller. Experimental tests demonstrate that the achieved recovery time depends only on the time required for physical detection.

articleTitle: Impact of pulse shaping and transceiver electrical bandwidths on nonlinear compensated transmission
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We investigate the impact of pulse shaping by numerical simulation of 127Gbit/s DP-QPSK transmission with RZ, NRZ and Nyquist pulse formats. The transmitter analog bandwidth is found critical for the latter two cases.

articleTitle: Low computational complexity mode division multiplexed ofdm transmission over 130 km of few mode fiber
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate 337.5-Gb/s MDM-8QAM-OFDM transmission over 130 km of FMF. This confirms that OFDM can significantly reduce the required DSP complexity to compensate for differential mode delay, a key step towards real-time MDM transmission.

articleTitle: Real-time FPGA implementation of efficient filter-banks for digitally sub-banded coherent DFT-S OFDM receiver
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate a real-time FPGA realization of dual polarization filter banks - this high-speed 2×25 GBd low-complexity core establishes feasibility of energy-efficient (multipliers count ~halved) HW architecture for a digitally sub-banded 170 Gb/s DFT-S OFDM receiver.

articleTitle: Slip-reduced carrier phase estimation for coherent transmission in the presence of non-linear phase noise
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Pilot-free coherent systems use blind carrier phase estimation (CPE) methods that inevitably generate cycle slips. We propose an enhanced CPE reducing the cycle slip probability low enough to enable turbo differential decoding.

articleTitle: Impact of broadband four-wave mixing on system characterization
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We experimentally and analytically demonstrate the effect of broad-band four-wave mixing (FWM) on system optimization. We show that broadband FWM changes the behavior of systems such as performance vs. OSNR and bandwidth.

articleTitle: Two-phased capacity upgrade method for NG-PON2 with hierarchical star 8-QAM and square 16-QAM
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose a two-phased upgrade method of capacity per wavelength in NG-PON2. Coexistence with conventional NG-PON2 ONUs and a higher capacity are realized using star 8-QAM and square 16-QAM in phases 1 and 2, respectively.

articleTitle: Unified access and aggregation network allowing fixed and mobile networks to converge
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A new concept for unified access and aggregation network architecture allowing fixed and mobile networks to converge is proposed based on the concepts of Next Generation POP combining structural and functional convergence.

articleTitle: Should like demands be grouped in mixed line rate networks?
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Grouping same line-rate channels makes no difference in growth-only networks, but significantly reduces fragmentation in dynamic networks and improves overall network throughput, particularly in congested operation scenarios.

articleTitle: Coordinated operations between IP and transport network management systems in multi-vendor settings
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: This paper outlines some promising results recently obtained in a field trial led by Telefónica and ADVA Optical Networking. The technology tested enables coordinated orchestrations among IP and transport management systems in multi-vendor settings.

articleTitle: Nonlinear tolerance of few-mode fiber based transmission systems with random mode coupling
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose an analytical model for nonlinear propagation in few-mode fiber with random mode coupling. Simulation results show the Q factor can be improved by 5.3 dB for OFDM system with DGD= ±1 ns/km.

articleTitle: 106-fJ/(bit·km) 2-km OFDM OM4 MMF transmissions for energy efficient optical interconnects
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Employing high-performance 850-nm VCSELs with oxide-relief and Zn-diffusion structures, we demonstrate 17.8-Gbps 2-km OM4 fiber transmissions. Meanwhile, ultra-low EDDR of 106 fJ/(bit·km) with bias current as low as 1.9 mA is achieved.

articleTitle: Oxide-relief and Zn-diffusion 850 nm vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers with extremely small power consumption and large bit rate-distance product for 40 Gbit/sec operations
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Oxide-relief and Zn-diffusion structures are realized in 850 nm VCSELs. Both record-low energy-to-data-rate ratio (96 fJ/bit at 25 Gbit/sec; 135 fJ/bit at 37 Gbit/sec) and energy-to-data distance ratio 175 fJ/bit.km at 25 Gbit/sec are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Impact of crosstalk on real-time coherent detection of 112 Gb/s PDM-QPSK signal in WDM transparent networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We investigate the crosstalk tolerance of 112 Gb/s PDM-QPSK channels for various temporal or spectral configurations of the detected and the crosstalk signals. We also illustrate usual bandwidth characterizations are not appropriate for coherent detection.

articleTitle: All-optical traffic grooming in elastic optical network
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
