abstract: Novel architecture based on all-optical traffic grooming in optical node for elastic optical network is proposed. BER measurements experimentally demonstrate efficient adaptive switching and processing of variable fragmented traffic, leading to improved network scalability and efficiency.

articleTitle: Wavelength defragmentation algorithm for transparent multi-ring networks with multiple fibers per link
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose a scalable and effective wavelength defragmentation algorithm that considers multiple fibers per link. The number of fibers is reduced by more than 14% in multi-ring-like networks based on numerical evaluation.

articleTitle: Transmission of simultaneous 10Gb/s Ethernet and radio-over-fibre transmission using in-band coding
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A technique using spectrum-shaping codes to create nulls in the baseband spectrum of an Ethernet signal, so that several RF signals can be inserted in-band, is demonstrated by simultaneous transmission of 10GbE and WCDMA signals.

articleTitle: Polarization diversity DPSK demodulator on the silicon-on-insulator platform with simple fabrication
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate a novel polarization diversity DPSK demodulator on the SOI platform with low polarization dependent loss (1.6 dB) and low polarization dependent extinction ratio (<;3 dB). System experiments verify the low polarization dependency.

articleTitle: FTTdp: Complementing FTTH in difficult areas
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: In this paper we describe FTTdp (fiber to the distribution point), which delivers “fiber-like” service rates over the existing copper drop wire infrastructure. FTTdp complements FTTH by avoiding the fiber drop cost in difficult areas.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable orbital-angular-momentum-based switching among multiple 100-Gbit/s data channels
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate OAM-based reconfigurable optical switching functions among multiple OAM modes. Three-pair OAM modes exchange shows 3.6-dB conversion efficiency and selective data exchange among three 100-Gb/s QPSK OAM channels has a 2.1-dB OSNR penalty.

articleTitle: Benefit of pure N×M WSS for optical multiflow application
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: In the context of “multiflow” application optimizing the operation of superchannel transponders, this study compares different candidates for N×M Wavelength Selective Switch used as colorless, directionless, and contentionless add/drop stages.

articleTitle: SPM spectral broadening compensation using organic dyes with negative n2
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Spectral broadening caused by SPM degrades performance of light-wave, multichannel communication systems. We propose a novel method in LCOF to compensate the SPM spectral broadening in systems using different concentrations of negative n<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> organic dyes.

articleTitle: Optical signal processing
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Presents a collection of slides covering the following topics: optical signal processing; optical signal transmission; nonlinear process; photonic integration; modulation format; multicasting operation; multiplexing operation; demultiplexing operation; tunable optical delay; data grooming; flexible transmitter; optical control information; and microwave photonics.

articleTitle: Design of four-mode erbium doped fiber amplifier with low differential modal gain for modal division multiplexed transmissions
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We present a practical four-mode erbium-doped fiber design (with reasonably good fabrication tolerance) incorporating two separate doped regions for low differential modal gain across all the signal modes using LP01p and LP41p pump modes only.

articleTitle: Dynamic wavelength assignment and burst contention mitigation for the LOBS-over-WSON multilayer networks with an OpenFlow based control plane
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A novel scheme capable of dynamic wavelength assignment and burst contention mitigation is proposed to achieve efficient optical burst flow grooming in the OpenFlow controlled LOBS-over-WSON network. Simulation and experiment verified its feasibility.

articleTitle: Flexible all-optical OFDM using WSSs
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A LCOS WSS implements an optical inverse Fourier transform for 10-Tb/s OFDM signal generation and cyclic prefix insertion. After 857.4 km of dispersion uncompensated transmission, a second WSS implemented optically-banded digital subcarrier demultiplexing.

articleTitle: Multi-channel optical frequency-locked multi-carrier source generation based on multi-channel recirculation frequency shifter loop
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a novel scheme to generate multi-channel optical frequency-locked comb by using multi-channel recirculating frequency shifter loop. We successfully generate 54 frequency-locked subcarriers with 25 GHz frequency spacing in 2 channels.

articleTitle: Four- and eight-port photonic switches monolithically integrated with digital CMOS logic and driver circuits
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate in a single chip a complete multiport photonic switching system using IBM 90-nm photonics-enabled CMOS. The system includes CMOS logic, switch drivers, multistage 4×4 and 8×8 photonic switch fabrics, and thermo-optic phase tuners.

articleTitle: 8 × 120 Gb/s transmission over a cascade of two spans with a total loss in excess of 120 dB
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: This paper describes developments in unrepeatered systems architecture which result in a significant reduction of Capital and Operational Expenditures. We report 8 × 120 Gb/s transmission over a cascade of two legacy spans of 303.5 km (59.7 dB) and 342.9 km (60.8 dB).

articleTitle: Tunable silicon comb filters based on Fabry-Perot resonators formed by Sagnac loop mirrors
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate tunable silicon comb filters based on Fabry-Perot resonators composed of Sagnac loop mirrors using periodically-interleaved PN junctions. Forward and reverse biases blue- and red-shift the comb lines, respectively.

articleTitle: Suppression of chaos in integrated coupled DFB lasers for millimeter-wave generation
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A novel approach for millimeter-wave generation is proposed and demonstrated by suppressing modulation induced chaos in an integrated coupled DFB laser. Millimeter-wave carrier with high spectral purity is generated at ten times the modulation frequency.

articleTitle: Field experiment of 112 Gb/s dual-carrier DQPSK signal transmission with automatic bias control of optical IQ modulator
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate a simple and cost-effective automatic bias control scheme of quadrature modulator for advanced modulation formats, and confirm its performances in field transmission of 112 Gb/s dual-carrier DQPSK signal over 797-km of installed fiber.

articleTitle: Minimized spectral resource consumption with rescaled failure probability constraint in flexible bandwidth optical networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose an ILP model and an efficient rescaled failure-probability-aware algorithm (RFPA) to minimize spectral resource consumption. Simulation results show that, compared to a traditional algorithm, both ILP model and RFPA achieve higher spectrum efficiency.

articleTitle: Performance of a real IP over DWDM network > 1000 Nodes Regarding Elastic and Mixed-Line-Rate Scenarios on a flexible frequency grid
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Real network with 1113 nodes is studied regarding CAPEX and energy consumption to compare MLR/elastic and flat/hierarchical IP over DWDM flex-grid network scenarios. No significant benefit for any of the network concepts can be deduced.

articleTitle: Predicting structural and optical properties of hollow-core photonic bandgap fibers from second stage preforms
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose a simple theory based on mass conservation that allows accurate prediction of guidance properties in hollow-core photonic bandgap fibers (HC-PBGF) from knowledge of the second stage preforms from which the fibers are drawn.

articleTitle: Mechanism of optical losses in bismuth-doped silica fibers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Background optical losses in Bi:SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> glass and fibers fabricated and heat-treated in different redox conditions are studied. It is shown that these losses are mainly due to the absorption by metallic bismuth nanoparticles in glass.

articleTitle: Optical interconnect for volume servers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: This paper looks at the changes that have occurred in volume servers, and the requirements optical interconnect needs to satisfy to become the network technology of choice for those servers.

articleTitle: Non-data-aided PMD monitoring for optical OFDM systems using low bandwidth coherent receivers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A Stokes vector based non-data-aided DGD monitoring scheme for 40-Gb/s polarization-multiplexed coherent optical OFDM systems with low-bandwidth sampling is reported. The DGD estimation error is less than 2.5 ps after 1000-km long-haul transmissions.

articleTitle: Implementation of coded modulation and FEC
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We discuss implementation aspects of LDPC based soft-decision FEC schemes for high speed optical systems. Several BICM schemes with LDPC convolutional codes are proposed and compared in respects of both performance and implementation complexity.

articleTitle: Demonstration of parametric tunable dispersion compensation for WDM channels with mixed OOK and QPSK formats
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate parametric tunable dispersion compensation (PTDC) for WDM channels with mixed modulation formats of OOK and QPSK at 43-Gbit/s. We discuss specific design issues on PTDC considering the characteristics of the received channels.

articleTitle: Thulium-doped fiber amplifier for optical communications at 2µm
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We report the realization of a thulium doped fiber amplifier designed for optical communications providing high gain (>35dB) and low noise figure (<;6dB) over 1910nm-2020nm with a maximum saturated output power of more than 1W.

articleTitle: Magneto-optic four-wave mixing in fibers: Theory and experiment
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A comprehensive magneto-optic four-wave mixing theory for guided optical waves in linearly birefringent fibers is presented. The extra sensitivity improvement of 1.2 dB is obtained in a magnetically controllable 2R parametric regeneration experiment.

articleTitle: Influence of hydrogen loading on active fibers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Additional quenching of Er, Yb, Nd, and Bi luminescence in hydrogen impregnated silica optical fibers is revealed. Phenomenon is explained by deactivation of activators' excited states via collisions with hydrogen molecules migrating inside the glass network.

articleTitle: Field evaluation of high resolution optical FMCW monitoring approaches in passive optical networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Field trial results of high resolution optical frequency modulated continuous wave (FMCW) monitoring approaches are presented. The variable chirp rate technique and the phase noise cancellation method show promising results on a deployed fiber PON-infrastructure.

articleTitle: Optics for Supercomputers - One engineers perspective
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: The role of optics in Supercomputers is reviewed. Desirable optics features for next generation systems are described. Research directions for next generation optics packaging are suggested.

articleTitle: Ant-based alternate routing algorithm in flexible bandwidth optical networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose a novel ant-based alternate routing algorithm in the flexible bandwidth networks. Simulation results show that our algorithm outperforms other traditional algorithms by achieving a much lower blocking probability.

articleTitle: PCE: What is it, how does it work and what are its limitations?
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: This article consists of a collection of slides from the author's conference presentation. Some of the specific areas/topics discussed include; GMPLS-controlled optical networks and PCE architecture: limitations of GMPLS-controlled optical networks and PCE-based solutions; GMPLS-controlled WSON-SSON; and SDN-Openflow.

articleTitle: Ultra-fine optical spectrum microscope using optical channel estimation and spectrum fusion technique
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Ultra-fine optical spectrum microscope is demonstrated based on optical channel estimation using coherent optical OFDM signals and optical spectrum fusion technique. The frequency resolution and measurement range of this technique are 10.7-MHz and 250-GHz respectively.

articleTitle: M-QAM carrier phase recovery using the viterbi-viterbi monomial-based and maximum Likelihood Estimators
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We present a novel two-stage feedforward M-QAM carrier phase recovery scheme that does not rely on a computationally expensive Blind Phase Search stage. Performance is evaluated for square constellations up to 256-QAM.

articleTitle: Integrated tunable CMOS laser for Si photonics
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: An integrated tunable C band laser fabricated in a commercial CMOS foundry is discussed. The laser is embedded in the silicon chip, and is hermetically sealed. Preliminary optical characterization results are presented.

articleTitle: Entanglement-preserving photonic switching: Demonstration of full cross-bar operation with 25-GHz capability
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We present an all-optical, fiber-based quantum switch that operates at high speeds with low loss and-most importantly-retains the incident photons' quantum state, thereby making it useful for applications in quantum communications.

articleTitle: Single multi-mode mask for multi-channel mode division demultiplexing
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A mode demultiplexer based on a single multi-mode mask is experimentally demonstrated for splitting 3 spatial modes. Simulations for separating 5 modes is verified successfully and low mode-dependent loss is achieved with mode-dependent rotation compensation.

articleTitle: Comparing optical & OTN switching architectures in next-gen 100Gb/s networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Bandwidth efficiency for 100Gb/s WDM and switch architectures are compared in a North American long-haul network. Results show that OTN grooming utilizes fewest WDM wavelengths, and integrated WDM/switch architecture utilizes fewest client service interfaces.

articleTitle: Field trial experiment over 1200 km on a 100GHz grid-aligned multi-channel black-box wavelength converter
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A flexible modulation-, bit rate- independent and polarization insensitive wavelength converter based on a highly nonlinear fiber is demonstrated in the middle-point of a field trial transmission experiment.

articleTitle: Bidirectional direct detection mode multiplexing scheme for optical short link communications
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: An incoherent 3 channel mode multiplexing scheme based on far field imaging is presented. A fourier lens approach is used to demultiplex modes with an broadband optical image sensor.

articleTitle: Shared mesh restoration in ROADM based service velocity network
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Simulations of shared mesh restoration in a backbone network supporting rapid provisioning show up to 27% fewer regenerators than dedicated protection, plus ∼40% increase in capacity. Regenerator site concentration and minimum-regenerator routing provide best results.

articleTitle: Identification of high-PMD sections along installed optical cables with long range OFDR
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We describe a recent development of phase-noise-compensated-OFDR (PNC-OFDR) to identify high birefringence sections of fiber cables. Its unprecedented fine spatial resolution over several tens km range enables us to observe short beat length.

articleTitle: Adiabatic microring modulators
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: In this work, we demonstrate and experimentally characterize adiabatic microring modulators, the smallest (4-μm-diameter) microring modulators shown to date, yielding 6.92-THz uncorrupted free spectral ranges. We demonstrate and quantify operation up to 12.5-Gb/s data rates.

articleTitle: All-optical regeneration of 40 Gb/s NRZ-DPSK signals in a single SOA
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We report wavelength-preserving and wavelength-converting regeneration of 40Gb/s DPSK data in a saturated SOA. Experimental investigation of small-signal SOA amplitude and phase response reveals the role of data/CW power balance for phase preserving operation.

articleTitle: Broadband fluorescence enhancement in Cr-doped fibers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Broadband fluorescence enhancement in Cr-doped fibers (CDFs) fabricated by drawing-tower integrated powder-in-tube with redrawing technique is proposed and demonstrated. The CDFs after heat treatment exhibited Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+4</sup> emission enhancement with spectral density of 200 pW/nm which was identified as the formation of a-Mg<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> nanocrystalline structures in the core, observed by HRTEM.

articleTitle: Pattern-dependent performance of microring modulators
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We characterize microring modulators under consecutive data patterns and find significant power penalties when long sequences of zeros and ones are introduced. The penalty is greater for injection mode devices compared to depletion mode devices.

articleTitle: Ultra-broadband wavelength conversion based on four-wave mixing in a Raman DFB fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We report efficient four-wave mixing within a 30cm-long π phase-shifted Raman DFB fiber laser written in standard fiber operating at 1117nm with a maximum wavelength shift of 167nm and a conversion efficiency up to -25dB.

articleTitle: Low-complexity joint frequency offset and carrier phase estimation based on QPSK partitioning for DP 16-QAM
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A low-complexity, joint frequency offset and carrier phase estimation algorithm based on QPSK partitioning is proposed for dual-polarization 16-ary quadrature-amplitude-modulation.

articleTitle: Novel optical switch using manual guide-pin slide method based on MT multifiber connector technique
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose a novel optical switch that employs a manual guide-pin slide method in special guide holes in a novel multifiber array. We describe a fabricated switch that can provide easy handling.

articleTitle: Few-mode fiber optical parametric amplifier
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A few-mode fiber with a central depressed index region is designed for few-mode fiber parametric amplification. Such a design allows the zero dispersion wavelengths of both the LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</sub> and the LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub> modes shifted to the center of the C band. High gain and large bandwidth parametric amplification is demonstrate for both the LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</sub> and the LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub> modes in a single fiber.

articleTitle: The growing documentary project
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We developed a new collaborative scheme for creating high-quality documentary content with cloud-based content sharing and collaborative directing/editing capabilities in remote locations. The platform was examined iteratively through real documentary productions over high-speed networked environments.

articleTitle: FWM-based wavelength conversion in a silicon germanium waveguide
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate four-wave mixing based wavelength conversion of 40 Gbaud DPSK and QPSK signals in a 2.5-cm long silicon germanium waveguide with a nonlinearity coefficient of 25.8/W/m.

articleTitle: Energy-efficient protection designs for translucent optical networks using mixed regenerator placement
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We investigate energy-efficient protection designs for translucent networks using mixed regenerator placement (MRP). For link-based p-cycle designs, we develop an ILP model and a heuristic. We also propose a path-based shared backup path protection design algorithm.

articleTitle: PS-QPSK with duobinary-shaping and MLSD reception for constructing power- and spectrum-efficient superchannel
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: By deploying duobinary-shaping and MLSD reception, we propose and implement a power-efficient superchannel consists of 32Gbaud PS-QPSK channels on a 25GHz grid, demonstrating 3.84-bit/s/Hz spectrum efficiency and 1.6-dB higher sensitivity than PM-QPSK superchannel.

articleTitle: Apodized and un-apodized sidewall grating filters with low coupling constants in ultra-low-loss Si3N4 planar waveguides
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate apodized and un-apodized sidewall grating filters in an ultra-low-loss planar Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> integration platform. Record low coupling constants, as low as 0.19 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>, and better than 5dB side-lobe suppression with apodization are reported.

articleTitle: Experimental study of 16-, 32- and 64-QAM constellation sets in the 200-Gb/s regime on a data rate flexible system
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We implement a constellation set and data rate flexible system for transmission in the 200-Gb/s regime. Experimental evaluation of 16-, 32-, 64-QAM constellation sets show a small benefit for circular diagrams compared to widely used square sets.

articleTitle: All-optical wide-area node connections assisted with optical parametric regeneration and wavelength conversion
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Characteristics of all-optical node connections with an optical regenerator and wavelength converter are studied. The reachability of 43-Gb/s commercial transponders is extended by the optical regenerator compensating the spectral narrowing due to WSS cascade.

articleTitle: Low-complexity fractionally-spaced frequency domain equalization with improved channel estimation for long-haul coherent optical systems
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We present a coherent single-carrier system with optimized channel estimation and low-complexity fractionally-spaced frequency-domain equalizer. The concept is experimentally demonstrated for QPSK and 16-QAM systems to enable substantial overhead and complexity reduction without performance degradation.

articleTitle: High-power high-speed waveguide photodiodes and photodiode arrays heterogeneously integrated on siliconon-insulator
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate InP-based modified uni-traveling carrier photodiodes on silicon-on-insulator (SOI) waveguides with an internal responsivity of 0.85 A/W, up to 30 GHz bandwidth, and high RF output power. Photodiode arrays exceed a saturation current-bandwidth-product of 630 mA·GHz and +10 dBm RF output power at 20 GHz.

articleTitle: Photonic processing using integrated optical filters
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We will discuss photonic processing tasks that are enabled or assisted by integrated optical filters. A novel platform incorporating a highly nonlinear glass on an electro-optic substrate will be reviewed, namely arsenic-trisulfide (As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>)-on-LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> waveguides.

articleTitle: Structured directional coupler pair for multiplexing of degenerate modes
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A technique for multiplexing degenerate modes in circular multimode fibers using the structure directional coupler pair is presented. The same device can be used for demultiplexing of degenerated modes in combination with MIMO processing.

articleTitle: Demonstration of edge interoperability, re-shaping and re-timing using hybrid mode-locking within a 40Gb/s optical packet router
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate a regenerative optical router node showing 2R and 3R regeneration on 40Gb/s labeled optical packets. Successfully achieved >5dB increase in received power sensitivity and obtained >99% edge-to-edge Ethernet frame recovery.

articleTitle: A compact and CMOS compatible MMI coupler with very low excess loss
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We present the design, fabrication and measurement of a compact multimode interference (MMI) coupler based on silicon nanowire waveguides. The fabricated device has very low excess loss of 0.06dB and a broad operation bandwidth.

articleTitle: A heterodyne optical phase-locked loop for multiple applications
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A novel heterodyne optical phase-locked loop (OPLL) has been achieved and testing results are demonstrated with a 0.03 rad<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> phase error variance. Based on the superior performance of this OPLL, a system prototype is shown for multiple applications, including free-space LIDAR systems, widely-and-fast-tunable ultra-narrow-linewidth lasers, and ultra-accurate optical spectrum analyzers.

articleTitle: 12,000km transmission of 100GHz spaced, 8 495-Gb/s PDM time-domain hybrid QPSK-8QAM signals
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Employing time-domain hybrid QPSK-8QAM and training-assisted phase recovery, we successfully transmitted eight 495-Gb/s DWDM signals at net 4.125 bit/s/Hz spectral efficiency (SE) over 120×100km of ultra-large-area fiber, achieving a record SE distance product of 49500 (bit/s/Hz)km.

articleTitle: Chip and board-scale integrated Photonic Networks for next-generation computers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Careful co-design between electronics and photonics is needed to fully leverage the immense bandwidth-density potential of silicon photonics. Key insights are presented, which capture the interplay between process integration, device, circuit and system design strategies.

articleTitle: SNR optimization through digital frequency-domain pre-emphasis for extending transmission distances in DML-based OFDM-PON systems
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: By optimizing the SNR of OFDM-PON systems through frequency-domain pre-emphasis to counter the transmission distortion caused by frequency-chirped lasers, we demonstrate 20-Gb/s fixed-16QAM transmission over 40 km with a 20-dB power-budget for a 5.2-GHz signal-bandwidth.

articleTitle: 20-Gb/s DPSK transmission with 550-ps/nm dispersion tolerance using silicon Mach-Zehnder modulator
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Transmission measurements are performed using a low-loss zero-chirp silicon Mach-Zehnder modulator in 20-Gb/s DPSK with accumulated dispersion of -347 ps/nm to +334 ps/nm. Dispersion tolerance for 2-dB path penalty is as high as 550 ps/nm.

articleTitle: Micro-ring optical resonators fabricated by selective oxidation of refractory metals (SORM)
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A novel platform for integrated photonic circuits is proposed based on selective oxidation of refractory metals (SORM). Low-loss tantalum pentoxide coupled micro-ring optical resonators and high-index contrast ridge waveguides are demonstrated based on this platform.

articleTitle: Downconversion and linearization of X- and K-band analog photonic links using digital post-compensation
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate linearized X- and K-band APLs incorporating photonic downconversion based on digital post-compensation. The IMD products are suppressed by more than 21 dB and an SFDR as high as 124.2 dB-Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2/3</sup> is achieved with an improvement of 8 dB.

articleTitle: Virtual optical network embedding considering mixed transparent and translucent virtual links
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: An intelligent virtual optical network embedding approach is proposed, which minimizes the network resource usage of each request. Both transparent and translucent virtual optical link embedding is considered as specifically required by virtual optical links.

articleTitle: Ultracompact Si electro-optic modulator based on horizontal Cu-insulator-Si-insulator-Cu nanoplasmonic waveguide
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate ultracompact Si electro-optic modulators based on horizontal Cu-insulator-Si-insulator-Cu nanoplasmonic waveguides on SOI substrates using standard CMOS technology. A modulator with 1-μm-long phase shifter exhibits 9-dB extinction ratio under 6-V/10-kHz voltage swing.

articleTitle: Compact transmitter and receiver modules for E-band wireless links
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Compact wireless Radio-over-Fiber transmitter and receiver modules for 1.025 Gb/s wireless communication in the frequency range of 71-76 GHz.

articleTitle: Cascade of two opposite tapers for butt-coupling between fibers and silicon photonic wires with large misalignment tolerance and low polarization dependency
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A new coupler design consisting of a three-dimensional SU-8 taper and a silicon inverted nanotaper is presented. The fiber misalignment tolerance is ±3 μm and the coupler loss is 2.8 dB(TE) and 4.1 dB(TM).

articleTitle: Tunable vernier microring optical filters using p-i-p resistor-based micro-heaters
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We report a microring optical filter using Vernier effect. Tuning is enabled by a p-i-p resistor-based micro-heater integrated inside the resonators. Experiments show the filter wavelength can be tuned by 47 nm.

articleTitle: First demonstration of a broadband 37-cell hollow core photonic bandgap fiber and its application to high capacity mode division multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We report fabrication of the first low-loss, broadband 37-cell photonic bandgap fiber. Exploiting absence of surface modes and low cross-talk in the fiber we demonstrate mode division multiplexing over three modes with record transmission capacity.

articleTitle: Simplified Brillouin optical correlation domain analysis sensor based on a chopped microwave applied single sideband electro-optic modulator
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a novel scheme of the Brillouin optical correlation domain analysis (BOCDA) using a single sideband electro-optic modulator (SSBM). In the work, the SSBM is used to get carrier suppressed upper sideband for the pump wave, and also lock-in detection is used by applying chopped microwave to SSBM for chopping the pump wave. This implementation enables us to eliminate an additional intensity modulator (IM) for lock-in detection in conventional BOCDA scheme. In the experiment, a 100-m measurement range with 8-cm spatial resolution is successfully achieved.

articleTitle: M4 services for software-defined passive optical network and mobile backhaul applications using Multicore Fiber
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We present the first M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup> services (Multilevel modulation-format through Multimode, Multicore fiber for Multiple services) for access software-defined network and mobile backhaul applications. We experimentally demonstrate 12 different wired/wireless services simultaneously over one fiber.

articleTitle: All-optical phase conjugation using a 90 degree optical hybrid and nested SOA-MZIs
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: This paper presents an all-optical phase conjugation technique based on coherent optical signal processing by cross-phase-modulation in SOA-MZIs. Numerical simulation and experimental results demonstrate successful phase conjugation for 10Gbps OOK signal.

articleTitle: Green and agile petabit optical sub-wavelength switching prototype for the future OTN multi-chassis switch cluster
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A proof-of-concept prototype of optical sub-wavelength switching fabric is demonstrated. The prototype supports petabit switching capacity with agile service granularity and low power consumption.

articleTitle: Nonlinearities in space-division multiplexed transmission
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We discuss the modeling of nonlinear propagation in multi-mode optical fibers. We show that nonlinear propagation in the presence of random mode coupling is described by coupled multi-component Manakov equations. The system implications of these equations on communications performance and information capacity are discussed.

articleTitle: 1.6-Tbit/s muxing, transmission and demuxing through 1.1-km of vortex fiber carrying 2 OAM beams each with 10 wavelength channels
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate muxing, transmission and demuxing of 2 OAM beams over 10 wavelength channels through 1.1-km of vortex fiber. An aggregated total capacity of 1.6-Tbit/s is achieved by using 20-Gbaud/s 16-QAM signal on each channel.

articleTitle: Linear and nonlinear properties of SiGe waveguides at telecommunication wavelengths
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We report the characterization of the optical properties of Silicon-Germanium (SiGe) waveguides. The evolution of these properties is presented as a function of the Ge concentration and the waveguide width.

articleTitle: Frequency domain M-shaped pulse for SPM nonlinearity mitigation in coherent optical communications
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A new ISI-free frequency domain M-shaped pulse is proposed and experimentally verified to have better SPM tolerance than both RRC and optimized pulses in a 14Gbaud 56Gbit/s DP-QPSK system over dispersion unmanaged links.

articleTitle: Lightpath optimization in multi-domain optical networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A multi-objective optimization model is developed for lightpath provisioning in hierarchical multi-domain optical networks. The proposed formulation is then solved and its results compared against some existing distributed heuristic strategies.

articleTitle: Fiber to the distribution point (FTTdp) architecture for single user based on hybrid fiber and copper scheme
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose a passive architecture mixing G-PON and VDSL2 technologies. We evaluate a single-user per port FTTdp prototype providing up to 100Mbit/s bidirectional bit rate per customer over 100m from the distribution point.

articleTitle: Tunable single mode laser array based on slots
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: 9-channel wavelength-tunable single-mode laser array based on slots is presented. A 27nm tuning range has been demonstrated with output power >35mW and side-mode-suppression-ratio up to 56dB over a temperature range from 5°C to 40°C.

articleTitle: Simple 2×2 MIMO 60-GHz OFDM RoF system with single-electrode MZMs employing beating interference mitigation and IQ imbalance compensation
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose simple 2×2 MIMO 60-GHz RoF systems using single-electrode MZMs. Employing signal-signal beating interference mitigation, IQ imbalance compensation, and bit-loading technique, >40-Gbps OFDM signals over 12-km fiber and 3.5-m wireless transmission are achieved.

articleTitle: Experimental colorless reception of 16×DP-16QAM at 28 and 30 Gbaud using a Si-integrated coherent receiver
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We experimentally study the performance of a colorless Si-based integrated balanced coherent receiver. The receiver performs error free on 16 DP-16QAM channels after 1280 km, providing 3.2 Tbps. LO power and channel count dependence are investigated.

articleTitle: Transmission performance of phase-preserving amplitude regenerator based on optical injection locking
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We experimentally investigate the phase-to-amplitude noise redistribution of a 10Gbit/s BPSK signal in a phase-preserving amplitude regenerator based on optical injection locking and demonstrate its performance in a transmission experiment over an installed fiber link.

articleTitle: WDM-PON based on self-seeded OLT and wavelength reuse at ONU
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We report a simple 1:25Gb/s short-reach WDM-PON exploiting self-seeded transmitters at OLT and wavelength-reuse at ONUs to achieve the best combination of cost and capacity. Two remodulation schemes, NRZ/NRZ and IRZ/RZ are compared.

articleTitle: Highly-scalable, fully-asynchronous 16 ONUs, OCDM-based 10G-PON with a multiple access noise suppression at RN
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A novel configuration for asynchronous OCDM-based high spectral efficient 16 ONUs 10Gbps-PON is demonstrated for the first time, that drastically suppresses multiple access and beat noises.

articleTitle: Time domain hybrid QAM based rate-adaptive optical transmissions using high speed DACs
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We present the transmission of time domain hybrid QAM signals in order to maximize spectral efficiency according to link conditions. Single carrier (28 Gbaud) and superchannel (up to 1.15 Tb/s) transmission is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Orbital-angular-momentum-based reconfigurable and “lossless” optical add/drop multiplexing of multiple 100-Gbit/s channels
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose reconfigurable optical add/drop multiplexing in a data link using orbital angular momentum (OAM) mode division multiplexing. Adding/dropping of one OAM mode from three multiplexed OAM modes, each carrying 100 Gbit/s QPSK data is demonstrated, with an OSNR penalty of < 2dB.

articleTitle: Full-range pilot-assisted frequency offset estimation for OFDM systems
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated a novel frequency offset compensation method with the widest estimation range by inserting one pilot-tone at the center of the OFDM spectrum.

articleTitle: Impact of interleaving on SD-FEC operating in highly non-linear XPM-limited regime
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We experimentally investigate the behavior of two SD codes in a 100G-PDM-DQPSK system with high-power 10G-OOK neighbors. We show that in the presence of sufficient interleaving the input-output BER relationship of both codes remains unaffected.

articleTitle: Energy-efficient optical quantization scheme with orthogonal spectral slicing by AWG for OFDM
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate a novel energy efficient quantization using orthogonal spectral slicing with AWG of OFDM for the first time. Both numerical and experimental results show the feasibility of 10 Gsample/s, optical quantization for A/D conversion.

articleTitle: Parametric amplification of a 640 Gbit/s RZ-DPSK signal
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We report the first demonstration and characterization of parametric amplification of a 640Gbit/s RZ-DPSK OTDM signal. With proper design of the fiber parametric amplifier, error-free amplification with less than 1 dB penalty has been achieved.

articleTitle: Dual-stage decision-directed phase estimator enabling perfect frequency-offset elimination in digital coherent optical receivers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose a dual-stage phase estimator controlled by the decision-directed LMS algorithm in digital coherent optical receivers. Simulations and experiments show that our proposed scheme can perfectly eliminate arbitrary frequency offsets in higher-order QAM systems.

articleTitle: Microresonator-based frequency comb generator as optical source for coherent WDM transmission
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A high-Q SiN microresonator is used for the first time as an optical source for WDM transmission with advanced modulation formats. We transmit QPSK and 16QAM signals with a total bit rate of 392 Gbit/s.

articleTitle: Demonstration of flexible optical buffer based on 1×32 optical switches and fiber-sheet delay lines
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We first demonstrated a 31-fiber-delay-lines buffer using flexible and compact fiber sheets combined with cascaded PLZT switches. Error-free operation of all packets, given delays up to 3-μs at intervals of 100-ns, was achieved after buffering.

articleTitle: A 33mW 100Gbps CMOS silicon photonic WDM transmitter using off-chip laser sources
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We report an ultra-low power 100Gbps silicon photonic WDM transmitter tunable with off-chip laser sources. The hybrid CMOS transmitter consists of eight 12.6Gbps WDM channels and consumes a total on-chip power of 33mW.

articleTitle: Unrepeatered transmission of 3.2-Tb/s (32×120-Gb/s) over 445-km fiber link with Aeff managed span
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrated 3.2-Tb/s (32×120-Gb/s) unrepeatered transmission over 445-km fiber with A<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">eff</inf>-managed-span. This was achieved by employing co-propagating second-order pumped Raman amplification and ROPA. This paper also discusses design trade-off for performance enhancement of unrepeatered transmission.

articleTitle: Multi-stratum resources integration for data center application based on multiple OpenFlow controllers cooperation
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We present a multi-stratum resources integration architecture for data center application with flow estimation based on multiple OpenFlow controllers cooperation. The overall feasibility and efficiency of the proposed architecture are experimentally verified on our testbed.

articleTitle: Differential link-loss compensation through dynamic bandwidth assignment in statistical OFDMA-PON
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Flexible bandwidth allocation strategies in a statistical OFDM-PON are experimentally shown to compensate for differential link loss allowing for proper detection of ONUs separated up to 55km (11.4dB).

articleTitle: Single-stage FDE supported by training-aided channel estimation for coherent optical receivers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Low-complexity single-stage frequency domain equalization is demonstrated in a 112-Gbps PDM-QPSK optical communication system. The bulk of CD is blindly estimated while residual CD, PMD and SOP tracking is supported by training-aided channel estimation.

articleTitle: Nyquist filtering of 160 GBaud NRZ-like DPSK signal
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We have generated a phase-correlated 160 GBaud NRZ-like DPSK signal based on XPM in a HNLF. The generated 160 GBaud DPSK signal is Nyquist filtered with minimized ISI and error-free performance is achieved.

articleTitle: Realizing the benefits of multi-layer packet-optical network design
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Tighter integration of packet and DWDM network layers has the potential for more cost-effective packet-optical networks. This paper examines evolving network design and traffic engineering practices that make more efficient use of packet and DWDM resources.

articleTitle: 105Tb/s transmission system using low-cost, MHz linewidth DFB lasers enabled by self-homodyne coherent detection and a 19-core fiber
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate a 105.1Tb/s self-homodyne transmission system using low-cost DFB lasers with dynamic path length adjustment and reduced DSP requirement in a 19-core-fiber with each signal core carrying 125×25Gbaud QPSK signals on a 50GHz grid.

articleTitle: Aberration correction in Spatial Light Modulator based mode multiplexers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: The Spatial Light Modulator in a mode demultiplexer is used to measure the aberrations of the system in which it is installed before applying aberration correction to improve the insertion loss and modal extinction ratios.

articleTitle: Differentiated quality of protection to improve energy efficiency of survivable optical transport networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A differentiated quality of protection scheme is evaluated in terms of energy efficiency for fixed-grid WDM and flexible-grid OFDM-based networks. Significant energy savings can be achieved by exploiting the heterogeneous protection requirements.

articleTitle: Development of a widely tunable narrow linewidth RF generator using a hybrid silicon photonic platform
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We have developed a system for generating widely tunable, narrow-line RF signals from a pair of injection-locked lasers. Here we focus on the design and implementation of an integrated module and analysis of the produced RF.

articleTitle: PAPR reduction using contiguous-tone Tone Reservation technique in optical OFDM IMDD transmissions
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: The performance of contiguous-tone Tone Reservation PAPR reduction technique is studied in OFDM and pre-coded OFDM systems in the context of optical IMDD transmissions. The study reveals also the potential of the pre-coded OFDM scheme.

articleTitle: Flexible WDM/FTDM passive optical network with RZ-seeded all-optical sub-wavelength grid engine
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: All-optical FDM grid generation and channel selection is experimentally demonstrated through optical signal processing. Full-duplex 10G/2×10G transmission with reflective ONUs is validated for 20dB budget and 25km reach. An optional 10Gb/s FDM/TDM mode is verified.

articleTitle: InP photonic integrated circuit with on-chip tunable laser source for 2D optical beam steering
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: 2D optical beam steering through an InP photonic integrated circuit with on-chip tunable laser source has been demonstrated for the first time.

articleTitle: Investigation of black-box phase regeneration using single bi-directional PPLN waveguide
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We investigate a novel in-line phase regeneration set-up using a single bi-directional PPLN waveguide for both generation of phase correlated signals and phase-sensitive regeneration and injection-locking for carrier phase recovery.

articleTitle: MPLS-TP: Overview and status
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Increasing demand for packet transport technology was driver for MPLS-TP technology. Key features of MPLS-TP: Separation of Data-plane and Control-plane; OAM; NMS; Recovery (Protection). An OAM solution (G.8113.1(PTN) ) has been standardized. PTN is a simple and transport-oriented OAM solution based on Ethernet OAM. Converged transport network solution based on MPLS-TP is a promising solution for future cost & energy efficient networks.

articleTitle: Γ-robust network design for Mixed-Line-Rate-Planning of Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Mixed-line-rate optical networks allow for a more resource-efficient handling of small and large traffic volumes. In this work, we extend this flexibility by adapting Γ-robust optimization to deal with demand uncertainty.

articleTitle: CMOS-compatible silicon double-etched apodized waveguide grating couplers for high efficient coupling
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a double-etched apodized fiber-to-waveguide grating coupler in silicon-on-insulator for high efficient coupling. The device fabricated using deep UV photolithography exhibits a coupling loss of -1.5 dB with 3-dB bandwidth of 54 nm.

articleTitle: Single-carrier 400G interface and 10-channel WDM transmission over 4,800 km using all-ETDM 107-Gbaud PDM-QPSK
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We transmit all-electronically multiplexed 107-Gbaud polarization-multiplexed quadrature-phase-shift-keying over 4,800-km using coherent detection based on a real-time oscilloscope with 63-GHz electronic bandwidth. Ten WDM channels on a 120-GHz grid yield a spectral efficiency of 3.3 b/s/Hz.

articleTitle: Minimize sub-carrier re-allocation overhead in SLICE networks with dynamic traffic
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose novel sub-carrier (re)allocation approaches to accommodate dynamic traffic while minimizing the reconfiguration cost in SLICE networks, with or without planning based on the traffic prediction.

articleTitle: Differential mode delay management in spliced multimode fiber transmission systems
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Influence of fiber splice to differential mode delay (DMD) in mode-division multiplexed fiber links is analyzed. We show that DMD managed links, even with significant mode coupling due to splices, strongly reduce the link DMD.

articleTitle: Crosstalk performance analysis of low cost 8 × 10 Gb/s tunable receiver for TWDM-PON
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate the performance of a low cost, 8×10 Gb/s tunable receiver with -26 dBm sensitivity at 1E-3 BER for each channel in a 8×100 GHz channel TWDM testbed for use in TWDM-PON applications.

articleTitle: First OpenFlow-based software-defined λ-flow architecture for flex-grid OFDMA mobile backhaul over passive optical networks with filterless direct detection ONUs
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate the first software-defined OpenFlow1.0-based flex-grid λ-flow architecture enabling 150Mb/s per-cell OFDMA MBH overlays onto bidirectional 10Gb/s PON, without any ONU-side optical filtering, amplification, or coherent detection over 20km SSMF and 1∶64 passive split.

articleTitle: Dependence of upstream power budget on the number of ONUs in IMDD optical OFDMA PONs
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: In optical OFDM multiple access PONs utilizing intensity-modulation/direct-detection, we show, for the first time, that doubling the number of ONUs gives an 1.9dB reduction in upstream power budget, mainly due to decreased signal-to-carrier power ratios.

articleTitle: 8 × 120 Gb/s transmission over 80.8 dB / 480.4 km unrepeatered span
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Unrepeatered transmission of 8 × 120 Gb/s PM-NRZ-QPSK signal over a record span loss of 80.8 dB (480.4 km) is achieved using forward and backward distributed Raman amplification and remotely-pumped Erbium fiber over large effective area fiber.

articleTitle: High accurately synchronized λ-tunable WDM/TDM-PON using timestamps based time and frequency synchronization for mobile backhaul
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose a time and frequency synchronized λ-tunable WDM/TDM-PON with a synchronization method using timestamps. We clarify requirements of synchronization accuracy for mobile backhaul networks numerically and confirm its feasibility experimentally.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a symmetric 10 Gb/s QPSK subcarrier multiplexed WDM PON with IM/DD transceivers and a bandwidth-limited RSOA
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Full-duplex 10 Gb/s/λ transmission is demonstrated over a 20 km single feeder WDM PON. BER performance below the RS(255,223) FEC threshold is achieved for OLT launch powers, ranging from 0 dBm to 9 dBm, proving flexibility to network operators.

articleTitle: Supermodes in strongly-coupled multi-core fibers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Single-mode and higher-order supermodes in the strongly-coupled multi-core fibers have been investigated. These fibers offer high mode density, ease of (de)multiplexed, and tunability in mode coupling as well as differential modal group delay.

articleTitle: 3.5 W optical power delivery over 5 km single-mode fiber using C-band amplified spontaneous emission light source
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrated the power-delivery limit of single-mode fiber. By using a C-band ASE light source to suppress the stimulated Brillouin scattering, we delivered 3.5 W of optical power over a 5 km-long fiber.

articleTitle: Transient crosstalk in LCOS based WSS and a method to suppress the crosstalk levels
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: The origin of the transient crosstalk (TC) in a phase-only LCOS based WSS using a Fourier transform setup was investigated and identified. Two methods were proposed to reduce the TC by at least 5dB without the need to modify the optics or electronics in use.

articleTitle: Optical packet switch node with packet flow control for flat inter-cluster data center network
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We experimentally investigate a flow-controlled optical packet switch node operation. The distributed control and the nanosecond packet switching/retransmission allow a limited input buffer capacity to ensure packet loss <10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−5</sup> for loads up to 0.5.

articleTitle: Flexible QoS differentiation in converged OFDMA-PON and LTE networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose a Weighted-DSA scheduling algorithm which allows efficient mapping of LTE QCIs over the optical queues of an OFDMA-PON. A 63ms end-end wireless packet delay has been demonstrated for QCI5 at highest network loads.

articleTitle: Node handling capacity based spectrum fragmentation evaluation scheme in flexible grid optical networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Based on the reasonable modeling of the spectrum consecutiveness around the node, the concept of node handling capacity is proposed which can effectively indicate the degree of spectrum fragmentation in flexible grid optical networks.

articleTitle: Transmitter synthesis for advanced modulation formats utilizing silica-LiNbO3 hybrid integration technology
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Silica-LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> hybrid integration has opened up the possibility of synthesizing advanced transmitters, including dual-carrier 16 QAM modulators and flexible-format modulators. They can provide the best mix of optics and electronics, and are the key to future optical transport systems.

articleTitle: 1.3 µm 28 Gb/s EMLs with hybrid waveguide structure for low-power-consumption CFP2 transceivers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: 1.3 μm 28 Gb/s EMLs with novel hybrid waveguide structure were demonstrated. The EMLs achieved high output power and high extinction ratio under the condition of low operating current, low modulation voltage and high chip temperature.

articleTitle: Adaptive maximum likelihood sequence detection in 100-Gb/s coherent optical communication systems
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A novel adaptive MLSD algorithm is introduced and experimentally demonstrated for a 100-Gb/s PDM-DQPSK system to automatically achieve optimal performance and reduce receiver complexity using a first-order filter for phase reference tracking.

articleTitle: Performance improvement by pre-equalization in W-band (75–110GHz) RoF system
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate pre-equalized W-band RoF system carrying 9.95-Gb/s OOK downlink signal with 19-km SMF-28 transmission and 1.5-m wireless delivery, with BER under 1×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−9</sup> and receiver sensitivity reduction at the BER of 1×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−9</sup> under 0.5dB.

articleTitle: Field trial demonstration and evaluation of coherent 100G IP over WDM alien wavelength across 769km of multiple WDM infrastructures without regeneration
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We report the first successful coherent 100G IP over WDM alien wavelength field trial over WDM infrastructures of total 769km, demonstrating the feasibility and robust performance of the 100G IP over WDM core network architecture.

articleTitle: Reducing equalizer complexity in coherent receivers for Nyquist spectrally shaped systems with matched filters
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We show that the complexity of the receiver-side dynamic butterfly equalizer can be significantly reduced by incorporating a matched filter in the static chromatic dispersion equalizer for root-raised-cosine Nyquist spectrally shaped systems.

articleTitle: 6×28-Gbaud few-mode recirculating loop transmission with gain-equalized inline few-mode fiber amplifier
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Using a transmission fiber with a zero differential modal dispersion wavelength and a gain-equalized few-mode EDFA, we demonstrate mode-multiplexed transmission over a fiber recirculating loop with all few-mode components.

articleTitle: Transmission of 130-Gb/s PDM-QPSK over 5,760-km with co-propagating 10-Gb/s OOK channels in dispersion-managed NZDSF spans with soft-decision LDPCC coding
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We transmit one 130-Gb/s PDM-QPSK channel surrounded by fifteen 10-Gb/s OOK channels at 50-GHz channel spacing over 5,760 km in dispersion-managed TrueWave<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">®</sup> REACH spans, with a 20% overhead concatenated FEC scheme using soft-decision LDPCC coding.

articleTitle: Configurable optical interconnects for scalable datacenters
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: High performance interconnects provide communications for large datacenters. Optical interconnects are replacing copper as bandwidth increases. This paper uses small MEMs optical switches to reconfigure large datacenter interconnects for varying needs.

articleTitle: ONT reflection for additional maintenance by OTDR-measurements in FTTH networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: ONT-reflection is used, additionally to GPON-EMS, to identify termination points in FTTH-PON-networks. OTN-reflectivity vs. wavelength is investigated. In-service OTDR-measurements from Central Office allow testing PON-branches and to distinguish optical length differences down to 2m.

articleTitle: Vector mode effects in few moded erbium doped fiber amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We numerically investigate the effects of vector mode evolution in FM-EDFAs and show that evolution of the transverse pump and signal intensities can have a profound effect on the detailed amplifier performance depending on the nature of the pump and signal modes involved.

articleTitle: Optically reconfigurable 1×4 silicon-on-insulator remote node switch for access networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Operation of an optically controlled 1×4 remote node, based on membrane InP switches and SOI waveguide circuits, is shown. Extinction ratio >25dB and penalty-free operation for 10Gb/s 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">31</sup>-1 PRBS data through the switch are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Angle-of-arrival measurement of a microwave signal based on parallel optical delay detector with accuracy monitored
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A novel parallel optical delay detector for angle-of-arrival measurement is proposed and the measurement errors are experimentally studied and analyzed. Moreover, the measurement accuracy monitoring is investigated.

articleTitle: Silicon microring-based integrated circuit for optical label-free biosensor with direct electrical readout
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate a cost-effective silicon microring-based bio/chemical sensor, which integrates vertical grating couplers, two cascaded microrings for optical sensing and electrical tracing, and Ge photodetector for direct sensing interrogation. Detection limit of 1.5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup> is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Signal-LO frequency offset tolerance under tight filtering for PM-QPSK using all-digital compensation
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We investigate the signal-LO frequency offset tolerance of PM-QPSK under tight filtering using all-digital compensation. For frequency offsets of 0.32× symbol rate, the additional receiver electrical bandwidth can be as low as 0.13× symbol rate.

articleTitle: Measurement of equivalent zero-dispersion wavelength distribution for capacity increase in FWM-limited networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: An equivalent zero-dispersion wavelength distribution of a DSF span is derived from degenerate FWM measurements and genetic algorithm optimization. The resulting distribution forms the input to channel allocation routines which maximize capacity on FWM-limited fibers.

articleTitle: Cost optimization in an FTTP environment
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Verizon has developed several optimization methodologies for the design and operation of the FTTP network. Two of these methodologies, one design and one operations, will be presented and the benefits of advanced analytics discussed.

articleTitle: OH-free halo-tellurite glass mid-infrared optical fiber
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We report the fabrication of a new halo-tellurite glass fiber with low attenuation from 2-4 μm using a dehydration process. It shows a promising candidate for transmission and nonlinear applications in 2-5μm region.

articleTitle: Novel back-to-back uni-traveling-carrier photodiodes with high responsivity and wide bandwidth
