publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Novel back-to-back uni-traveling-carrier photodiodes are proposed and demonstrated. High responsivity of 0.83 A/W and wide bandwidth over 40 GHz are realized simultaneously in mesa-structure photodiodes for the first time.

articleTitle: Coherent receiver photonic integrated circuits
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Coherent Receiver PICs are realized both in InP-based monolithic integration and in hybrid integration using polymer waveguides. These platforms are compared and evaluated.

articleTitle: Practical limits of coherent receivers for unamplified 100Gb/s applications
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: The impact of noise sources on the performance of a coherent receiver for loss-limited links is demonstrated. With GFEC, -29.1dBm receiver sensitivity is achieved for 112-Gb/s PM-QPSK format. For shared laser architectures, asymmetric power splitting favoring the transmitter is shown to result in optimum link budget.

articleTitle: 32-channel integrated receiver module for WDM-PON applications
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: WDM-PON offers distinct advantages over competing technologies, but has typically come at the expense of high component costs and low OLT port densities. We present an integrated PLC-based receiver module that integrates 32 APD receivers along with a demultiplexer and integrated temperature controller, in a compact module with high performance.

articleTitle: Infrared tube-leaky optical fibers with microstructured glass supports
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Guiding mechanism of tube-leaky fibers composed only of a dielectric thin wall is explained by ray-optic method. The tube-leaky fiber supported by microstructured glass is fabricated and the loss at 2.94-μm wavelength was 0.87dB/m.

articleTitle: Generation of 1500-tone, 120nm-wide ultraflat frequency comb by single CW source
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Dense 1500-tone frequency comb is derived from a single CW laser. Sub-2dB flatness was measured over 120 nm, with 40 dB optical signal-to-noise-ratio. The new generator uses regenerative shock formation prior to parametric mixing process.

articleTitle: A 270 × 270 optical cross-connect switch utilizing wavelength routing with cascaded AWGs
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We develop a 270 × 270 optical cross-connect that utilizes our cascaded arrayed waveguide-grating (AWG) configuration. The system is set in a 370 × 230 × 120 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> box and its feasibility is confirmed by transmission experiments.

articleTitle: Multiband DFT-spread-OFDM equalizer with overlapand-add dispersion compensation for low-overhead and low-complexity channel equalization
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We describe a multi-band DFT-spread-OFDM equalizer that combines overlap-and-add dispersion compensation with OFDM demultiplexing for reduced guard interval and lowered DSP complexity, and demonstrate it in the transmission of a 22-Gbaud signal over 6400-km SSMF.

articleTitle: Demonstration of 4-band millimeter-wave radio-over-fiber system for multi-service wireless access networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A novel all-band 60-GHz RoF system with 4 sub-bands has been proposed to offer converged legacy wireless services and multi-gigabit data access. Successful transmission of 0.4-Gb/s QPSK-OFDM and three independent 0.5-Gb/s OOK data is achieved.

articleTitle: Mid-infrared silicon photonics
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A mid-infrared silicon nanophotonic integrated circuit platform can have broad impact upon environmental monitoring, personalized healthcare, and public safety applications. Development of various mid-IR components, including optical parametric amplifiers, sources, modulators, and detectors, is reviewed.

articleTitle: 21 Gb/s polarization switched-QPSK real-time coherent FPGA-based receiver
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A real-time FPGA-based receiver of 21Gb/s PS-QPSK signal is reported and tested against optical noise, chromatic dispersion (CD), polarization mode dispersion (PMD) and state of polarization (SOP) scrambling. A comparison with PDM-QPSK realized with equivalent parameterized setup and signal processing confirm the greater tolerance of PS-QPSK over PDM-QPSK.

articleTitle: A novel multi-channel digital pre-distortion technique for subcarrier multiplexed radio-over-fiber system
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A multi-channel digital pre-distortion (DPD) technique is proposed to linearize the SCM-RoF system. The DPD processing bandwidth and computation cost are greatly reduced, while excellent nonlinear compensation performance is obtained in the experimental demonstration.

articleTitle: DT's standardization activities to achieve interoperability on 100G for metro applications
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: This paper reports about the simplification of network infrastructure by reducing the number of interconnected layers, integration of IP and Optics and the related standardization activities to ensure interoperability and manageability of optical interfaces specified by G.698.2.

articleTitle: Polarization diversity detection for equidistant target discrimination in passive optical networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A method to distinguish single- and equidistant multi-target reflections in optical monitoring is successfully demonstrated. The polarization dependent transmission in field deployed fiber PON-infrastructure was evaluated by combining polarization diversity detection with frequency modulated continuous-wave.

articleTitle: FTTH deployments in Latin America
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: The deployment of FTTH is in initial stage in the region. In this study we will review the current market size, forecast for next 3 years, topologies applied and technical issues due to local conditions.

articleTitle: All-solid photonic bandgap fiber with record mode area
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated all-solid photonic bandgap fibers with ~50μm core diameters and excellent higher order mode suppression, which can be used for high power fiber lasers to overcome the limits of fiber nonlinearities.

articleTitle: Which is more suitable for the control over large scale optical networks, GMPLS or OpenFlow?
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Two testbeds based on GMPLS and OpenFlow are built respectively to validate their performance over large scale optical networks. Blocking probability, wavelength utilization and lightpath setup time are shown on the topology with 1000 nodes.

articleTitle: Multimaterial functional fibers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Integrating optically, electrically, and thermo-mechanically disparate materials into a fiber drawn from a preform is enabling fiber devices with unique functionalities. We present two examples: directionality-controlled radial fiber lasers and all-in-fiber chemical sensors.

articleTitle: A bidirectional multi-band 60-GHz wireless-over-fiber transmission system with compacted base station and mobile terminal using a robust mm-Wave LO free technique
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: For the first time, bidirectional multi-band multi-gigabit wireless-over-fiber transmission at 60-GHz mm-wave band has been accomplished with centrally supplied LO service. It does not require mm-wave LO devices in each base stations and mobile terminals.

articleTitle: Dose dependence of luminescence increase in H2-loaded Bi-Al co-doped optical fibers by cw 244-nm and pulsed 193-nm laser irradiation
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: The near infrared luminescence is increased in H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-loaded Bi-Al co-doped optical fibers by irradiation of cw 244-nm or pulsed 193-nm laser light. The dose dependence is different for the two lasers.

articleTitle: Using SBS loop for extinction ratio enhancement and flatness improvement in optical comb generation
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate improvement in optical comb characteristics using a stimulated Brillouin scattering fiber loop. A 25-dB extinction ratio enhancement together with a 4-dB flatness improvement are achieved. The output extinction ratio reaches 38 dB.

articleTitle: Novel carrier phase estimation scheme for polarization switched-QPSK-based transmission systems
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose a novel, low complexity, carrier phase estimation scheme for the coherent reception of PSQPSK-modulated signals and assess its back-to-back and transmission performance.

articleTitle: 224-Gb/s PDM-16-QAM modulator and receiver based on silicon photonic integrated circuits
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate a coherent modulator and a receiver based on monolithically-integrated silicon photonic circuits, capable of modulating and detecting 224-Gb/s polarization-division-multiplexed 16-QAM. The high-degree photonic integration promises small-form-factor and low-power transceivers for future coherent systems.

articleTitle: Operation and maintenance work using AR technology for optical access networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: This paper describes operation and maintenance work for optical access networks in the present and future. We report a navigation system that employs augmented reality (AR) technology, and describe the future prospects for this work.

articleTitle: Strategic vision for KDDI's next generation packet optical transport network
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Layer 1 mesh network architecture is proposed as KDDI's next generation packet optical transport network. We suggest it has effects both on saving CAPEX by not only IP but also L2 offloading and on totally increasing survivability.

articleTitle: Efficient quadrature squeezing of QPSK signals by sideband-assisted dual-pump phase sensitive amplifier
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Sideband-enhanced parametric de-amplification enables efficient and various squeezing of QPSK signals. Phase sensitivity of approximately 25 dB is achieved at a nonlinear phase shift of only 0.8 rad for the wavelengths from 1545nm to 1565nm.

articleTitle: A novel direct-modulation envelope-detection Pol-Mux MIMO RoF system based on blind equalization techniques
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time a polarization-multiplexed multiple-input multiple-output radio-over-fiber system with direct-modulation and envelope-detection architectures. Based on blind equalization techniques, cross-channel interferences in both optical fiber and wireless channels are cancelled simultaneously without incurring additional overhead.

articleTitle: 40/100/400 Gb/s mixed line rate transmission performance in flexgrid optical networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: 40/100/400 Gb/s mixed line rate transmission performance is investigated for different spectrum allocation schemes in flexgrid optical networks. The results show that grouped and ungrouped allocation schemes have similar transmission performance with balanced launch power.

articleTitle: DWDM fiber-wireless access system with centralized optical frequency comb-based RF carrier generation
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate an optical wireless DWDM system at 60 GHz with optical incoherent heterodyne up-conversion using an optical frequency comb. Multiple users with wireline and wireless services are simultaneously supported.

articleTitle: Photonic microwave channelizer with improved channel characteristics based on spectrum-controlled stimulated Brillouin scattering
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A technique for microwave channelization using stimulated-Brillouin-scattering with well-controlled pumping-spectrum resulting in improved channel characteristics is proposed. A channelizer having a shape factor less than 2 with tunable channel bandwidth and channel spacing is demonstrated.

articleTitle: The Ge-on-Si integrated microphotonic platform
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: During the past twenty-five years hetero-epitaxial structures of germanium on silicon have played three essential roles: i) a tool for the study of interface coherency at lattice misfit interfaces; ii) a basis for strain-scaling of channel mobility in silicon transistors; and iii) a foundation for monolithic integration of active photonic devices in silicon microphotonics. Coherency and strained silicon employ Ge as a minority constituent in SiGe alloys, while Ge microphotonic devices are comprised of near 100% Ge. The three topics share a common learning curve that has had major impact on information technology.

articleTitle: Integration of optical fiber and optoelectronic devices
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: The paper reports on pursing a different, potentially complementary vision of all-fiber optoelectronics in which light can be generated, modulated, and detected within the fiber itself. Fiber devices are in general valued for their robustness, simplicity, and ability to integrate seamlessly with existing fiber infrastructure. If the light never leaves the fiber, for example, difficulties associated with modal and impedance mismatches between fibers and planar semiconductor waveguides do not need to be overcome. Fiber lasers also integrate naturally with fibers, whereas using direct gap semiconductor lasers on chip remains an ongoing challenge. Semiconductor fiber fabrication and adding optoelectronic function to fibers are also discussed.

articleTitle: Waveguide optics for novel in situ biomedical imaging
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Optical microscope-in-a-needle technology for 3D tissue micro-imaging will open up new avenues in diagnosis and treatment of disease. We describe innovations in guided-wave optical design for needle probes and demonstrate applications in tissues.

articleTitle: Enhanced performance of four-wave mixing wavelength conversion through dynamic control of optical phase
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate dynamic control of optical phase to enhance fiber-based four-wave mixing using gain-transparent stimulated Brillouin scattering. Quantitative measurement results are obtained for the control on wavelength conversion of 10 Gbit/s NRZ-OOK data.

articleTitle: Less than 0.5-dB gain excursion AGC-EDFA with a high speed FB/FF-controlled VOA for a wide operation range
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We have developed a digitally controlled AGC-EDFA by combining an FF-controlled pump-LD and a high-speed FB/FF-controlled VOA. We realized a gain excursion of less than 0.5 dB for a wide operation range.

articleTitle: 300-nm broadband chromium-doped fiber amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: The experimental breakthrough of net gain for optical signals in a chromium-doped fiber amplifier (CDFA) is demonstrated. This leads to the possibility of functioning as broadband amplifiers for utilizing the entire transmission bandwidths from 1300–1600 nm of low-loss windows of silica fibers for next-generation optical communication systems.

articleTitle: Full-range and rapid-tracking carrier phase and frequency estimator for 16-QAM coherent systems
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We present a carrier phase and frequency estimator for 16-QAM with frequency acquisition range of ±0.5 times the symbol rate, speed of 15 times faster than differential frequency estimation, and robustness in tracking time-varying frequency.

articleTitle: Integrated Silicon Photonic Laser Sources for Telecom and Datacom
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate record performance heterogeneously integrated telecom wavelength and datacom wavelength lasers, processed simultaneously on the same wafer. Tunable lasers for telecom applications and uncooled 2x8 WDM laser arrays for datacom applications are presented.

articleTitle: Pulse shaping by phase-modulated fiber gratings in transmission
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose a novel approach to pulse shaping using a phase-modulated fiber Bragg gratings (FBGs) in transmission. This enables the simplification of the device fabrication while retaining the substantial advantages of FBGs in transmission.

articleTitle: Wide-range, low-complexity frequency offset tracking technique for single carrier transmission systems
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose a wide-range, low-complexity frequency offset tracking algorithm for single carrier transmission systems. Its effectiveness is validated numerically and experimentally in a 112 Gb/s DP-QPSK system.

articleTitle: Asynchronous single-shot optical sampling of high-repetition-rate signals using temporal magnification
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate single-shot characterization of an ultrafast, high-repetition-rate pulse source using an asynchronously-pumped, time-lens-based temporal magnifier. Additionally, we show frequency compression that can be used for real-time high-speed RF spectral characterization.

articleTitle: Periodically poled silicon (PePSi) for efficient and electronically-tuned nonlinear optics in silicon
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Periodically poled silicon (PePSi) induces substantial 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup> order optical nonlinearity and at the same time achieves quasi-phase matching. PePSi is made by alternating strain gradients along the waveguide using periodic arrangement of stressed cladding layers.

articleTitle: Low-power, low-penalty, flip-chip integrated, 10Gb/s ring-based 1V CMOS photonics transmitter
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Modulation with 7.5dB transmitter penalty is demonstrated from a novel 1.5Vpp differential CMOS driver flip-chip integrated with a Si ring modulator, consuming 350fJ/bit from a single 1V supply at bit rates up to 10Gb/s.

articleTitle: Tunable two-stage self-coupled optical waveguide (SCOW) resonators
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate two-stage self-coupled optical waveguide (SCOW) resonators. Coupled-resonator-induced-transparency (CRIT) and high-order filtering features are observed. Resonance spectrum is tunable via a p-i-p thermal resistor or a p-i-n diode.

articleTitle: Link vs. opto-electronic device sleep mode approaches in survivable green optical networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Energy savings of link and OE device sleep mode approaches are compared in 1:1 protected optical networks, together with a hybrid solution combining both of them. The proposed hybrid solution can decrease network energy consumption by up to 82%.

articleTitle: On the energy and cost trade-off of different energy-aware network design strategies
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We compare different energy-aware network design strategies that adapt network resources utilization to traffic variations. We show how to achieve, without extra devices, up to 26% energy savings with respect to a 100Gb/s static network.

articleTitle: 200 Gb/s and dual-wavelength 400 Gb/s transmission over transpacific distance at 6 b/s/Hz spectral efficiency
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We transmit 106×200 Gb/s channels over 10,290 km at 6.0 b/s/Hz enabled by Nyquist spectral shaping and nonlinearity compensation. We also transmit 53×400 Gb/s channels over 9,200 km detecting two 200 Gb/s wavelengths simultaneously using a wideband receiver.

articleTitle: WDM transmission at 2µm over low-loss Hollow Core Photonic Bandgap Fiber
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: World's first demonstration of WDM transmission in a HC-PBGF at the predicted low loss region of 2µm is presented. A total capacity of 16 Gbit/s is achieved using 1×8.5 Gbit/s and 3×2.5 Gbit/s channels modulated using NRZ OOK over 290 meters of hollow core fiber.

articleTitle: Leaky modes in trench-assisted bend-insensitive MMFs
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: The impact of the leaky modes in trench-assisted MMFs on system performances is investigated through their contribution to the modal bandwidth and to the insertion loss.

articleTitle: Experimental investigation of the statistics of the interplay between nonlinear and PDL effects in polarization multiplexed systems
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Experimental studies of the combined nonlinear and PDL effects reveal that interplay between fiber nonlinearity and PDL changes the shape of the Q-distribution, which becomes narrower and asymmetric, depending on system parameters.

articleTitle: A 10 µs hybrid optical-circuit/electrical-packet network for datacenters
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We built and evaluated a hybrid electrical-packet/optical-circuit network for datacenters using a 10 μs optical circuit switch using wavelength-selective switches based on binary MEMs. This network has the potential to support large-scale, dynamic datacenter workloads.

articleTitle: Radio-over-fiber technologies for multi-Gb/s wireless applications
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We investigate the efficacy of simple RoF signal transmission techniques for multi-Gb/s wireless signal distribution at mm-wave frequencies. We employ simple digital signal processing techniques and experimentally demonstrate ultra high-capacity wireless data transmission at > 50 Gb/s.

articleTitle: Frequency stabilization of multiple semiconductor lasers for Nyquist-WDM transmission systems
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose a technique for stabilizing frequencies of multiple semiconductor lasers, which can reduce the fluctuation of the frequency spacing to below 3MHz. Using our scheme, we demonstrate 10-GBaud Nyquist-WDM PDM 16QAM transmission over 1,000km.

articleTitle: Fiber amplifiers for SDM systems
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Major advances made in both MCF and MMF amplification is presented here, including scaling up to 6 channels for MMF and up to 7 channels for MCF. EDFA and Raman based approaches and TDFA for PBGF are also demonstrated.

articleTitle: High-speed fading-free direct detection for double-sideband OFDM signal via block-wise phase switching
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We employ phase switching of either main-carrier or subcarriers of two consecutive signal blocks for double-sideband fading-free direct-detection (DD). In so doing, 40-Gb/s DD-OOFDM is successfully received over 80-km SSMF with single polarization and detector.

articleTitle: A miniaturized 43 Gbps EML TOSA employing impedance matched FPC connection
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A 43 Gbps electro-absorption modulator laser was packaged in a miniaturized module with a novel impedance matched flexible printed circuit connection aiming for a CFP2 transceiver showing ITU-T G.693 compliance.

articleTitle: An analysis of daily power consumption under different On-Off IP-over-WDM translucent design approaches
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We compared the energy efficiency of Multi-Layer Bypass and Direct-Bypass On-Off design under daily traffic variations in 100G and 40G networks. Housing power contribution limits the energy savings achievable by On-Off dynamics.

articleTitle: Real-time elastic coherent muxponder enabling energy-proportional optical transport
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We present the first prototype of a real-time bandwidth-variable coherent muxponder aggregating multiple 10GigE clients onto a symbol-rate-variable PDM-QPSK optical signal. This technology enables optical transport with power consumption linearly proportional to the actual requested traffic.

articleTitle: France Telecom's PON deployment, learnt lessons and next steps
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: This paper describes the current and future practices of France Telecom in delivering Fiber To The Home services.

articleTitle: A simple carrier-phase estimation technique for high-speed RSOA-based coherent WDM PON
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose a simple carrier phase estimation technique for the phase-modulated signal generated by using bandwidth-limited RSOA. By using this technique, we demonstrate 25.78-Gb/s QPSK upstream transmission in 60-km reach coherent RSOA-based WDM PON.

articleTitle: Pilot-assisted channel estimation methods for coherent receivers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We analyze time domain and frequency domain channel estimation methods with respect to their accuracy and implementation effort. We investigate the trade-off between training overhead, performance, and tolerance to distortions.

articleTitle: 40Gbit/s germanium waveguide photodiode
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: This paper reports on high speed Ge photodetectors integrated in Si waveguides which present very low dark current (25nA @-1V). 40Gbit/s operation under zero bias was reported at a wavelength of 1.55μm.

articleTitle: 320 Gb/s all-optical clock recovery and time demultiplexing enabled by a single Quantum Dash Mode-Locked Laser fabry-perot optical clock pulse generator
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We present the first 320Gb/s all-optical clock recovery by exploiting single Quantum Dash MLL to generate 40GHz synchronized optical clock pulse with 71fs timing jitter. 320Gb/s all-optical demultiplexing operation with 1dB BER penalty was demonstrated.

articleTitle: 10-Gb/s Polarization-Insensitive RSOA-based Self-Tuning transmitter for WDM-PON bridging up to 52 km
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: 10-Gb/s operation of a network-embedded self-tuning transmitter exploiting a high-PDG RSOA in a polarization preserving configuration based on two-Faraday rotators, is demonstrated bridging up to 52 km of NZD- fibre. The dispersive load tolerance is finally analysed.

articleTitle: Integrated optical beam steerers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Beam steering plays an important role in ultra-fast switching and scanning applications. This paper discusses the possibilities of the silicon photonics platform to fabricate integrated beam steerers using active phase tuning or wavelength tuning.

articleTitle: Fast wavelength switching of fully heater-tuned CSG-DR lasers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Dynamic wavelength switching properties of a fully heater-tuned CSG-DR laser are comprehensively studied. More than 1000 source-destination channel pairs are evaluated, 99 % of which exhibit switching time less than 1 msec.

articleTitle: High isolation in silicon waveguide optical isolator employing nonreciprocal phase shift
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A silicon nanowire waveguide optical isolator employing nonreciprocal phase shift is fabricated by directly bonding a magneto-optical garnet Ce:YIG. An optical isolation of 28 dB is obtained at a wavelength of 1552 nm.

articleTitle: Enhanced multicast performance for a 60-GHz Gigabit wireless service over optical access network based on 16-QAM-OFDM hierarchical modulation
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a 60-GHz ultra-high throughput (VHT) wireless over fiber multicast system. A novel 16-QAM-OFDM hierarchical modulation is implemented and 2.5-dB performance improvement is achieved comparing with conventional I-Q modulation.

articleTitle: Dynamic grouped routing optical networks for cost effective and agile wavelength services
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose a dynamic control algorithm for coarse granular optical routing networks that provide wavelength services. Numerical experiments elucidate its significant switch scale reduction at nodes while keeping fiber increment to marginal level.

articleTitle: First experimental demonstration of a 3-dimensional simplex modulation format showing improved OSNR performance compared to DP-BPSK
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a novel 3-dimensional modulation format with 1.2-dB OSNR tolerance improvement potential compared to DP-BPSK, as verified for the linear case. The non-linearity tolerance is evaluated in single-span transmission over 300km SSMF.

articleTitle: The role of anisotropy in few-mode optical fibers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We analyze beating and coupling within LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1,1</sub> manifold, caused by fiber anisotropy. Results suggest that spinning the fiber may reduce modal dispersion as for nondegenerate LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0,1</sub> modes of nonideal fibers.

articleTitle: Improving hardware protection switching in 10Gb/s symmetric Long Reach PONs
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We report results of PON protection switching tests based on analytical models and hardware implementation. We compare re-activation times of GPON and X-GPON. We also propose protocol extensions and improvements for 10Gb/s symmetric Long-Reach PON.

articleTitle: First demonstration of enhanced software defined networking (eSDN) over elastic grid (eGrid) optical networks for data center service migration
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time enhanced software defined networking (eSDN) over elastic grid (eGrid) optical networks for data center service migration, the performance of which are first verified on our testbed with real prototypes.

articleTitle: Large PMD tolerant 1.28 Tbit/s/ch transmission over 525 km with 640 Gbaud optical Nyquist pulses
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate a substantial increase in PMD tolerance in ultrahigh-speed single-carrier polarization-multiplexed transmission using optical Nyquist pulses. A low-penalty 1.28 Tbit/s/ch transmission was successfully achieved over 525 km with a 640 Gbaud optical Nyquist pulse.

articleTitle: Analysis of the SSMF zero-dispersion wavelength location and its influence on high capacity 1310 nm transmission
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Location of the zero-dispersion wavelength significantly affects the 1310 nm DWDM system capacity/range performance. Strategies based on the channel allocation management to overcome those limitations are proposed and evaluated.

articleTitle: Contention resolution strategy in optical burst switched datacenters
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose using burst assembly electronic buffers at source pod in optical burst switched datacenters for contention resolution. 100% throughput is approached with latency in the order of microseconds without any buffering in core switches.

articleTitle: High-throughput fiber links for computercom interconnects
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: With some high-performance computers now deploying >10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup> fibers per machine, next-generation systems must increase levels of optical integration and bandwidth-per-fiber, decrease component power and cost, and maintain manageable complexity by leveraging automation where possible.

articleTitle: Investigation of offset-launch characteristics for Two-Mode Optical Fiber using FE-BPM
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We report mode launch characteristics for Two-Mode Optical Fiber (TMF) under offset-launch condition. We confirmed that the power ratio of each mode for TMF under offset-launch condition can be evaluated by using FE-BPM.

articleTitle: Wavelength preserving optical serial-to-parallel conversion
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate optical wavelength preserving serial-to-parallel conversion. 9-of-16 OTDM channels are simultaneously mapped from a 160 Gbit/s signal to a 100 GHz WDM grid by wavelength preserving FWM idler generation, with BER<1E-9 performance.

articleTitle: Phase-modulated radio-over-fiber systems
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We present an overview of phase-modulated RoF systems and review methods for downconversion based on phase-modulation. We describe a technique for phase-sensitive detection and demonstrate downconversion and I/Q channelization of a 64-QAM microwave signal.

articleTitle: Software-defined transport network for cloud computing
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Core networks need to convey distinct DC-to-DC traffic for cloud computing. To meet this requirement, software defined optical transport network is introduced with intelligent and open control plane and flexible data plane.

articleTitle: Optical multicasting of a 224Gb/s PM-16QAM signal in a periodically-poled Lithium Niobate waveguide
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Polarization independent multicasting is demonstrated in a PPLN. 3-fold and 2-fold wavelength conversion of a 112Gb/s 16QAM and a 224Gb/s PM-16QAM signal respectively, is experimentally achieved with penalties within 2.9dB at BER=10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>.

articleTitle: Theoretical study of crosstalk characteristics for multi-core optical fiber amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We show, for the first time, simple formulas that describe the crosstalk characteristics of a multi-core optical fiber amplifier. The influences of the gain difference and the fan-in/out devices on the crosstalk measurement are discussed.

articleTitle: 100GHz grid-aligned reconfigurable polarization insensitive black-box wavelength converter
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A new scheme for a flexible modulation-, bit rate- independent, reconfigurable and polarization insensitive wavelength converter based on FWM in a highly nonlinear fiber is demonstrated and characterized with 10Gbaud 16 QAM signals.

articleTitle: Pass-drop operations of 4×172Gb/s Nyquist OTDM-WDM over cascade of WSSs using distributed matched filtering
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a method of distributed matched filtering to satisfy ISI-free criterion for Nyquist OTDM-WDM pass-drop operations over cascaded WSSs. Spectrally packed 4×172Gb/s OTDM-WDM channels are successively dropped by WSSs at BER < 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−9</sup>.

articleTitle: Optoelectronic components for higher order modulation formats
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Optical modulators and receivers in various material systems for higher-order modulation formats were discussed. LN-based modulators are useful for high-end LH systems. InP/Si-based modulators show applicability to advanced modulation formats. Powerful DSP will push InP/Si-based modulators into fields from Metro/SR applications. Many approaches in digital coherent receivers are being taken in the direction of size reduction. High-level integration with total optimization based on various aspects is being required. Monolithic/hybrid, optics and electronics performance, transmission reach/application, size, assembling cost, and power consumption etc.

articleTitle: Energy-efficient OFDMA-PON exploiting modular OLT/ONU digital signal processing
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose and evaluate a novel system design and MAC framework for OFDMA-PONs leveraging modular DSP which offers significant power savings for the ONU and the OLT while providing controllable trade-off with packet delay.

articleTitle: Quantum dash mode-locked laser based open-loop optical clock recovery for 160 Gb/s transmission system
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We report first demonstration of quantum dash mode-locked laser based open-loop optical clock recovery of 160 Gb/s RZ-OOK after 52 km transmission with 102 fs timing jitter 40 GHz clock and 2 dB BER penalty.

articleTitle: Advanced modulation formats for free-space laser communication
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We show that novel modulation formats enabled by digital coherent receivers can significantly reduce the required received optical power in Free Space Optical (FSO) systems, thereby enabling links with significantly lower Size, Weight, and Power (SWaP).

articleTitle: 100 Gb/s optical IM-DD transmission with 10G-class devices enabled by 65 GSamples/s CMOS DAC core
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: 100 Gb/s optical IM-DD transmission over 10 km SMF is experimentally demonstrated by using discrete multi-tone and CMOS DAC core. The limiting factors towards further reach extension are investigated.

articleTitle: Analytical investigation of operating conditions for simultaneous intensity and phase noise suppression using phase sensitive semiconductor optical amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We analytically investigate the possibility of simultaneously suppressing intensity and phase noise during phase sensitive amplification using four-wave mixing in a semiconductor optical amplifier. The results show a significant improvement in the error vector magnitude.

articleTitle: A small cell augmentation to a wireless network leveraging fiber-to-the-node access infrastructure for backhaul and power
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We describe an efficient fiber backhaul strategy for a small-cell network, which leverages facilities associated with an existing fiber-to-the node (FTTN) residential access network. Related optimization studies are also described.

articleTitle: Measurements-based power control - A cross-layered framework
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Despite the emergence of dynamic optical devices, operational networks are still mostly static. To enable future dynamic operation, we present a cross-layered optimization framework that adapts the wavelengths' power levels based on real-time OPM measurements.

articleTitle: Efficient nonlinear compensator for coherent OFDM based on Volterra Series Transfer Function (VSTF) factorization
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A novel decision-feedback based nonlinear compensator (NLC) for coherent optical OFDM receivers, based on a VSTF factorization, applicable to multi-span fiber links is ~20x more computationally efficient than conventional complexity-constrained Split-Step-Fourier NLC.

articleTitle: Silicon-organic hybrid (SOH) modulator generating up to 84 Gbit/s BPSK and M-ASK signals
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We report on high-speed multilevel signal generation with silicon-organic hybrid Mach-Zehnder modulators. Pure phase modulation exploiting the linear electro-optic effect allows to generate 28 GBd BPSK, 4-ASK and 8-ASK signals up to 84 Gbit/s.

articleTitle: All-optical phase noise suppression using optical nonlinear mixing combined with tunable optical delays
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose and demonstrate an all-optical scheme of phase noise reduction using optical nonlinearity and dispersion/conversion delay. This scheme is capable of reducing the standard deviation of phase noise with low frequency component (e.g., laser phase noise) by a factor of ~ 4 without degrading the data signal. The EVM can be reduced from 31% to 11% for ~500 MHz phase noise bandwidth on 20-Gbaud QPSK input.

articleTitle: Demonstration of 40-Gb/s QPSK upstream transmission in long-reach RSOA-based coherent WDM PON using offset PDM technique
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate the 40-Gb/s QPSK upstream transmission in 60-km reach WDM PON (channel spacing: 50 GHz) implemented by using directly modulated RSOAs and self-homodyne receivers together with the offset PDM technique.

articleTitle: Integration of silicon photonics into DRAM process
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We present an electro-photonic circuit integrated into a 65-nm DRAM periphery process. Its photonic circuit features 2-dB/mm waveguide, 7-dB grating coupler, 10-Gb/s modulator, and 5-Gb/s Ge photodiode.

articleTitle: First endless optical polarization and phase tracker
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We report the first automatic endless polarization tracker that not only transforms variable input into fixed output polarization but also controls the phase shift between this polarization and its orthogonal, all at 20-krad/s scrambling speed.

articleTitle: Enhancing data rates in graded-index multimode fibers with offset coupling and multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Offset coupling and DSP based multiplexing techniques are evaluated on silica and plastic multimode fibers of various lengths and operating wavelengths. We demonstrate a 10-28× boost in bandwidth-length product with excellent tolerance to fiber misalignments.

articleTitle: Fundamental study on new characterization method for crosstalk property of multi-core fibers using long wavelength probe signals
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We investigate the feasibility of new characterization method of crosstalk properties of multi-core fibers using long wavelength probe signals. Sensitivity of the measurement was found to be improved in most combination of input/output cores.

articleTitle: Higher-order multilevel signal transmission using coherent receiver with digital-delay detection
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: The use of digital-delay detection for coherently received higher-order QAM signals is an attractive technique to improve phase noise and IF offset tolerance. The paper reviews its concept, implementation and performance improvement with experimental results.

articleTitle: Demonstration of broadband inter-modal four-wave mixing in graded-index few-mode fibers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate broadband four-wave mixing (FWM) between two spatial modes of a 5-km-long few-mode fiber. We show that, in contrast to FWM in single-mode fibers, inter-modal FWM (IM-FWM) can be better phase matched for waves well separated in frequency (a few THz) than when they are closely spaced (tens of GHz).

articleTitle: Integration of planning and control plane in packet optical multilayer network
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: An integrated solution relying on a centralized management and a distributed control plane is presented for packet optical networks. Simulations results, based on realistic network, traffic and node modeling, show up to 42% CapEx saving.

articleTitle: Thermal management in hybrid silicon lasers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We review thermal management challenges in hybrid silicon lasers. Several technologies are discussed and experimentally verified to reduce device thermal impedance.

articleTitle: Optical waveguides and photodiodes in 0.18µm CMOS SOI with no post-processing
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate the first optical waveguide and fastest photodiode implemented in a commercial CMOS technology without performing any post-processing. The measured waveguide loss at 1.55μm is 37dB/cm and bandwidth of photodiode exceeds 9.2GHz at 850nm.

articleTitle: 26.75 Gb/s short-reach transmission over up to 15 m of large-core PMMA polymer optical fiber for next-generation 100 GbE
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time 26.75 Gb/s transmission over up to 15 m of large-core Ø 500 μm PMMA POF. Simple NRZ modulation is used which reduces complexity, power consumption and latency of the system. In combination with a POF ribbon cable this approach is a promising and robust alternative to high-speed 100 Gb/s copper interconnects for data center applications (4 channels with 25 Gb/s each).

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of a new pilot tone generation method
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a line encoding based pilot tone generation method and compare it to conventional schemes. The proposed method leaves intact the high speed signal quality and can be used with standard optical transceivers.

articleTitle: Inter channel crosstalk impairment of WDM-PON long reach application with large differential path loss
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Inter-channel crosstalk limit is studied for the WDM-PON application with large differential path loss. A method to overcome the limit is also proposed by controlling ONT transmit power based on received signal power.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of adaptive frequency-domain equalization for mode-division multiplexed transmission
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate adaptive frequency-domain equalization with low algorithmic complexity for a 6×6 coherent MIMO transmission system in a few-mode fiber. Master-slave carrier recovery is also proposed and demonstrated for further reduction of algorithmic complexity.

articleTitle: Terabit+ (192 × 10 Gb/s) Nyquist shaped UDWDM coherent PON with upstream and downstream over a 12.8 nm band
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a bi-directional Terabit+ UDWDM coherent PON with Nyquist shaped 16QAM modulation, offering up to 10 Gb/s service capabilities per user/wavelength in a total spectrum of 12.8 nm over 40 km of SSMF.

articleTitle: Digitally tunable optical power equalization for large port count optical switches
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A digitally tunable optical power control loop with dynamic range >25dB is designed to compensate losses in large port count multi-stage switch fabrics. At 10 Gb/s with 7.7dBm of input power, the BER is 6.95×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-12</sup>.

articleTitle: Experimental study of intra- vs. inter-superchannel spectral equalization in flexible grid systems
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Benefits of intra-superchannel spectral-equalization are demonstrated in a production 8Tbps system. ~1.2dB OSNR improvement and ~4.5dB reduction in power-spread is measured relative to inter-superchannel equalization. Tradeoff between OSNR and nonlinearity dictates the net reach improvement.

articleTitle: A 50Tbps optically-cabled Infiniband datacenter switch
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We present a commercial 50Tbps Infiniband packet switch with 648 ports running 40Gbps per port enabled by 12-channel full-duplex active optical cables with 10Gbps per channel per direction of optical I/O.

articleTitle: Towards 400GBASE 4-lane solution using direct detection of MultiCAP signal in 14 GHz bandwidth per lane
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We report on an experimental demonstration of 102 Gbit/s transmission over a 15km single wavelength and polarization fiber link with 14GHz 3dB bandwidth. Novel multi-band CAP signaling allows for a 4-lane 400GBASE long reach solution.

articleTitle: The role of optical interconnections in data-center architecture evolution
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: The new, “cloud” era, DC architectures require more optical interconnections, in systems with higher port density, and networks with more flexibility, in order to unlock stranded capacity, and thus lower overall cost.

articleTitle: Support statistical sharing in circuit switching WDM Optical networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We present a new optical networking paradigm in which statistical sharing is natively supported at the spectrum level. The proposed capacity approximation model enables well-balanced capacity requirement estimation and fine-tuning of statistical network capacity gain.

articleTitle: Spectral management in flexible multiwavelength PONs
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: In this paper we address scenarios of coexistence between NGPON2 and legacy technologies. Different PON dimensioning paths to be potentially followed are presented based on the enabled wavelength flexibility brought in by NGPON2.

articleTitle: Software-defined packet optical transport networks offering multiple services
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A software-defined transport network architecture with OpenFlow-enabled MPLS switches is proposed for metro networks. The results of preliminary numerical study show how the proposed architecture improves the cost-efficiency and simplicity of transport networks.

articleTitle: Suppression of radio over fiber system nonlinearity using a semiconductor optical amplifier and mixed polarization
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose and investigate the suppression of RoF nonlinearity using a semiconductor optical amplifier combined with simplified mixed polarization. It is found that EVM of OFDM UWB can be improved by up to 10.2dB.

articleTitle: Integrated packet/circuit hybrid network field-trial
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We report the first field-trial of an integrated packet/circuit hybrid optical network. Bypassing routers with circuit quality of service and network throughput of 99% is demonstrated on a shared packet/circuit layer lightpath.

articleTitle: Path Computation Elements (PCE): Applications and status
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: This paper provides an overview of Path Computation Elements in optical networks, highlighting the motivations behind their adoption, common deployment models, and new trends such its use as stateful entities in software defined networks.

articleTitle: PDL compensation using whitening matrix in polarization division multiplexed coherent optical transmission
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A novel noise whitening method for compensating the performance loss due to spatially-colored noise in the presence of polarization-dependent impairments is proposed. The proposed algorithm is general for all single carrier, WDM, and OFDM systems.

articleTitle: Fault location in passive optical networks using T-OTDR and wavelength-selective isolators
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We present a new method for fault location in passive optical networks by employing a tunable OTDR and wavelength-selective isolators in the remote node. A proof-of-principle experiment is performed, demonstrating the feasibility of the technique.

articleTitle: Nonlinear transmission of 6PolSK-QPSK signals using coded modulation and digital back propagation
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We experimentally investigate the characteristics of 126-Gb/s coded 6PolSK-QPSK signals in the nonlinear transmission regime and demonstrate that required OSNR improvement is increasing with fiber-launch power due to coded modulation as well as digital back propagation.

articleTitle: Terabit optical OFDM demultiplexer in silicon photonics
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: The design, implementation in silicon photonics and characterization of a demultiplexer for an OFDM signal using generalized MZIs are presented. The filter performs the DFT operation to demultiplex a 1.2 Tbps OFDM super-channel.

articleTitle: Elastic and green optical access based upon coherent interleaved frequency division multiple access (IFDMA)
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We present a novel bandwidth-elastic and power-efficient coherent NG-PON based on coherent interleaved frequency division multiple access (IFDMA) and experimentally demonstrate the 2xONUs uplink transmission, exhibiting capabilities of the elastic bandwidth provisioning and CFO compensation.

articleTitle: Fabrication of the first high-speed GaAs IQ electro-optic modulator arrays and applicability study for low-cost Tb/s direct-detection optical OFDM networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We present fabrication of the first GaAs electro-optic IQ modulator arrays for high capacity optical transport. Modulators demonstrate >35 GHz bandwidth with 3V Vp. The applicability study reveals suitability for 440Gb/s OOFDM over 1000 km.

articleTitle: Integrated on-chip optical links using photonic-crystal lasers and photodetectors with current blocking trenches
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate on-chip optical interconnects consisting of integrated photonic crystal (PhC) lasers and photodetectors. Current-blocking trenches effectively reduce the leakage current in the two-dimensional PhC slab, resulting in ultralow operating energy of 17.3 fJ/bit.

articleTitle: Progress in polymer-based components for next-generation PON applications
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Polymer components for next-generation WDM PON are presented, incl. 8ch OLT-Tx and OLT-Rx devices using polymer AWGs and InP-based DFB laser and photo diode arrays together with a 40nm wide tunable InP/polymer Bragg grating laser for realizing colorless ONUs.

articleTitle: Indoor optical wireless Gbps link dimensioning
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: The dimensioning of indoor distributed optical wireless Gbps links is reported, respecting the eye-safety rules and involving standard optoelectronic components. The links performance are defined and estimated as a function of geometrical and signal parameters.

articleTitle: Operator perspective on next-generation optical access for high-speed mobile backhaul
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Deep-penetrated optical access using advanced photonic technologies will play an important role in the construction of multiple services platforms that can provide not only future small-cell based wireless services beyond 4G, but also M2M towards a big-data society.

articleTitle: 100 nm-bandwidth positive-efficiency wavelength conversion for m-PSK and m-QAM signals in QD-SOA
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We show wavelength-conversion over 100 nm-span in full S- and C-band with positive conversion-efficiency by low-power double-pump Four-Wave-Mixing in a QD-SOA. We demonstrate full format transparency in C-band using QPSK, 8-PSK and 16-QAM coherent signals.

articleTitle: 32-bit/s/Hz spectral efficiency WDM transmission over 177-km few-mode fiber
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We transmit 32 WDM channels over 12 spatial and polarization modes of 177 km few-mode fiber at a record spectral efficiency of 32 bit/s/Hz. The transmitted signals are strongly coupled and recovered using 12×12 multiple-input multiple-output digital signal processing.

articleTitle: Low complexity FDM/FDMA approach for future PON
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: FDMA PON allows the ONU complexity and cost to be tailored to the service level targeted per customer while achieving high per wavelength throughput (35-39Gbps downlink). Initial progress towards an all Silicon ONU is presented.

articleTitle: Overhead-free channel estimation using implicit training for polarization-multiplexed coherent optical systems
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Implicit training is successfully demonstrated for the first time in a 40-Gb/s QPSK experiment and 224-Gb/s 16-QAM simulation. Overhead-free transmission can be achieved with less than 0.5 dB Q-penalty compared to traditional explicit training scheme.

articleTitle: Grooming Index for OTN/WDM networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We present a new concept “Grooming Index” for judging the aptitude of OTN/WDM solution for any given network conditions. The index is easy to calculate and provide reliable estimation of cost reduction from OTN grooming.

articleTitle: ODN intelligence - Automating fiber deployment and operations
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: ODN intelligence enabled by electronic identification of each ODN component has opened a new era of FTTx passive facilities management. Intelligent ODN systems, by automating fiber routing and service provisioning, reduce total cost of ownership of FTTx networks.

articleTitle: GPU-based parallelization of system modeling
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Simulation of fiber-optic transmission systems using general purpose-computing on graphics processing units is investigated. It is shown that a speedup factor of more than 100 can be achieved compared to CPUs without loss in accuracy.

articleTitle: Large-capacity transmission over a 19-core fiber
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We discuss the recent progress of space division multiplexed transmission using a 19-core fiber. We find that high core-number multi-core fibers can both enable large transmission capacity and potentially reduce system costs and power consumption.

articleTitle: Space-division multiplexing of coherent beams by diffractive optical elements
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Capabilities and limitations of diffractive optics in mode division multiplexing for optical communications are investigated theoretically and experimentally. Computer generated multichannel matched optical spatial filters provided low cross-talks in de-multiplexing of several Laguerre-Gaussian modes.

articleTitle: A single-channel, 1.6 Tbit/s 32 QAM coherent pulse transmission over 150 km with RZ-CW conversion and FDE techniques
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A 1.6 Tbit/s/ch single-carrier transmission of 32 QAM coherent pulses over 150 km was demonstrated using an RZ-CW conversion technique and frequency-domain equalization (FDE). A large improvement in the bit-error-rate characteristics was achieved with FDE.

articleTitle: New analytical method to compute availability non-compliance risks for lambda services
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We derive a new analytical method to compute the SLA non-compliance risk for lambda services with availability guarantees, which applies to fiber links with arbitrary time-to-repair distributions. The results are validated through discrete-event simulations.

articleTitle: Multi-flow virtual concatenation triggered by path cascading degree in flexible spectrum optical networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We present a multi-flow virtual concatenation model in flexible spectrum networks. A split-multi-flow RSA algorithm (SMF) triggered by path cascading degree is proposed based on the model. Simulation results show SMF can get better performance.

articleTitle: Situation-aware multipath routing and wavelength reassignment in a unified packet-circuit OpenFlow network
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate multipath routing and wavelength re-assignment in OpenFlow-enabled packet-circuit network, aware of links' bandwidth utilization, applications' protocol, and quality of transmission. Applications are re-routed under traffic congestion and wavelengths are re-assigned under physical impairments.

articleTitle: Multi-modulus blind equalizations for coherent spectrum shaped polmux quadrature duobinary signal processing
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A novel DSP scheme for spectrum shaped polarization-multiplexed quadrature duobinary signal based on multi-modulus blind equalizations is proposed and demonstrated with simulation and experimental results on 25GHz Nyquist-WDM channels with 112Gb/s PM-QPSK and SE >4bit/s/Hz.

articleTitle: Uncooled (0 to 85°C) and full C-band operation of a 10.7 Gbit/s InP Mach-Zehnder modulator monolithically integrated with SOA
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Uncooled InP-Mach-Zehnder modulator monolithically integrated with SOA was demonstrated for 10.7 Gbit/s 1600 ps/nm transmission at C-band wavelengths. Output power was obtained over +3.2 dBm at 0-85°C with +2 dBm optical input by using SOA.

articleTitle: Measuring the spectra of advanced optical signals with an extension of an electrical network analyzer
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A new cost saving and convenient method, that extends the functionality of an electrical network analyzer (ENA) towards high resolution optical spectroscopy is presented.

articleTitle: Integrated thermal stabilization of a microring modulator
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: An integrated silicon photodiode and heater are used to thermally stabilize a microring modulator, interfacing with external feedback circuitry to provide error-free microring modulator operation under thermal fluctuations that would normally render it inoperable.

articleTitle: 22-Gbit/s × 16-ch WDM receiver based on a Si-Ge-silica monolithic photonic platform and its application to 40-km transmission
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We developed a 22-Gbit/s × 16-ch WDM receiver based on a Si-Ge-silica monolithic photonic integration technology, in which a 16-ch SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf> AWG with 1.6-nm channel separation and Ge photodiodes are monolithically integrated. The AWG-PD device exhibited fiber-to-PD resoponsivity of 0.29 A/W and inter-channel crosstalk of less than 20 dB, and successfully received 22 Gbit/s signal for all 16 channels. In addition, we demonstrated 40-km transmission of 12.5 Gbit/s signal and obtained sensitivity of −6.8 dBm at BER of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−9</sup> without transimpedance amplifiers.

articleTitle: 10.5 Gbit/s 8-PSK signal generated by directly modulating RSOA with instantaneous injection/depletion currents
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose a novel technique that can compensate patterning effect by optimizing the modulation current of RSOAs, and successfully demonstrate 10.5-Gbit/s 8-PSK signal generation by directly-modulated RSOA having modulation bandwidth of only 0.9-GHz.

articleTitle: Multipulse vector solitons with precessing states of polarization
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate experimentally new families of vector solitons with the precessing states of polarization for multipulse soliton operations in a carbon nanotube mode-locked fiber laser with anomalous dispersion laser cavity.

articleTitle: Optical link planning guidelines for a hybrid packet and circuit integrated network
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate OSNR requirements below 13dB and system margin above 5dB for a 2-node 100Gb/s hybrid optical packet and circuit network prototype, which can be used for planning further network extension and field deployment.

articleTitle: New opportunities for optical phase-locked loops in coherent photonics
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: New efforts demonstrate that integrated optical phase-locked loops can provide stable and robust phase locking. Coherent receivers now use DSP processing for long haul communications. However, given a low-cost, low-power coherent receiver, uses in shorter links become viable, and other approaches for removing impairments can be explored.

articleTitle: 5-Gb/s broadcast overlay for WDM-PON employing noise-suppressed mutually injected Fabry-Perot laser diodes
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
