abstract: We propose and demonstrate 5-Gb/s broadcast transmission in WDM-PON using cost-effective mutually injected F-P LDs. A transmission speed can be doubled by eliminating a fundamental noise peak by 28 dB with interferometric noise suppression technique.

articleTitle: DQPSK/QPSK modulation at 40–60 Gb/s using low-loss nested silicon Mach-Zehnder modulator
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: 44.6-Gb/s DQPSK and 50-to-64 Gb/s QPSK modulation are demonstrated using low-loss nested Silicon MZ modulator with fiber-to-fiber loss of 10dB. Dispersion tolerance of +/-80 ps/nm is observed in the DQPSK transmission.

articleTitle: CMOS-compatible athermal tunable silicon optical lattice filters
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We present a CMOS-compatible temperature-independent tunable silicon lattice filter composed of 10 cascaded 2×2 asymmetric Mach-Zehnder interferometers. Experiments show the device has a wide wavelength tuning range and low temperature sensitivity of ~6.2 pm/°C.

articleTitle: Activities, drivers and benefits of extending PON over other media
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: This paper reviews the latest effort of extending PON over other media. After looking at standards progress in ITU-T and BBF, we explore possible interworking solutions for the hybrid access.

articleTitle: Bi-directional ultra-dense polarization-diverse OFDM/WDM PON with laserless colorless 1Gb/s ONUs based on Si PICs and <417 MHz mixed-signal ICs
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We introduce a next-gen OFDM/WDM spectral architecture symmetrically serving 40G/40G to 4 ODNs (4×64 users) per 4×12.5 GHz dense λ -s, with low-cost energy-efficient self-coherent photonic-integrated ONUs with down/up 16-QAM OFDM polarization diversity.

articleTitle: Optical modulation format recognition in stokes space for digital coherent receivers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We report on a novel method for optical modulation format recognition based on Stokes parameters and variational expectation maximization algorithm. Discrimination among six different pol-muxed coherent modulation formats is successfully demonstrated in simulation and experiment.

articleTitle: Fractionally-spaced frequency domain linear crosstalk cancellation with spectral alignment techniques for coherent superchannel optical systems
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A computationally efficient frequency domain implementation of a fractionally-spaced equalizer with inter-channel spectral alignment is proposed for inter-channel-crosstalk cancellation. The algorithm is an essential component of crosstalk cancellation and reduces the complexity without sacrificing performance.

articleTitle: High-speed all-optical NOT gate based on spectral phase-only linear optical filtering
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose and analyze a novel concept for all-optical NOT gate (AONG) for high-speed telecommunication on-off-keying data signals based on spectral phase-only linear optical filtering, with applicability for speeds above 160Gb/s. Proof-of-concept experiments are reported to validate the proposed AONG working principle.

articleTitle: Stable clock recovery and channel identification in OTDM realized by in-band clock distribution based on pulse position modulation
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrated 344-Gb/s OOK OTDM transmissions over 3-km SMF fiber using a new scheme based on pulse position modulation in OTDM transmissions to achieve stable clock recovery and channel identification through in-band clock distribution.

articleTitle: A collinear nondegenerate source of entangled photon pairs in PM fiber
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate a source of entangled photon pairs based on standard polarization-maintaining fiber in a novel architecture. Sections of fibre are spliced together with perpendicular polarization axes, allowing single-path entanglement generation.

articleTitle: Ultra-compact CMOS compatible TE-pass polarizer for silicon photonics
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: An ultra-compact broadband TE-pass polarizer was demonstrated on SOI platform using horizontal nanoplasmonic slot waveguide. With 1μm device length, we achieved greater than 15dB polarization extinction ratio over 80nm bandwidth. The insertion loss was ~2dB.

articleTitle: Over bandwidth OC-192 NRZ modulation of TO-can weak-resonant-cavity Fabry-Perot laser diode for DWDM-PON
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A beyond bandwidth modulated weak-resonant-cavity FPLD with TO-56-can package is demonstrated for OC-192 DWDM-PON transmission with its receiving sensitivity at BER=10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup> improving to -16 dBm by attenuating the coherently injection-locked power to -12 dBm.

articleTitle: Optimized brownfield deployment of 100-GbE over metro networks using 4×25G and 10×10G optical CFP interfaces
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose a novel wavelength assignment method for single-channel services in metropolitan networks that optimizes the spectrum to accommodate 100Gb/s Ethernet signals using multi-channel transceivers of limited wavelength-tuning properties.

articleTitle: Simultaneous multichannel transmission of intensity- and phase-modulated signals based on optical phase conjugation using a quantum-dot SOA
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We report the first demonstration of optical phase conjugation using a quantum-dot semiconductor optical amplifier. The 100-km transmission performances of the multiplexed 10-Gb/s intensity- and phase-modulated signals are investigated for different channel alignments.

articleTitle: An LD-based ultra-low phase noise opll circuit using an optical voltage controlled oscillator
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We report a highly precise OPLL circuit employing an optical voltage controlled oscillator and a frequency-stabilized, narrow linewidth LD. An extended OPLL bandwidth of 4 MHz enabled a phase noise as low as 0.6 degrees.

articleTitle: High-order photonic differentiator using on-chip cascaded Mach-Zehnder interferometers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate a high-order photonic differentiator using on-chip CMOS-compatible Mach-Zehnder interferometers, including first-, second-, and third-order differentiators. For Gaussian optical pulse injection, the average deviations of all differentiators are less than 6.5%.

articleTitle: 112-Gb/s DP-QPSK transmission over 7,860-km DMF using phase-conjugated copy and digital phase-sensitive boosting with enhanced noise and nonlinearity tolerance
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate a phase-sensitive boosting technique for extending the reach of 112-Gb/s DP-QPSK. We transmit the signal alongside a phase-conjugated idler. Nonlinearity is partially mitigated by detecting them jointly and summing them with phase conjugation.

articleTitle: Polymer-based vertically optical splitter with 20-Gbps transmission rate realized on silicon substrate
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A polymer waveguide combined with three silicon 45° micro-reflectors is realized on a silicon substrate to form a 1 × 2 vertically optical splitter with a 20-Gbps transmission rate for on-chip optical interconnect application.

articleTitle: High-accuracy, sub-μs wavelength switching with thermal drift suppression in tunable distributed amplification (TDA-) DFB laser array
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We successfully demonstrate sub-μs wavelength switching based on current tuning with a frequency deviation of 1 GHz achieved by the large suppression of thermal frequency drift in a narrow interval tunable distributed amplification (TDA-) DFB laser array.

articleTitle: 20-Gbps WDM-PON transmissions employing weak-resonant-cavity FPLD with OFDM and SC-FDE modulation formats
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a superior performance of 20-Gbps OFDM/SC-FDE transmission over 20-km WDM-PONs, using a channelized weak-resonant-cavity FPLD with a modulation bandwidth of only 1.25 GHz by using injection-locking, direct detection and adopting the power-loading algorithm.

articleTitle: 146λ×6×19-Gbaud wavelength- and mode-division multiplexed transmission over 10×50-km spans of few-mode fiber with a gain-equalized few-mode EDFA
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate wavelength- and mode-division multiplexed transmission over a fiber re-circulating loop comprising 50-km of low-DMGD few-mode fiber, and an optimized few-mode EDFA with a flat gain spectrum and low mode-dependent gain.

articleTitle: Distributed Brillouin sensing with sub-meter spatial resolution based on four-section pulse
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A novel four-section pulse based Brillouin distributed fiber sensor with sub-meter spatial resolution is proposed. This simple technique can mitigate the secondary “echo” directly without extra measurement time and post-processing algorithm.

articleTitle: High sensitivity micro Sagnac loop interferometer based on tightly twisted micro fiber tapers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate high-sensitivity micro Sagnac loop interferometer by twisting microtapered fiber. The extinction ratio can be above 24.04dB and beating phenomena can be produced due to excitation of high-order modes when tapered-fiber is tightly twisted.

articleTitle: Wavelength conversion bandwidth enhancement through quasi-phase-matching in a width modulated silicon waveguide
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Width-modulated silicon waveguide is investigated as a means of quasi-phase-matching to enhance the bandwidth of wavelength conversion based on four-wave-mixing. A conversion bandwidth enhancement of ~40% is achievable in a 5mm sinusoidally modulated SOI waveguide.

articleTitle: Chromatic dispersion compensated 25Gb/s multimode VCSEL transmission around 850nm with a MMF jumper
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A special multimode fiber jumper was designed to provide desired DMD characteristics for a multimode fiber link for chromatic dispersion compensation. 25 Gb/s VCSEL transmission experiment was conducted. Performance benefit of CD compensation was observed.

articleTitle: Transverse Anderson localization in a glass optical fiber with random air-holes
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We report on the first observation of transverse Anderson localization in a glass optical fiber. Non-uniform distribution of the random air-holes across the fiber profile results in non-uniformity of the localization behavior.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a novel III–V-on-Si distributed feedback laser
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We present the first experimental demonstration of a novel III-V-on-silicon distributed feedback laser type. All structures defining the laser cavity are defined in the silicon. Alasing threshold of 50mA and a side mode suppression ratio higher than 40 dB is achieved.

articleTitle: Towards athermal nanoplasmonic resonators based on Cu-Tio2-Si hybrid plasmonic waveguide
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Owing to the negative thermo-optic coefficient (TOC) of titanium dioxide, the real effective modal index of Cu-TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-Si hybrid plasmonic waveguides can be potentially temperature independent. High-performance Cu-TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-Si waveguide-ring resonators (WRRs) are experimentally demonstrated on SOI platform using standard CMOS technology. TOC of the group index is measured to be ~1.09×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup> K<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> for a WRR with 220-nm-high Si core and 58-nm-thick TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. TOC of the as-deposited TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> is estimated to ~ -1.0×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup> K<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>.

articleTitle: Manufacturing tolerance analysis of an InP, 4x4 MMI-based 90° optical hybrid for integrated coherent receivers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A manufacturing tolerance analysis of a 4×4-MMI working as a 90° optical hybrid is performed, both at the physical and system level. The relationship between well-known figures of merit with system penalty is also explored.

articleTitle: Employing a single DPLL for joint carrier phase estimation in few-mode fiber transmission
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: To reduce DSP complexity, both a master/slave and phase-averaged single digital PLL are investigated for a 3×112Gbit/s DP-QPSK transmission over 70km FMF with inline MM-EDFA. A 0.5dB OSNR gain at 3.8×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> FEC-limit is experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Carrier-induced silicon waveguide Bragg grating filter based on ion implantation
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A carrier-induced silicon-waveguide Bragg-grating filter with a pin junction is demonstrated. The bandwidth and the extinction ratio of the filter are 0.3nm and 14dB, respectively. It can be tuned by both forward and reverse biases.

articleTitle: High capacity field trials of 40.5 Tb/s for LH distance of 1,822 km and 54.2 Tb/s for regional distance of 634 km
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: 40.5 Tb/s over 1,822 km and 54.2 Tb/s over 634 km field SSMF was realized using 41 Nyquist rate DP-8QAM and DP-16QAM superchannels. They are the highest field capacities for long-haul and regional distances achieved so far.

articleTitle: Coherent detection of a 32-point 6PolSK-QPSK modulation format
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We report a new 4-dimensional (4D) 6PolSK-QPSK modulation format which carries 32 constellation points and 5 bits per symbol. It can be used as an alternative to PM-QPSK and PM-8QAM in a flexible-rate coherent modem.

articleTitle: Tutorial: Real-time digital signal processing for future optical access networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Presents a collection of slides covering the following topics: real-time digital signal processing; optical access network; optical transceiver; DAC; ADC; DSP; and OOFDM.

articleTitle: Simultaneous regeneration of 4×160-Gbit/s WDM and PDM channels in a single highly nonlinear fiber
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate simultaneous regeneration of 4×160-Gbit/s signals in a HNLF. The receiver powers at the BER of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup> are improved by 1.9 dB, 1.8 dB, 1.6 dB and 1.5 dB for the four channels, respectively.

articleTitle: Adaptive spectral filtering for Nyquist-WDM generation with extremely high resolution photonic spectral processor
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We employ a LCoS based photonic spectral processor with record spectral addressability of 200 MHz for shaping the channel response of a Gaussian filter to square-like shape, compatible with Nyquist WDM requirements.

articleTitle: Nanomechanical functionality of dual-core fibres
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We report experimental results on a dual suspended core nanomechanical optical fibre. Optical switching of light from one core to another is achieved through moving one core by just 8 nm.

articleTitle: Cost and performance evaluation of WDM-based access networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: WDM-based next-generation access systems have been compared to G-PON/XG-PON1 for high per-user bandwidths and access-node consolidation. Only with increasing sustained user bandwidth and decreasing node number, WDM-PON gets increasingly efficient.

articleTitle: High-speed directly-modulated lasers with photon-photon resonance
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Multi-section distributed-feedback lasers with surface gratings have been fabricated, without re-growth, by employing nanoimprint lithography. High-frequency photon-photon resonance was exploited to extend their direct modulation bandwidth beyond the limitations set by the carrier-photon resonance.

articleTitle: Availability analytical model for permanent dedicated path protection in service differentiated WDM networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: This paper analyses the connection availability of a protection paradigm, termed permanent dedicated path protection, in service differentiated WDM mesh networks. An analytical model for calculating the unavailability of P-DPP is introduced.

articleTitle: A transform domain processing based channel estimation method for OFDM radio-over-fiber systems
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an 8×4.65 Gb/s OFDM RoF system with TDP-based channel estimation over 40 km fiber link and 60 GHz wireless link. Compared with TDA-based method, the overhead can be reduced and 1.8 dB improvement is obtained at BER of 3.8×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup>.

articleTitle: Photonics millimeter-wave generation in the E-band (66∼88GHz) and bi-directional transmission
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We first experimentally demonstrate bi-directional full-duplex E-band fiber-wireless link over 20-km SMF-28 and 1.5-m free-space based on photonics millimeter-wave generation, independently carrying 2- and 2.5-Gb/s error-free OOK signals by 74- and 84-GHz mm-wave carriers simultaneously.

articleTitle: The first single-link exact model for performance analysis of flexible Grid WDM networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We analyze the performance features of dynamic flexible grid WDM networks from the mathematical angle. A continuous-time Markov model for links is proposed and matches Monte Carlo simulation results exactly.

articleTitle: Mode-division multiplexing systems: Propagation effects, performance and complexity
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: This article consists of a collection of slides from the author's conference presentation. Some of the specific areas/topics discussed include: Mode coupling (Sources, effects and models); Modal dispersion (Principal modes, Statistics of group delays, MDM system complexity); Modal gains and losses (Statistics of gains/losses and noise, MDM system performance, Frequency diversity).

articleTitle: Interplay of filtering and nonlinear transmission in coherent uncompensated DWDM system
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose an engineering method for OSNR penalty estimation for non-linear transmission of 112Gb/s PDM-DQPSK WDM signals over uncompensated links incorporating WSSes. Simulations and experimental results validate the method.

articleTitle: 512Gb/s DP-BPSK superchannel transmission over 7,200km DMF link with 1.43b/s/Hz spectral efficiency
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrated the first 400-Gb/s optical super-channel transmission over 7,200km DMF link using 8 optical subcarriers at 35GHz spacing and modulated with 32G baud-rate DP-BPSK Nyquist signal. Spectral efficiency of 1.43b/s/Hz was achieved.

articleTitle: An experimental study of nonlinear effects on 43 Gb/s electronic pre-equalized transmission
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We have studied the impact of nonlinear effects on 43 Gb/s electronically pre-equalized DQPSK signals. A nonlinear power threshold around 1 dB higher than for conventional DQPSK signals with optical dispersion compensation was confirmed.

articleTitle: Fault-identification method based on index distribution of optical fibers for enhanced optical link monitoring
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: This paper has investigated the enhanced fault-identification method based on the difference of intrinsic properties within an optical fiber. We have verified a fault-identification method using the wavelength dependency of non-reflective events through the experiment.

articleTitle: A narrow-passband frequency-tunable microwave photonic filter with an improved dynamic range
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A technique to improve the dynamic range of a microwave photonic filter using an SBS-assisted adaptive filter is proposed. An improved dynamic range of 6 dB over a tunable range of 14 GHz is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Next-generation optical transport network TCO analysis for 100G strategic deployment inflection point
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: This paper explores the many facets of transport network transformation economics in order to compare current technology with next generation automated 100G optical networks and examine the effects of deployment strategies and bandwidth growth.

articleTitle: Investigation of wavelength-tunable directly-modulated laser for 100-Gb/s EPON
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We experimentally investigate the BER performance of a wavelength-tunable directly-modulated laser that can be used in future 100-Gb/s EPON systems. The effects of temperature variation and optical filtering on the receiver sensitivity are also discussed.

articleTitle: Improvement of transmission distance of a 25-Gb/s FPC-OE with polymer waveguide by a microlens-imprinted film
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A cost-effective microlens-imprinted film between the VCSEL and the polymer waveguide has a benefit of improving mode launch condition in multimode fiber. We demonstrated 25-Gb/s 200-m multimode-fiber transmission by using this novel FPC-OE transceiver.

articleTitle: k-regular and k-(edge)-connected protection structures in optical transport networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We construct k-regular and k-(edge)-connected structures for providing protection against multiple failures in optical transport networks. It improves the spare resources efficiency without increasing the complexity of design and implementation of protection mechanisms.

articleTitle: High speed MIMO-OFDM wireless data transport in 60-GHz radio-over-fiber system multiplexed by optical TDM
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A spectrum-efficient MIMO-enhanced 60-GHz RoF system based on optical TDM has been demonstrated. It consists of two QPSK-OFDM MIMO channels with a simple TDM network design as a practical solution for mm-wave MIMO-based wireless communications.

articleTitle: Transmission of 25.5-Gb/s OFDM signal over 200-m G62.5/125 MMF using mode group diversity multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a 25.5-Gb/s OFDM transmission over 200-m OM1 MMF with a modulation bandwidth of 4.25 GHz, by using mode group diversity multiplexing. The power penalty induced by inter-channel crosstalk is only 0.5 dB.

articleTitle: Long-haul Ethernet-transport integrated packet/circuit hybrid network field-trial
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: In the first integrated packet/circuit hybrid network field-trial with production traffic, the mean capacity utilization of an Ethernet wavelength during a 24h period is doubled without timing-impact on the wavelength traffic.

articleTitle: Demonstration of fully functional MIMO wireless LAN transmission over GI-MMF for in-building networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose a low-cost optically-fed architecture capable of increasing the capacity and overall coverage of IEEE 802.11n MIMO WLAN system for in-building networks. A fully functional transmission over GI-MMF was demonstrated employing 2×3 MIMO configuration.

articleTitle: Automated alignment and splicing for multicore fibers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A novel method for aligning multi-core fibers (MCF) provides a systematic approach for MCF splicing in the lab, in cable factories, and in the field. This method also provides possibility of loss estimation for side-cores using IPA method and central core with WSI images.

articleTitle: A 1∶128 high splitting ratio long reach PON based on a simple receiving design for ONU with 120-Gb/s double-sided multiband DDO-OFDM signal
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A 120-Gb/s double-sided multiband DDO-OFDM based LR-PON architecture is proposed and experimentally demonstrated. With a simple receiver design, the implementation complexity can be reduced and the splitting ratio can be as high as 1∶128.

articleTitle: A 4×25 Gbps hybrid integrated EML module for 100 GbE transmitters using lens positional control by laser irradiation
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A lens-coupled hybrid optical integration system for a 100GbE transmission module is demonstrated for the first time. The multi-channel system has been realized via a precise lens-alignment technique exploiting high-power laser irradiation.

articleTitle: A new multi-purpose optical transmitter for higher-order QAM generation
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We present a versatile optical transmitter composed of tandem I/Q modulators driven by electrical binary signals. This transmitter is able to simply generate higher-order QAM formats (from BPSK up to 64QAM) without hardware modification.

articleTitle: 40GBASE-SR4 frame error rate test of chromatic dispersion compensating MMF
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Chromatic dispersion compensating MMF (OM4-PLUS) has been tested with 40GBASE-SR4 IP network traffic. The frame error rate results show that a reach of 1km is possible, demonstrating superior performance compared to regular OM4 MMF.

articleTitle: High-resolution 3-dimensional radar imaging based on a few-cycle W-band photonic millimeter-wave pulse generator
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A three-dimensional (3-D) radar imaging system is demonstrated by use of a near-single-cycle photonic millimeter-wave short-pulse generator at W-band. 3-D radar imaging with state-of-the-art range resolution of around 1 cm can be achieved.

articleTitle: Joint ICI cancellation for superchannel coherent optical systems in nonlinear transmission regimes
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A joint-DSP strategy for superchannel coherent optical systems is described and demonstrated. The proposed joint inter-channel interference cancellation algorithm is shown to be effective in the nonlinear transmission regime, yielding 5dB OSNR improvement.

articleTitle: Fast fault monitoring technique for reliable WDM PON: Achieving significant operational saving
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose a fast fault supervision technique compatible with an efficient resilience scheme for WDM PON. Several drop fibres can be monitored simultaneously so that a significant reduction of operational cost can be achieved.

articleTitle: Wavelength-reused WDM access network supporting 40 Gb/s downlink and 10 Gb/s uplink
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose the use of modified duobinary modulation in the downlink of a wavelength-reused WDM access network to combat the impacts of dispersion and reduce the crosstalk between 40-Gb/s downstream and 10-Gb/s upstream signals.

articleTitle: Home area networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: This article consists of a collection of slides from the author's conference presentation. Some of the specific areas/topics discussed include: Convergence in home networks, home service scenarios; Home wired network architectures, CapEx and OpEx; Residential Gateway; Optical fiber types; High-capacity data transmission for wirebound delivery; High-capacity data transmission for wireless delivery; Converged networks; Standards for POF transmission systems; Advanced networking techniques (routing, MGDM, Optical wireless); and Evolution trends and roadmap.

articleTitle: Carrier strategies in Russia
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: This paper will review major trends for Russian Service Providers analyzing the services/traffic growth, the major challenges and potential future network evolutions. Specific examples and use cases leveraging TransTeleCom deployment will be outlined.

articleTitle: Self-coherent differential phase detection for optical physical-layer secure communications
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate a polarization independent receiver suitable for self-coherent M-ary phase-shift keyed signals. The receiver measures a M-PSK signal from a quantum noise randomized encryption system and decrypts it to binary format.

articleTitle: 74.4% SSII cancellation in an EAM-based OFDM-IMDD transmission system
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We develop a novel SSII cancellation technique and experimentally demonstrated that 74.4% SSII cancellation and 2.8-dB sensitivity improvement can be achieved in a 32-Gbps EAM-based IMDD OFDM transmission system over 100-km uncompensated SSMF.

articleTitle: A novel in-building small-cell backhaul architecture for cost-efficient multi-operator multi-service coexistence
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate a novel in-building small-cell backhaul architecture for multi-operator, multi-service coexistence with optical infrastructure sharing. In-building experiments confirm 6–12Mb/s layer-4 packet throughputs for users under mobile distributed antenna and static frequency re-use scenarios, respectively.

articleTitle: Wavelength-tunable QAM synthesis by direct modulation of injection-locked Fabry-Perot semiconductor lasers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A new scheme for direct and tunable (30nm shown here) QAM synthesis from binary RF data streams is demonstrated with up to 48Gbit/s QPSK, including propagation over 75km SMF-28. Preliminary 16QAM (60Gbit/s) results are shown.

articleTitle: Differential mode attenuation in MMFs and its impact on DMD and EMB measurements
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Differential mode attenuation in multimode fiber is studied. Measurements show that a higher attenuation of lower order mode groups can explain the measured length dependence of differential mode delay and effective modal bandwidth.

articleTitle: Flattened optical comb generation using only phase modulators driven by single fundamental frequency sinusoidal sources with small frequency offset
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a novel and simple scheme to generate flattened optical subcarriers using only phase modulators driven by single frequency fundamental sinusoidal sources. 160.8Gb/s PM-QPSK experiment over a single subcarrier has been demonstrated.

articleTitle: 40-km reach symmetric 40-Gbit/s λ-tunable WDM/TDM-PON using synchronized gain-clamping SOA
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose a high power λ-tunable burst-mode transmitter with an output of over +10 dBm using a synchronized gain-clamping booster SOA, and demonstrate a 40-dB loss budget and 40-km reach symmetric 40-Gbit/s λ-tunable WDM/TDM-PON.

articleTitle: A 25-Gb/s × 4-Ch, 8 × 8 mm2, 2.8-mm thick compact optical transceiver module for on-board optical interconnect
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A 25-Gb/s × 4-ch optical transceiver module was developed. To obtain a compact module, CMOS analog front-end ICs, a lens integrated connector, and small LGA package was applied. The module demonstrated 25-Gb/s error-free transmission.

articleTitle: III–V on silicon transmitters
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Recent advances on hybrid III-V/Si transmitters using a wafer bonding technique are reported. In particular, widely tunable III-V/Si lasers exhibiting 45 nm tuning range and hybrid tunable transmitters integrating a silicon Mach-Zehnder modulator are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Demonstration of multi-channel hitless defragmentation with fast auto-tracking coherent RX LOs
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: This paper demonstrates simultaneous defragmentation of two channels without causing errors (BER <; 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-11</sup>) on other connections lying in the middle. The technique exploits fast tunable lasers and burst-mode coherent receivers with fast wavelength auto-tracking.

articleTitle: Optical 64QAM transmitter using tandem IQ modulators with balanced complexity in electronics and optics
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Instead of using eight-level electronics or highly-integrated optics, 64QAM generation is experimentally demonstrated using two tandem IQ modulators with four-level electronics. The complexity in electronics and optics is well-balanced. 16QAM and 36QAM are also synthesized.

articleTitle: High speed 850nm VCSELs for >40Gb/s transmission
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: VCSELs capable of direct modulation exceeding 40Gb/s are needed in next generation optical interconnect standards. Using a refined high-speed design we demonstrate GaAs-based VCSELs having record-high 28GHz modulation bandwidth, and that operate error-free at 47Gb/s.

articleTitle: Multi-level coded modulation for phase noise optimized constellations
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Multilevel coded modulation combined with a phase-noise-optimized 16QAM constellation is proposed to decrease required SNR by several dB. The set partitioning method is presented and constituent code rates are found to minimize block error rate.

articleTitle: Wide-band polarization splitter and rotator with large fabrication tolerance and simple fabrication process
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate a polarization splitter and rotator built on the silicon-on-insulator platform. The device shows low insertion loss (0.6 dB), low polarization crosstalk (<;-12 dB), wide bandwidth (-100 nm), and large fabrication tolerance (60 nm).

articleTitle: Feasibility study of SOA-preamplified coherent reception for 112 Gb/s DP-QPSK unamplified link
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: The feasibility of preamplifying a 100G DP-QPSK signal before coherent reception is investigated. A sensitivity improvement of 3 dB is found. Theoretically, there is another 5 dB of margin, and it is believed that several dBs can be gained through SOA optimization.

articleTitle: Performance improvement in radio-over-fiber transmission using pre-distorted double-sideband signals
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We investigate the optimal carrier-to-sideband-ratio (CSR) for optical double-sideband (DSB) signals, and experimentally demonstrate that pre-distorted DSB has 1.2dB sensitivity advantage over single sideband both with optimal CSR in a 12GHz 29km radio-over-fiber transmission.

articleTitle: A novel polarization division multiplexed OFDM system with a direct-detection BLAST-aided receiver
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a 50-Gbps PDM-OFDM system with a direct-detection BLAST-aided receiver. Without dynamic polarization tracking, the PDM-OFDM system can achieve BER of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup> over all possible SOP with <2.8-dB difference of OSNR requirement.

articleTitle: Real-time 400G superchannel transmission using 100-GbE based 37.5-GHz spaced subcarriers with optical Nyquist shaping over 3,600-km DMF link
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: 400G superchannel with four parallel 100-GbE subcarriers is successfully transmitted in real-time over 3600-km of DMF link using 150-GHz bandwidth. Optical Nyquist shaping is employed to reduce performance penalty induced by sharp optical filtering.

articleTitle: Optical burst-over-circuit switching for multi-granularity traffic in data centers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose a composite optical crossconnect by adding a fast wavelength routing module to a MEMS-based switch. This crossconnect efficiently addresses the requirements of burst and circuit switching in data center optical networks.

articleTitle: Nonlinear compensation and inter-channel crosstalk suppression for 4×160.8Gb/s DWDM PDM-QPSK signal with heterodyne coherent detection
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose and experimentally investigate digital nonlinear compensation and inter-channel cross talk suppression for 4×160.8Gb/s DWDM PDM-QPSK transmission with simplified heterodyne coherent detection. The BER has been improved from 5.7×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> to 3.5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup> after 1300km SMF-28.

articleTitle: Impact of mode partition noise on horizontal eye opening in multimode fiber links
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Statistical exploration of the impact of the mode partition noise in multimode links shows achievable distances without CDR or FEC limited to 50m, while adding both CDR and FEC extends them to more than 200m.

articleTitle: Chiral Fibers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Microforming optical fibers provides unique properties that are useful for: polarization control, harsh-environment sensing, dense multichannel coupling, spatial division-multiplexing and fiber amplification.

articleTitle: Generation of 28GBaud and 32GBaud PDM-Nyquist-QPSK by a DAC with 11.3GHz analog bandwidth
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Generations of 28GBaud and 32GBaud PDM-Nyquist-QPSK using a DAC with a sample rate up to 64GSa/s and an analog bandwidth of 11.3GHz are demonstrated. By bandwidth limitation pre-equalization, a Q-gain of 0.8 dB is achieved in B2B experiments.

articleTitle: Spectral pre-distortion with FPGA and DAC at 448-Gb/s DP-16QAM improving nonlinear threshold power
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Non-linear tolerance measurements of DP-16QAM (28 Gbd) signals with transmitter based digital signal pre-distortion are reported, showing systematic performance gains of fibre launch power versus pre-distortion (~1.5 dB for 6 uncompensated SMF spans) and a distinct reduction of the non-linear threshold spans scaling factor.

articleTitle: 30.7 Tb/s (96×320 Gb/s) DP-32QAM transmission over 19-cell Photonic Band Gap Fiber
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We report for the first time coherently-detected, polarization-multiplexed transmission over photonic band gap fiber. By transmitting 96 × 320-Gb/s DP-32QAM modulated channels, a net data rate of 24 Tb/s was obtained.

articleTitle: First demonstration of multi-span transmission using phase and amplitude regeneration in PPLN-based PSA
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrated that impairments caused by chromatic dispersion, fiber nonlinearity, and the ASE of optical amplifiers were effectively suppressed using in-line PSA repeaters. Over 3200-km transmission of 28-Gb/s BPSK signal was achieved without dispersion compensation.

articleTitle: 3.22-Gb/s WDM visible light communication of a single RGB LED employing carrier-less amplitude and phase modulation
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate WDM-VLC employing CAP modulation and commercially available RGB-type LED. The record aggregate data rate of 3.22 Gb/s with the BER of less than 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> is successfully achieved over >25-cm air-transmission.

articleTitle: Broadband 4×4 switch matrix using fifth-order resonators
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A 4×4 crossbar switch is implemented and fully demonstrated using a matrix of fifth order resonators. Broadband 40Gb/s routing is demonstrated with a power penalty of only 0.3dB and a switch extinction ratio of 27dB.

articleTitle: Cascade of 4 SOAs with 448 Gbit/s (224 Gbit/s) dual channel dual polarization 16QAM (QPSK) for high-capacity business paths in converged metro-access networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate 448 Gbit/s (224 Gbit/s) dual channel DP-16QAM (QPSK) transmission over four cascaded, linear SOAs using advanced modulation formats. As an application we envision dedicated high-capacity business paths in future converged metro-access networks.

articleTitle: 100 Gbit/s wireless link with mm-wave photonics
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate a single-input single-output photonic wireless link at 237.5 GHz with record 100 Gbit/s data transmission over 20 m. We use an optical heterodyne I/Q transmitter and a state-of-the-art active I/Q-MMIC at the receiver.

articleTitle: Ultrafast absolute ranging by coherent parametric comb
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A new technique for fast, high-precision ranging is presented. The method utilized multi-tone heterodyning of dual phase-locked parametric combs. A 1.5-μm accuracy and 500ns capture time is demonstrated for the first time in LIDAR vibrometry.

articleTitle: Investigation of receiver DSP carrier phase estimation rate for self-homodyne space-division multiplexing communication systems
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate a significant reduction of the required carrier-phase estimation rate for self-homodyne multi-core fiber systems by analyzing experimental data with implementation-constrained digital signal processing, which could enable an improvement on receiver energy consumption.

articleTitle: On the pulse shape performance of CP-QPSK signal with optimum pre-compensation in submarine systems
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Relative-low-cost upgrade possibilities of realistic submarine links of >4500km with 100G CP-QPSK transponders are analyzed with various formats. We showed that with the optimum pre-compensation, simpler NRZ-shaped CP-QPSK signal performs similarly to the RZ-shaped one.

articleTitle: Evaluation of FSK light labels superimposed on 112 Gbps DP-QPSK signal with real-time coherent receiver and optical filter based decoder for light path tracing
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We experimentally evaluate the feasibility of FSK light labels superimposed on 112 Gbps DP-QPSK signals using real time digital coherent receiver and optical filter based light label decoder.

articleTitle: Self-aligned InP/InGaAsP polarization converter for polarization-multiplexed photonic integrated circuits
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a compact and low-loss InP/InGaAsP polarization converter, fabricated by a simple self-aligned process. The mode-conversion of 96% and the excess loss of less than 1.0 dB are obtained over the entire C-band.

articleTitle: Digital clock recovery algorithm for Nyquist signal
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Conventional Gardner clock recovery method fails on Nyquist signal with sinc pulse shape. A novel algorithm is proposed and verified by experiment. It has lower timing jitter, and its tolerance to various distortions is investigated.

articleTitle: Transport network evolution for advanced services
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We discuss the evolution of carrier network infrastructure in view of the growth in packet-based services and current progress in transport network technologies, and outline key issues driving network evolution today.

articleTitle: A novel photonic integrated regenerator
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate a novel InP-PIC for all-optical regeneration. The PIC exploits cross-gain compression in SOA obtaining, at the same time, wavelength-preserving regeneration and wavelength conversion. 10 Gb/s operation is shown by Q-factor and BER improvement.

articleTitle: ROADM system for space division multiplexing with spatial superchannels
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A two-span SDM system includes the first ROADM supporting spatial superchannels and the first cladding-pumped multicore-EDFA directly spliced to multicore transmission fiber. For 6×40×128-Gb/s SDM-WDM-PDM-QPSK transmission, BER penalties are ≤1.6dB in Add, Drop, and Express paths.

articleTitle: Gridless submarine optical networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Submarine networks around the world are being upgraded in capacity through the use of coherent-based transmission technology, which is increasing existing channel rates from 10 Gb/s to 40 Gb/s and 100 Gb/s. Older submarine cables are hindered as to how many channels are supported due to the limited useable optical bandwidth of legacy submarine repeaters. This paper reviews how gridless networks can improve spectral efficiencies of existing submarine networks.

articleTitle: Spectrum defragmentation algorithms for elastic optical networks using hitless spectrum retuning techniques
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose several algorithms to achieve hitless bandwidth defragmentation using spectrum retuning in elastic optical networks. Two retuning techniques, spectrum sweeping and hop tuning, are studied. Simulation results show that the hop tuning technique achieves better defragmentation performance.

articleTitle: Comparison of network cost and power consumption between a single-line-rate network and a flexible-bitrate network in the beyond-100-Gb/s networks era
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: This paper shows a comparison of the number of transponders including regenerators, cost and power consumption depending on transmission reach of the 400-Gb/s-based signal between the flexible-bitrate network using 100-Gb/s and 400-Gb/s signals and 100-Gb/s signal network.

articleTitle: Network Energy Efficiency in the data center
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Data center energy-use has been a leading topic in computing for more than a decade. In 2006, the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) conducted a study to understand data center energy-use trends and recommended a systems-wide approach to achieving energy efficiency. In the same year the IEEE began work on Energy-Efficient Ethernet (EEE), which completed in 2010, producing another tool in the energy-efficiency solution set. While IEEE 802.3az™-2010 specifies EEE for twisted-pair copper and backplane interface, this paper examines the motivation for energy-efficient networking in data centers, the role Energy-Efficient Ethernet could have in making the data center network energy-proportional, and how EEE combined with optical networks may optimize network energy-use.

articleTitle: Striding optical transport technologies to mitigate a cyclical capacity crunch
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Technologies are developed to meet the demands of consumers and providers alike; flexible ROADMs, spatial multiplexing in few-mode, multi-core and hollow-core fibers are the current and future technologies vying for the limelight. Maturity cycles are consecutive and complementary.

articleTitle: Optical interconnect networks for datacom and computercom
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Traditional telecom applications spend more at the link end points to maximize spectral efficiency of long-distance fiber links - see for example recent R&D on coherent transmission devices ; For datacom, spectral efficiency tends to be traded for lower power, cheaper transceiver cost and a network fabric with abundant path diversity. ; Within the datacenter, fiber resources are much more abundant, cheap, and easy to deploy. Thus, the transceiver cost must be aggressively reduced ; As we enter an age of network affluence, the focus shifts to quality of service & application awareness ; Five Mega-Trends affect optical network design in the data center: - Big Data Centers - Big Data - PODs (and new network architectures) - Network becomes Smarter & More Open - Network Virtualization ; Virtualization of the network is the next big frontier - Software-defined Networking (OpenFlow + DOVE overlays) are a disruptive technology in this landscape - Application velocity and deployment velocity become equally important ; The most cost effective path forward requires open standards and interoperable networks ; Business process improvement provides more value add for IT than capex/opex reduction.

articleTitle: First monolithic GaAs IQ electro-optic modulator, demonstrated at 150 Gbit/s with 64-QAM
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We report on the first experimental demonstration of a GaAs IQ-modulator. Data rates of up to 150 Gbit/s are generated using QPSK, 16-QAM, 32-QAM and 64-QAM on a single carrier and polarization.

articleTitle: Field trial of a novel FTTH/PON monitoring technique based on unique wavelength-selective mirror combinations
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Our novel PON monitoring concept succeeded in a field trial. Subscribers located at equal distances were individually identified across a PON with at least 30.7 dB one-way loss and utilization of low cost components.

articleTitle: Optical multicast at 224 Gb/s with tunable frequency conversion in a flex-grid network testbed
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose an optical node architecture, based on PPLN, simultaneously supporting optical multicast and frequency conversion.Multicasting with two tunable conversions is demonstrated with low power consumption in a flex-grid testbed with 224 Gb/s PM-16QAM signal.

articleTitle: Multiformat wavelength swapping in periodically poled Lithium Niobate waveguide
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Multiformat wavelength swapping is demonstrated. The operation is achieved at packet level through second order nonlinearities in PPLN waveguide. The experimental validation is provided by BER measurements using 40Gb/s DQPSK and 10Gb/s OOK signals.

articleTitle: Spectrum-efficient provisioning for multi-channel elastic optical networking
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Spectrum-efficient provisioning is designed for multi-channel elastic optical networking, which exploits various modulation formats and performs compact spectrum assignment at channel basis. Our scheme achieves high spectral efficiency with fast computation independent of spectrum granularity.

articleTitle: Engineering Colorless/Directionless/Contentionless Metro/Regional networks for 400G+
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Architectural alternatives are considered for Metro/Regional network with 400G+ transmission based on 100Gb/s and 200Gb/s subchannels in super-band transmission. Reach results are derived for practical metro/regional networks. The results provide clear direction for architectural decisions.

articleTitle: Enabling 850nm VCSELs for 100GbE unretimed applications
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We have investigated feasibility and limitations of 850nm VCSELs for 100GbE unretimed applications based on 4×25.78GBd signaling. We have shown traditional FFE/DFE based equalizer could overcome optical as well as electrical channel impairments.

articleTitle: Multi mode optical amplifiers with flexible wavelength and spatial channel count
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We investigate the capability of multi mode EDFAs to dynamically adapt to load scenarios with different wavelength and spatial channel count. Gain and noise figure values of channels could be equalized by pump power control.

articleTitle: Dimensioning of elastic optical packet switched metro rings
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose a dimensioning algorithm for all-optical packet rings equipped with elastic or fixed mixed line rate (fMLR) transponders (TRX) and show that elastic TRX can reduce network cost by up to 40% with respect to fMLR networks.

articleTitle: Multi-tenant Data Center and cloud networking evolution
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Multi-tenant cloud networking is undergoing an evolution to address scalability, efficiency, and agility in allocating compute, storage and network resources to tenants. This paper provides an overview of existing and evolving cloud networking technologies.

articleTitle: Survivability strategies for PCE-based WDM networks offering high reliability performance
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Two approaches based on backup reprovisioning and path restoration are proposed for dynamic failure recovery in survivable, PCE-based, WDM networks. Results show that proposed schemes can achieve high connection availability in double link failure scenarios.

articleTitle: WAN virtualization: Looking beyond point-to-point circuits
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Meshes of point-to-point circuits have been the lingua franca for isolating WAN traffic between distributed sites. This talk describes a flexible switching-service abstraction that enables distributed science collaborations as well as enterprise cloud computing.

articleTitle: 80 Gb/s decision feedback equalizer for intersymbol interference limited channels
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate the first 80 Gb/s decision feedback equalizer in various electrical and optical applications. The device, designed in SiGe:C BiCMOS 0.13 μm technology, enables error-free data recovery of heavily distorted signals transmitted at a bandwidth less than 30% of their bit rate. The fastest nonlinear electrical equalizer reported yet utilizes a novel 1-tap look-ahead architecture.

articleTitle: 106km fully-distributed fiber-optic fence based on P-OTDR with 2nd-order Raman amplification
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A long-distance (106 km) fully distributed fiber-optic fence based on polarization optical time-domain reflectometry (P-OTDR) with 2-nd order Raman amplification is demonstrated. To our best knowledge, it is the longest fiber fence reported so far.

articleTitle: Cost evaluation of the integration of IP/MPLS and WDM elements
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Multi-layer integration is an important trend in the telecom industry as a cost-efficient alternative. From an incremental CapEx analysis, we aim to quantify the maximum cost savings that could be achieved by such integration.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of polarization demultiplexing in stokes space for coherent optical PDM-OFDM
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose a polarization demultiplexing method in Stokes space for coherent optical PDM-OFDM without inserting training symbols. The experimental demonstration of fiber transmissions shows good performance, comparable with that of using training symbols.

articleTitle: PPLN based phase sensitive amplifiers and their applications
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We review recent advances on phase sensitive amplifiers based on periodically poled LiNbO3 waveguides. In particular, we discuss their unique low noise amplification, phase squeezing properties, in-line operation, and applications.

articleTitle: Intra-channel XPM compensation for single-stage backward-propagation
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Intra-channel XPM compensation is proposed for reduced-complexity back-propagation. By optimizing the number of intra-channel sub-bands, single-stage back-propagation is demonstrated on a 3,400 km straight-line NZ-DSF link. A trade-off between complexity and performance is analyzed.

articleTitle: Orthogonal multipulse modulation for 64 Gigabit Fibre Channel
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Real-time orthogonal multipulse modulation is demonstrated at 56 Gb/s with transmission over 500 m of single-mode fiber. Up to 2 dBo power budget advantage is predicted relative to alternatives such as PAM4.

articleTitle: Multimode EDFA performance in mode-division multiplexed transmission systems
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We report a detailed study on the system performance of a two-mode group EDFA. In particular we quantify how the gain spectrum and BER performance are affected by input signal and pump power as required in the execution of our ongoing MDM transmission experiments.

articleTitle: The first demonstration of silicon waveguide optical circulator
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A Mach-Zehnder interferometer-based 4-port optical circulator is fabricated in a Si-nanowire waveguide using the direct bonding technique. The circulator operation is demonstrated with the highest isolation of 15.3 dB at a wavelength of 1531 nm.

articleTitle: Four channel DFB laser array based on the reconstruction-equivalent-chirp technique for 1.3 µm CWDM systems
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We report the first experimental realization of four-channel DFB laser array with λ/4 equivalent phase shift (EPS) based on the reconstruction-equivalent-chirp (REC) technique for 1.3 μm CWDM systems.

articleTitle: Phase-sensitive amplifiers for optical links
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A review of recent progress on the implementation of phase-sensitive amplifiers in optical links is provided. Additionally, their use as regenerators, specifically the trade-off between phase- and amplitude regeneration is discussed.

articleTitle: Analysis of transmission impairments on Terabit aggregate PONs
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We analyze the transmission limitations of coherent optical access networks transporting over Terabit data rates with high-order QAM modulation. Additionally, we experimentally demonstrate the coexistence of 16×1.25 Gb/s-QPSK with 10 Gb/s-NRZ considering guard bands ≤200 GHz.

articleTitle: 12.5GB operation of a novel monolithic 1.55µm BPSK source based on prefixed optical phase switching
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Novel optical phase switching BPSK transmitter was used to transmit 12.5GB signal over 40km. Speed scalability, ultra-small footprint and low power drive of the monolithic circuit are attractive for advanced format migration towards low-cost applications.

articleTitle: Fiber bragg gratings in industrial sensing
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: The tutorial is based on technical experiences obtained during development and numerous practical industry deployments of fiber Bragg grating (FBG) sensors and sensor systems. Technical means will be analyzed, which make FBG to an attractive sensing solution: draw tower Bragg grating technology, sensor-specific fiber coatings, sensor packaging. Sensor system technologies are discussed, among them the fiber-optic, opto-electronic hardware and software concepts that transform low-cost polychromator read-out into robust as well as precise high-quality FBG interrogation. Technical FBG sensor implementations can show significant advantages against other sensor technologies, for instance in aerospace, transport, energy sector, and engineering. For such examples, the specific monitoring conditions are characterized, which ask in particular for application of fiber optic sensors. Reasons are discussed, how monitoring creates added value, e.g., by obtaining enhanced efficiency and availability of power generation, railway service, production processes, and other industrial benefits. Special focus is directed on a successfully launched actual application - monitoring and controlling the paper making process by FBG sensor assisted measurements of load and temperature profiles between rolls in paper mills - the NipVision® sensor system. The tutorial concludes with a review of opportunities and issues of FBG sensing technique, open for vibrant discussion: about basic limits, barriers necessary to overcome, and more about active technology trends, e.g., in extreme high and low temperature energetics.

articleTitle: High density optical interconnects integrated with lasers, optical modulators and photodetectors on a single silicon chip
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Silicon optical interposers for inter-chip interconnects, integrated with lasers, an optical splitter, optical modulators and germanium photodetectors on a single silicon substrate were demonstrated. A 12.5-Gbps error-free data transmission and 6.6-Tbps/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> transmission density were achieved.

articleTitle: 400 Gbit/s 256 QAM-OFDM transmission over 720 km with a 14 bit/s/Hz spectral efficiency using an improved FDE technique
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate 400 Gbit/s PDM-256 QAM-OFDM transmission with 14 bit/s/Hz spectral efficiency by employing an improved FDE technique that extended the transmission distance to 720 km and achieved an SE-distance product of 10,080 km·bit/s/Hz.

articleTitle: Bi-directional ultra-wideband services over large-core POF-PON based home networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Bi-directional transmission of ultra-wideband wireless signals over 1 mm core diameter POF for PON-based in-home network is demonstrated. Standard compliant signal distribution over 50 m POF and 4 m wireless transmission is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Adaptive rate and bandwidth WDM optical sampling pulse streams with LCoS-based photonic spectral processor
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We generate transform-limited WDM optical sampling pulse streams, as an alternative to time-stretched optical sampling in photonically-assisted analog-to-digital conversion applications. A single LCoS processor compresses and retimes user-selectable bandwidths from an optical short pulse source.

articleTitle: LGLC tunable laser with highly stable SMSR against large filter deviation for full C-band operation
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Highly stable SMSR over 40-dB was confirmed against a wavelength deviation (> 4 nm) of LGLC filter integrated tunable laser. Moreover, C-band tunable laser operation at 50°C was achieved with LGLC current of 6 mA.

articleTitle: Impact of wavelength/waveband convertors and the cost bound in hierarchical optical path networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: This paper investigates the impact of wavelength/waveband convertors in hierarchical optical path networks. It shows that even if their costs are relatively high, hierarchical optical path networks can be cost effective over a wide traffic demand area.

articleTitle: Next generation applications and services for ultra-fast broadband
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: US Ignite is catalyzing the development of 60 next-generation applications that take advantage of advanced network services such as ultra-fast broadband. This paper discusses relevant advanced network services and gives examples of new applications they make feasible.

articleTitle: Hybrid silicon transmitter using quantum well intermixing
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A hybrid silicon DFB laser array emitting over 200nm was integrated with EAMs (3dB bandwidth>30GHz). Four bandgaps spread over >100nm were realized using quantum well intermixing for increased spectral gain and for laser-modulator detuning.

articleTitle: Broadband passive InP membrane regenerator for silicon-based optical interconnect applications
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Improved passive signal regeneration performance based on bonded InP membrane waveguides is demonstrated. A tripling of the ER and receiver sensitivity enhancement of >3.6dB is achieved over the entire C-band at a bitrate of 2.5Gb/s.

articleTitle: Orthogonal phase quadratures conversion to different wavelengths through phase-sensitive four wave mixing in an highly nonlinear fiber
