publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Phase-sensitive processes exploiting FWM in an HNLF allow simultaneously converting two orthogonal quadratures of an optical signal to different wavelengths. Conversion efficiencies to two 90°-phase-shifted idlers exceeding 10 dB of phase-sensitive extinction ratio are obtained experimentally.

articleTitle: Spectrally-efficient 448-Gb/s dual-carrier PDM-16QAM channel in a 75-GHz grid
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We improved 448-Gb/s dual-carrier PDM-16QAM spectral efficiency by using optical pre-filtering and RZ pulse-shaping, allowing it to operate in a 75-GHz WDM grid transmission system at 5.6-b/s/Hz without the use of Nyquist filtering or OFDM.

articleTitle: Packet switched optical mobile network - Architecture design and performance analysis
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a packet switched optical mobile network architecture and the correspondent mobility management scheme. The simulation in a real scenario shows that the proposed architecture can fulfill the requirements of future mobile networks.

articleTitle: Influence of channel misalignment of time-interleaved DAC on sensitivity degradation in coherent optical receivers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: The time-interleaved architecture is indispensable for high-speed digital-to-analog converters (DACs) in coherent optical transmitters. After analyzing the impact of misalignment of time-interleaved channels, we measure receiver-sensitivity degradation by such misalignment using QPSK and 16-QAM signals.

articleTitle: Characterization of dynamic evolution of channel matrix in two-mode fibers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We employ coherent detection and digital signal processing to characterize dynamic evolution of channel matrix in two-mode fibers. Experimental results reveal that the evolution frequency of channel matrix can reach as fast as 4 kHz.

articleTitle: 406.6-Gb/s PDM-BPSK superchannel transmission over 12,800-km TWRS fiber via nonlinear noise squeezing
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We transmit a 406.6-Gb/s superchannel consisting of eight 37.5-GHz-spaced 32-Gbaud Nyquist-filtered PDM-BPSK signals over 12,800-km (160×80-km) EDFA-only amplified dispersion-unmanaged TWRS fiber. This result is enabled by nonlinear noise squeezing achieved through optimized digital electronic dispersion pre-compensation.

articleTitle: Measurement of spatial and polarization birefringence in two-mode elliptical core fibers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: By analyzing the SOP evolution as function of wavelength the group birefringence of both the polarization and spatial modes of elliptical-core two-mode fibers with systematically varied ellipticity (b/a≈0.1-0.64) is measured over a broad wavelength range around 1550 nm.

articleTitle: Surveys of emerging control plane initiatives
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Current technologies and architecture result in exponentially escalating costs and do not target revenue generation within the network. They are also complex, failure prone, and power inefficient. Software Defined Networking (SDN) enables network providers to monetize higher layer functions and services based on software and to decouple development from the physical platforms. Carrier rationale and requirements driving the use of SDN are described.

articleTitle: Eye-safe high-capacity 1-mm GI-POF interconnects exploiting discrete multitone modulation
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We report high capacity 1-mm graded-index polymer optical fiber (GI-POF) short-range interconnects employing discrete multitone (DMT) modulation technique. The bit rates of 13.09 Gb/s over 15 m and 28.19 Gb/s over 1 m were achieved at 0 dBm fiber-coupled power and BER of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>. The record capacity of 31.74 Gb/s over 1-m link was achieved at +2 dBm fiber-coupled power.

articleTitle: 8×8 space and wavelength selective cross-connect for simultaneous dynamic multi-wavelength routing
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate the first monolithic 8-input, 8-output WDM-compliant cross-connect with nanosecond programmable path provisioning between each input and output. Multiple data channels are simultaneously demonstrated for all eight outputs with penalty as low as 1.7dB.

articleTitle: Single chip 46 Gb/s DP-QPSK digital clock recovery and channel equalization performance in the presence of CD, PMD, and ultra-fast SOP rotation rates exceeding 20 krad/s
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate performance of a single chip 46 Gb/s coherent DP-QPSK transceiver. An OSNR penalty <;0.9 dB is shown for 56,862 ps/nm CD, and up to 100 ps DGD, 4000 ps<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> SOPMD, and 22,000 rad/s polarization rotation rate.

articleTitle: Photonic multiwavelength transmitters with DBR laser array for optical access networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Photonic multiwavelength transmitters were fabricated on an indium phosphide-based platform by monolithically integrating an array of DBR lasers with Mach-Zehnder modulators. The devices operate at 12.5Gbps with the output power above 3dBm per transmission channel.

articleTitle: Scalability and performance of a distributed AWGR-based all-optical token interconnect architecture
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: This paper studies an interconnect architecture with distributed all-optical control plane. A physical layer analysis shows scalability up to 128 ports. Simulations for an 128-port switch show low latency and high throughput at 0.75 load.

articleTitle: 4G/5G mobile technologies - Can they be a blueprint for optical networks?
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: This paper provides a brief perspective of the evolution of mobile networks with the premise of spectrum as a scarce resource. We highlight some key aspects of mobile technology, and we comment about their connection to optical networks.

articleTitle: Efficient MIMO channel estimation for OFDM-PON based on polarization interleaving and direct detection
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We present efficient MIMO channel estimation methods for OFDM-PON based on polarization interleaving. The simulation and experiment results show that the LMMSE and ISFA estimators have better performance than the LS estimator.

articleTitle: 400 Gb/s (40 × 10 Gb/s) ASE injection seeded WDM-PON based on SOA-REAM
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate a 400-Gb/s ASE injection seeded WDM-PON. A cost-effective SOA-REAM and FEC were utilized to enhance the BER performance. A required total seed power at OLT was 8.6 dBm with the 2nd generation FEC.

articleTitle: Waveguide germanium photodetector with high bandwidth and high L-band responsivity
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We present a waveguide germanium p-i-n photodetector for C and L-band operation. A record-high responsivity of 1.30 A/W for a germanium p-i-n photodetector is achieved at 1611.5 nm, while maintaining a high 27 GHz bandwidth.

articleTitle: An ultralow complexity algorithm for frame synchronization and IQ alignment in CO-OFDM systems
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We present a simple and efficient method for CO-OFDM frame synchronization and IQ component aligning. A training sequence is used. Simulations and experimental results confirm that our proposed method outperforms the widely-used method of Schmidl&Cox.

articleTitle: High performance, in-service correlation OTDR
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We describe a correlation OTDR suitable for embedded in-service monitoring of a TDM-PON. We demonstrate fault detection on a 1 × 16 PON in the presence of multiple drop fibers with this OTDR.

articleTitle: Experimental comparison of terabit nyquist superchannel transmissions based on high and low baud rates
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We report experimental results comparing two-types-of terabit Nyquist-pulse-shaped superchannel transmissions. A 50-subcarrier low-baud-rate system with potential of significant DSP simplification has shown similar transmission performance compared with a 10-subcarrier high-baud-rate system.

articleTitle: Energy efficiency of load-adaptively operated telecommunication networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Presents a collection of slides covering the following topics: load-adaptively operated telecommunication networks; telecommunication network energy consumption; network energy efficiency; and ICT production sites.

articleTitle: 875-Mb/s asynchronous bi-directional 64QAM-OFDM SCM-WDM transmission over RGB-LED-based visible light communication system
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated a 575-Mb/s downstream and 300-Mb/s upstream bi-directional SCM-WDM visible light communication system based on RGB-LED. BERs in all channels are under pre-FEC limit of 3.8×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> after 66-cm free-space transmission.

articleTitle: CAPEX benefits of colorless directionless ROADM in WDM transport networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: This paper quantifies the CAPEX benefits of network defragmentation and shared protection using colorless directionless ROADM. The value of contentionless is also investigated.

articleTitle: Fiber fuse propagation modes in typical single-mode fibers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: The precise measurement of fusing speed revealed that its behavior varies depending on the plasma volume per pump beam diameter. Irregular void patterns appear when the pump power changes faster than the surrounding melt relaxes.

articleTitle: Filter-less multi-tone coherent orthogonal detection for multi-channel reception of super-channel/OFDM signals
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Multi-tone coherent-matched detection is demonstrated for multi-channel reception of superchannel/OFDM signals without optical filters for channel selection. Assisted with MIMO equalization, interleaved 23×20Gb/s QPSK are orthogonally demultiplexed.

articleTitle: System design tradeoffs for XPM mitigation in hybrid 100G-10G networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: The effectiveness of XPM reduction in 100G-10G networks employing fiber Bragg grating and fiber-based DCMs is determined experimentally as a function of key system parameters including dispersion map, spectral guard bands, and DSP parameters.

articleTitle: Investigation of energy savings in optical networks using bundle link rightsizing methods
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose several distributed local optimized algorithms to rightsize the capacity of bundle links to achieve energy savings by shutting down corresponding layer-3 router ports and in layer-1 optical components.

articleTitle: Demonstration of cascaded operation of active-passive integrated 4×4 SOA switches with on-chip monitoring for power control and energy consumption optimization
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Cascaded 4×4 SOA switches with on-chip power monitoring exhibit potential for low power 16×16 integrated switches. Cascaded operation at 10Gbit/s with an IPDR of 8.5dB and 79% lower power consumption than equivalent all-active switches is reported.

articleTitle: High-efficient InP-based balanced photodiodes integrated with 90° hybrid MMI for compact 100 Gb/s coherent receiver
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: InP-based balanced photodiodes monolithically integrated with the 90° hybrid consisting of multimode interference structures (MMI) by the butt-joint process were demonstrated for the first time. The high responsivity of 0.14 A/W and wide 3-dB bandwidth of 22 GHz at a low reverse bias voltage of 1.6 V were successfully achieved.

articleTitle: WMRD net: An optical data center interconnect
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose a less expensive power efficient high availability data center interconnect called as WMRD net (WDM based Multi link Ring Data center network). WMRD net mainly uses readily available passive optical network components.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of reconfigurable optical interconnect based on hybrid free-space and multi-mode fiber propagation
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A reconfigurable optical interconnect architecture based on hybrid free-space and multi-mode fiber (MMF) propagation is proposed and experimentally demonstrated. 3×10 Gb/s reconfigurable interconnect is achieved with ~12 cm free-space propagation and a 10 m multimode fiber length.

articleTitle: Ultra-high-speed uni-traveling carrier photodiodes and their applications
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: This paper presents a review of the recent progress in the performances of uni-travelling carrier photodiodes. It shows how waveguide devices have pushed responsivity, bandwidth and power handling and how these enhancements impact their applications.

articleTitle: Fractionally-spaced frequency domain equalization for optical coherent receivers with interleaved samplers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose a fractionally-spaced frequency domain equalization technique for optical coherent receivers with interleaved samplers and experimentally demonstrate its robustness against the sampling timing mismatch and the IQ channel skew in 20Gbps coherent QPSK transmissions.

articleTitle: A 400 Gb/s WDM receiver using a low loss silicon nitride AWG integrated with hybrid silicon photodetectors
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A heterogeneously integrated WDM receiver based on an AWG demultiplexer and hybrid silicon/InGaAs detectors is presented in a novel platform that combines hybrid silicon components with ultra-low loss silicon nitride waveguides.

articleTitle: Ultrahigh spectral efficiency coherent optical OFDM
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Recent development of ultrahigh spectral efficiency coherent optical orthogonal frequency-division multiplexed (OFDM) signal modulation with polarization-division-multiplexing (PDM) has been reviewed which includes 128-ary quadrature amplitude modulation (QAM), 256QAM and 1024QAM at each modulated subcarrier.

articleTitle: Directly modulating a long weak-resonant-cavity laser diode at limited bandwidth of 5 GHz with pre-leveled 16-QAM OFDM transmission at 20 Gbit/s
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Coherently injection-locked and directly modulated long weak-resonant-cavity FPLD for pre-leveled optical 16-QAM OFDM transmission in DWDM-PON at 20.25-Gbit/s over 25-km is demonstrated with receiving sensitivity of -8dBm at EVM of 8% and BER of 3.8×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>.

articleTitle: Nonlinearity and phase noise tolerant 75–110 GHz signal over fiber system using phase modulation technique
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We report on the transmission of 8 Gb/s 0 dB PAPR 16QAM-OFDM W-band (75-110 GHz) signals over 22.8km SMF without phase noise compensation by using a phase modulator in the optical heterodyne up-convertor.

articleTitle: Analytical modeling of non-linear propagation in coherent systems
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: The GN-model appears as the convergent result of many parallel perturbative approaches. Further investigation is needed to better identify its limitations. There are open problems, such as “Gaussinization” in first span(s). On the other hand, validation so far seems to indicate that it already captures the main features of non-linear propagation in UT systems with good accuracy. Simple approximate analytical formulas are available, that provide clear indications on the dependence of system performance on the main parameters. Overall, the GN-model could provide an effective tool for the analysis and design of UT coherent systems.

articleTitle: Development of low loss, wide bandwidth hollow core photonic bandgap fibers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We present a detailed overview of progress in the development of hollow-core photonic bandgap fibers with improved transmission and modal properties which demonstrates the feasibility and potential of this fiber solution for future telecom systems.

articleTitle: First experimental demonstration of real-time adaptive transmission of 20Gb/s dual-band optical OFDM signals over 500m OM2 MMFs
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Record-high 20Gb/s real-time dual-band optical OFDM transceivers using 4GS/s DACs/ADCs are experimentally demonstrated, whose transmission system-adaptive performances are extensively explored in various MMFs of different lengths and types including OM1, OM2 and legacy fibers.

articleTitle: A low-complexity digital pre-compensation of SOA induced phase distortion in coherent QAM transmissions
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A simple digital pre-compensation technique for the pattern-dependent phase distortion in Semiconductor Optical Amplifiers is proposed for coherent QAM transmitters. The performance of the proposed compensator is experimentally evaluated in 40Gbps 16QAM systems.

articleTitle: Recent progress on multi-core fiber and few-mode fiber
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: This paper reviews research activities concerning multi-core fiber, few-mode fiber and few-mode multi-core fiber. The characteristic of the 12-core fiber that was used for the first 1-Pb/s/fiber transmission experiments is presented.

articleTitle: Energy awareness in the design of optical core networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We evaluate the power savings achievable in the design of optical core networks considering design alternatives to solve LTD and RWA problems. Results show that an appropriate design can increase energy efficiency in WDM networks.

articleTitle: On-demand spectrum and space defragmentation in an elastic SDM/FDM/TDM network with mixed multi- and single-core fiber links
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We show on-demand multi-wavelength spectrum and space defragmentation in an SDM and elastic network with four programmable nodes and two multi-core fiber links. The combined approach is shown to reduce blocking and hardware requirements in small nodes.

articleTitle: Transmission improvement through dual-carrier FEC gain sharing
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A coherent MODEM is implemented with FEC payload and checksum distributed between two PM-QPSK optical channels spaced at 200 GHz. Real-time experiments verify PDL and PMD penalties are 40–50% higher without FEC gain sharing.

articleTitle: Multicore EDFA for DWDM transmission in full C-band
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We optimize 7-multicore erbium-doped fiber amplifier for DWDM systems. Each core of MC-EDF is pumped by LD individually with bundled fan-in. The MC-EDFA has gain of 15 dB and NF of 6 dB within C-band.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of pilot-aided polarization recovery, frequency offset and phase noise mitigation
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate polarization demultiplexing, frequency offset and phase noise compensation using an electrically inserted pilot for 28 Gbaud PDM-QPSK. We report excellent back-to-back and transmission performances, frequency offset and phase noise tolerances.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of an optimized 16-ary four-dimensional modulation format using optical OFDM
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the best known 16-ary 4-d modulation format at 24.8 Gb/s using coherent optical OFDM, achieving 0.58 dB OSNR gain over PDM-QPSK at a SER of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup>. With 7% overhead optimal codes, a 0.38 dB gain is theoretically achievable.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of 128-SP-QAM in uncompensated long-haul transmission
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate 128-SP-QAM experimentally for the first time and compare the performance to PM-16QAM at the same symbol rate (10.5 Gbaud).We find a 1.7 dB increased sensitivity and 50% increased transmission reach over PM-16QAM.

articleTitle: Wideband wavelength conversion of 16 Gbaud 16-QAM signals in a semiconductor optical amplifier
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate wavelength conversion of 16-QAM signals over the entire C-band with low power penalty (<;1.5 dB) at the FEC threshold using a dual pump configuration. We also investigate the power penalty dependence on input OSNR.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of multi-level modulation on OFDM signals using integrated silicon modulators
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Multi-level modulation on orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) signals is experimentally demonstrated by an integrated silicon Mach-Zehnder modulator. The measured bit error rate is well below the forward error correction (FEC) threshold.

articleTitle: Optical vortex based Mode Division Multiplexing over graded-index multimode fibre
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Mode Division Multiplexing is performed over 2km and 8km of 50μm graded-index multimode fibre using (de)multiplex phase masks based around optical vortex modes to transmit 2×56Gbps QPSK signals without MIMO equalization.

articleTitle: Energy Efficient 10G-EPON system
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: In PON system, power saving techniques for customer premise equipment has been studied. This paper gives considerations on power consumption reduction and data transfer latency, then presents evaluation results with 10G-EPON prototype system.

articleTitle: Data bandwidth reduction based on wireless resource allocation for digitized radio over TDM-PON system
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose a novel data bandwidth reduction method based on wireless resource allocation for digitized radio over TDM-PON system, and the required PON bandwidth is reduced by 25 % when there are 80 mobile terminals.

articleTitle: Progress in photonic analog-to-digital conversion
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Recent progress in using photonics for highly-accurate analog-to-digital conversion of wideband RF signals is reviewed, its capabilities and limitations are discussed. A down-converting electronic-photonic ADC digitizing a 41 GHz tone with 16 fs equivalent jitter is presented.

articleTitle: Failure coverage in optimal virtual networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We provide optimal virtual network design models with protection against various physical and virtual failures. Our models enable protection against single link, node and sub-network failures with almost the same cost using an intelligent design.

articleTitle: Wired-wireless services provision in FSAN NG-PON2 compliant long-reach PONs: Performance analysis
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Performance of OFDM-based quintuple-play service provisioning in long-reach PONs using direct and external modulation is evaluated experimentally. Adequate system design is shown as effective solution to reach 125 km with both modulation schemes.

articleTitle: Stand-alone high-power broadly tunable optoelectronic frequency comb generator
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We present a high power, broadly tunable, optoelectronic frequency comb generator. The device produces between 60-75 lines within 10dB bandwidth over its tuning range, from 6-18 GHz, and can handle 1W of optical input power.

articleTitle: Amplifier technologies for unrepeatered links, submarine transmissions
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We present the amplifier technologies, based on high-order Raman amplification, that are currently used in unrepeatered systems. We describe their principle of operation and discuss the physical effects which limit their application.

articleTitle: Vertical junction silicon microdisk modulators at 25Gb/s
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate the first vertical junction microdisk modulator to achieve an open eye diagram at 25Gb/s. The result was achieved using a circularly contacted microdisk with a 3μm radius and a 1.2V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">pp</sub> drive for ~13fJ/bit.

articleTitle: Highly efficient data aggregation on single optical carrier through fiber frequency conversion of discrete multi-tone signal
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose an efficient data aggregation through optical frequency conversion of discrete multi-tone (DMT) signals. We demonstrate distributed multiplexing of four DMT signals with BPSK to 128QAM, and achieve total 29.2-Gb/s data-multiplexing within 6-GHz bandwidth.

articleTitle: Cognitive dynamic optical networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Cognitive networks are a promising solution for the control of heterogeneous optical networks. We review their fundamentals as well as a number of applications developed in the framework of the EU FP7 CHRON project.

articleTitle: Four-wavelength silicon hybrid laser array with ring-resonator based mirror for efficient CWDM transmitter
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A four-wavelength Si/III-V hybrid laser array was developed for energy-efficient silicon photonics CWDM transmitter. Under 4-ch simultaneous operation, stable lasing oscillations at four neighboring ring-resonator peaks are obtained with high output powers of >+5dBm/ch.

articleTitle: Detailed experimental phase noise characterization of Y-branch lasers for use in coherent communication systems
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time a detailed phase noise characterization of Y-branch lasers. BER tests of 10.7GBaud DQPSK revealed the effect of phase noise at frequencies around the relaxation oscillation peak on system performance.

articleTitle: A shared carrier reception and processing scheme for compensating frequency offset and phase noise of space-division multiplexed signals over multicore fibers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose a noise resistant method to compensate frequency offset and phase noise based on shared carrier reception for SDM signals. We demonstrate improvement in the transmission of 112Gb/s PM-16QAM over 294km MCF.

articleTitle: IP-optical interaction during traffic restoration
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We analyze the required interaction between the optical and IP layers to enable restoration of IP links in the optical layer. Significant interaction is needed to achieve a cost effective process that minimizes traffic impact.

articleTitle: Interoperability of single-mode and multimode data links for data center and optical backplane applications
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We show that a multimode fiber can support both single-mode “Si-Photonics” and multimode VCSEL technologies. This allows designers of data centers and optical backplanes to install one fiber infrastructure that is compatible with both technologies.

articleTitle: Efficient multiplier-free FPGA demonstration of polar-domain multi-symbol-delay-detector (MSDD) for high performance phase recovery of 16-QAM
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We eliminate all multipliers from the MSDD carrier recovery (CR) sub-system without performance penalty. The extreme-low-complexity CR is demonstrated in real-time in FPGA HW.

articleTitle: Contention resolution within colorless and directionless ROADM
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A conventional colorless and directionless ROADM architecture is modified to achieve contention-free performance without relying on external transponders and OTN switches, and can achieve a smaller size and lower power consumption than those of a conventional CDC ROADM.

articleTitle: Robust low loss splicing of hollow core photonic bandgap fiber to itself
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Robust, low loss (0.16dB) splicing of hollow core photonic band gap fiber to itself is presented. Modal content is negligibly affected by splicing, enabling penalty-free 40Gbit/s data transmission over > 200m of spliced PBGF.

articleTitle: Narrow optical filtering tolerance of 127-Gb/s DP-QPSK utilizing real-time DSP with 20 cascaded 50-GHz filters in the presence of 40,200-ps/nm chromatic dispersion
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Tolerance of 127-Gb/s DP-QPSK signal with real-time DSP is experimentally investigated. The results show high tolerance to narrow optical filtering with large CD and center frequency offsets making this system very attractive for Metro links.

articleTitle: Assessing the performance of multi-layer path computation algorithms for different PCE architectures
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We have implemented a multi-layer PCE and compared performance of various algorithms using either one integrated, or two separate PCEs in each layer. Multi-layer integration reduces blocking by 13,91%, but increases computation time by 49,24%.

articleTitle: Near term terabit transmission field trial opportunities
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: High speed transmission field trials are reviewed. Near term terabit field trials involve higher spectral-efficiency, broader optical-bandwidth, and more flexible networks. New capacity units are introduced for better field trial result comparisons.

articleTitle: How national IP/MPLS networks can benefit from flexgrid optical technology?
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We design a 1113-node network and show that the optimum is a large Flexgrid core serving small metro areas. Cost savings of about 31% in the core and 23% in the metro are shown.

articleTitle: An adaptive decision-feedback channel estimation for coherent optical OFDM
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Adaptive channel estimation methods are proposed for reduced guard-interval (RGI) CO-OFDM. Channel estimation is updated adaptively after decoding a sequence of OFDM symbols using LS or MMSE decision-feedback from demodulator to channel estimator.

articleTitle: IM/DD vs. 4-PAM using a 1550-nm VCSEL over short-range SMF/MMF links for optical interconnects
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We experimentally compare the performance of 10.9-Gb/s IM/DD and 5-GBd 4-PAM modulation formats over 5-km SMF and 1-km MMF links, employing a commercially-available 1550-nm VCSEL as an enabling technology for use in optical interconnects.

articleTitle: Devices and components for space-division multiplexing in few-mode fibers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We show several components for space-division multiplexing in few-mode fibers including integrated spatial multiplexers, lossless adiabatic single-mode to multi-mode converters, all-optical multi-input multiple-output processing and a wavelength blocker with spatial-diversity.

articleTitle: Energy consumption analysis of converged networks: Node consolidation vs metro simplification
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We present a comparison of network energy consumption for converged networks in the case of node-consolidation and metro-simplification. Results indicate an advantage for metro simplification by DWDM-centric transport.

articleTitle: Coherent Subcarrier-WDM-PON system with SSB modulation and wavelength reuse
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose a Subcarrier-WDM-PON system suitable for up to 320 users, using SSB modulation and wavelength reuse for colorless ONUs. The experimental results have shown the feasibility of such a concept.

articleTitle: Ultra-compact and low-loss silica-based dual polarization optical hybrid for digital coherent receiver with excellent common-mode rejection ratio
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: An ultra-compact 3 × 12 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> DPOH on a 1.5%-Δ silica-based PLC employing a novel coupler is reported. The excess loss is <;2 dB and the CMRR is <;-27 dBe over the C- and L-bands.

articleTitle: Optical RAM row access and column decoding for WDM-formatted optical words
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We present a multi-wavelength SOA-MZI-based access gate and an AWG-based column decoder that control random access of 4×10Gb/s WDM-formatted words into a 4-bit optical RAM row. Error-free decoding with 0.4dB peak power penalty is presented.

articleTitle: Narrow guard-band distributed Nyquist-WDM using fiber frequency conversion
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We present distributed Nyquist wavelength-division multiplexing experiments with four 25-GBd quadrature phase-shift keying modulation channels having 4% guard-band. Optical fiber-frequency conversion ensures accurate remote optical frequency alignment of the channels.

articleTitle: Valuing flexibility in the migration to flexgrid networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Flexible optical networking can now be installed to increase network capacity in light of future traffic demands. This paper researches the different migration paths using a real option analysis, showing the impact of uncertainty.

articleTitle: 1-Tbit/s dual-carrier DP 64QAM transmission at 64Gbaud with 40% overhead soft-FEC over 320km SSMF
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate 1-Tbit/s dual-carrier dual-polarization 64QAM transmission at 64Gbaud over 320km of standard single-mode fiber with EDFAs only. Error free performance is validated by sFEC decoding of the received data after fiber transmission.

articleTitle: Collaborative signal processing with FEC in digital coherent systems
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We discuss the concept of combination of nonlinearity equalizer and soft-decision FEC decoder. The appropriate choice of equalization performance and error correcting capability of FEC is essential for performance optimization with existing nonlinear phase noise.

articleTitle: Nonlinear interaction between signal and amplified spontaneous emission in coherent systems
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We experimentally and numerically investigate the impact of nonlinear interaction between signal and ASE in coherent transmission systems. We show that dispersion management of the transmission path significantly increases penalties caused by signal-ASE interaction.

articleTitle: OXC hardware scale reduction attained by using interconnected subsystem architecture
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We significantly reduce OXC hardware scale by utilizing our interconnected subsystem architecture. It basically matches the routing capability of the conventional architecture but with more than 75% fewer WSSs.

articleTitle: 200-subchannel ultra-high-density frequency division multiplexed coherent otdr with nonlinear effect suppression
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate 200-channel high-density frequency division multiplexing coherent OTDR employing apodization and nonlinear suppression schemes. The sensitivity enhancement is 13 dB by comparison with conventional coherent OTDR.

articleTitle: Compact integrated tunable filter utilizing AWG routing function and small switches
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: The wavelength tunable filter will play a key role in realizing C/D/C add/drop functions in ROADMs. We fabricate a novel tunable filter for 192 optical channels on a PLC chip. Transmission experiments verify its optical characteristics.

articleTitle: Defining optical software-defined networks (SDN): From a compilation of demos to network model synthesis
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose the first optical SDN model enabling performance optimization and comparison of heterogeneous SDN scenarios. We exploit it to minimize latency and compare cost for non-SDN, partial-SDN and full-SDN variants of the same network.

articleTitle: Network Services Interface: An interface for requesting dynamic inter-datacenter networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: The Network Services Interface Working Group in the Open Grid Forum [1] has been working to define an open interface standard to enable interoperability between dynamic circuit services, which can be used for inter-datacenter networking.

articleTitle: How to design an energy efficient fiber-wireless network
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We analyze the energy consumption of current in-building networks and show that new network designs employing fiber-wireless technologies could lead to significant energy savings in future high-speed networks.

articleTitle: Trading off transponders for spectrum in flexgrid networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose algorithms for planning flexgrid networks under physical layer impairments. Using an optimization function that accounts for both the spectrum used and the transponders cost, we observe tradeoffs between these two optimization parameters.

articleTitle: Fixed-length elastic-capacity OFDM payload packet: Concept and demonstration
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A novel fixed-length elastic-capacity optical OFDM payload packet which can significantly ease the buffer scheduling is proposed. 1 × 2 switching and fiber delay line buffering of 19-30Gbps coherent OFDM payload packets is experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a dynamic transparent WSON employing flexible transmitter/receiver controlled by an OpenFlow/stateless PCE integrated control plane
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: By using an OpenFlow/stateless PCE integrated control plane with significant protocol extensions, we successfully demonstrate and quantitatively evaluate dynamic end-to-end path provisioning and lightpath restoration in a transparent WSON employing flexible transmitters/receivers.

articleTitle: Fast and distributed high resolution Brillouin based fiber optic sensor
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We present a fast and distributed high-resolution Brillouin sensor. A sensing speed of hundreds Hz with 5cm spatial resolution is experimentally demonstrated. A comparison between Bragg and Brillouin based sensing methods is also presented.

articleTitle: QAM synthesis by direct modulation of semiconductor lasers under injection locking
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A new scheme for direct synthesis of QAM (4,16,64,..) from binary RF data streams is suggested and tested by generating 10 Gbaud QPSK. Current semiconductor lasers should allow for operation up to 160 Gbaud.

articleTitle: Transmission beyond 2 Gbit/s in a 100 m SI POF with multilevel CAP modulation and digital equalization
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: High-capacity transmission in a 100 m SI POF is reported. This was enabled by multilevel CAP modulation and digital equalization techniques. The influence of multilevel coding and equalization penalties are discussed.

articleTitle: 25-Gb/s transmission over 250-m MMF using over-drive of 10-Gb/s VCSEL by utilizing asymmetric pre-emphasis
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We developed a 25-Gb/s transmitter with an over-drive of 10-Gb/s VCSEL using our asymmetric pre-emphasis design. Owing to the narrow spectral width characteristics of our transmitter, we demonstrate 25-Gb/s transmission over 250-m of multimode fiber.

articleTitle: Monolithically integrated 8-channel WDM reflective modulator
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: In this work the design and characterization of a monolithically integrated photonic circuit acting as a reflective modulator for eight WDM channels is presented. The chip was designed and fabricated in a generic integration technology.

articleTitle: Non-directed line-of-sight visible light system providing high-speed and robustness to ambient light
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate the first optical wireless link operating in non-direct line-of-sight configuration over typical room distances, with data-rate up to 200 Mbit/s at acceptable bit-error-ratios, under the ambient light noise of usual indoor illumination.

articleTitle: Evaluating efficiency of multi-layer switching in future optical transport networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: This paper evaluates multi-layer switching architecture vs. all-optical and all-digital switching architectures. Further, the value of incorporating super-channels is evaluated to determine benefit. A real world network model is utilized to quantify and compare results.

articleTitle: An optical multi-ring burst network for a data center
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose an efficient scheme to all-optically inter-networking the pods of a data center. With the proposed multi-ring burst network, many transceivers, fibers and core switches are eliminated and ultrahigh-capacity switching is achieved.

articleTitle: Dynamic adaptive virtual optical networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Adaptive virtual optical networks are proposed to support the Future Internet. Planning these to address the dynamic and unpredictable services and their characteristics considering requirements such as service resilience and security can have significant impact.

articleTitle: Virtual network reconfiguration in optical substrate networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: This paper studies virtual network service provisioning over substrate optical networks and presents a novel reconfiguration scheme to improve efficiency. Simulation results show lower blocking and increased revenues as compared to existing strategies.

articleTitle: Wavelength blocker for few-mode-fiber space-division multiplexed systems
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We show how to build and characterize optical devices with spatial-diversity such that all spatial modes experience the same transmission. We build a wavelength blocker interfacing to a few-mode-fiber that supports six spatial and polarization modes.

articleTitle: Submarine transmissions with spectral efficiency higher than 3 b/s/Hz using Nyquist pulse-shaped channels
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We study experimentally PDM-QPSK, PDM-8QAM and PDM-16QAM signals with Nyquist pulse-shaping at 28 Gbaud for undersea transmissions. We compare their noise sensitivity, nonlinear tolerance, transmission reach and assess their performance depending on channel spacing.

articleTitle: ROADM options in optical networks: Flexible grid or not?
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Flexible-grid networks are attractive because they claim greater spectral efficiency and the ability to accommodate future modulation formats that may need wider channel bandwidths. We compare flexible-grid networks to alternative approaches.

articleTitle: A tunable optical tapped-delay-line that simultaneously and independently processes multiple input WDM data signals
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate an optical tapped-delay-line that is reconfigurable with complex tapcoefficients and independently and simultaneously performs data pattern recognition, equalization, and QAM format conversion on eight B/QPSK WDM signals at both 20 and 26 Gbaud, demonstrating >400 Gbit/s processing speed.

articleTitle: WDM-FDM approach for a multiservice home network
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose a passive star based on a NxN optical splitter to deliver simultaneously Ethernet, terrestrial television and 60GHz wireless connectivity (RoF). WDM multiplexing with FDM demultiplexing is adopted and validated by real-time signals transmissions.

articleTitle: 30.58 Tb/s transmission over 7,230 km using PDM half 4D-16QAM coded modulation with 6.1 b/s/Hz spectral efficiency
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We transmit 30.58 Tb/s data (294×104 Gb/s) over 7,230 km in 40 nm bandwidth with 6.1 b/s/Hz spectral efficiency. We use PDM half-4D-16QAM coded modulation to achieve the highest reported capacity-distance product of 221 Pb/s·km.

articleTitle: Long-haul transmission of PM-2PPM-QPSK at 42.8 Gbit/s
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We present the first experimental realization of polarization-multiplexed 2 pulse-position modulation QPSK. Close to 40% increase in transmission reach is achieved compared to conventional polarization-multiplexed QPSK at a data rate of 42.8 Gbit/s.

articleTitle: Requirements for adaptive electronic dispersion compensation in burst-mode systems
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate that electronic dispersion compensation in 10Gb/s burst-mode links must be adapted burst-to-burst, even for bursts with the same impairment. Tap adaptation is possible with less than 500 training bits, allowing short preambles.

articleTitle: Combined self-seeding and carrier remodulation method for reflective transmitters in WDM-PON
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose a RSOA-based WDM-PON architecture, combining self-seeding and carrier remodulation. A maximum 2.5 dB power penalty for a BER@10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-10</sup> was achieved for an injection power of - 22 dBm on 1.25 Gbps transmission.

articleTitle: Microwave photonics: The past and the future
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Analog Photonics is here to stay. More and more RF applications are finding good uses for the technology to solve their particular problems. Generally RF systems utilizing long delays or multi-octave RF bandwidths are good insertion candidates. Integration and “Ruggedization” are needed to allow for more widespread use.

articleTitle: Hardware-efficient chromatic dispersion estimator based on parallel gardner timing error detector
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose a hardware-efficient, low-complexity and non-data-aided CD estimator with accuracy similar or better than other prominent CD estimation algorithms; all evaluated in simulated and experimental PM-4-QAM and PM-16-QAM transmission scenarios.

articleTitle: Nonlinear performance of SDM systems designed with multimode or multicore fibers
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We discuss the nonlinear performance of space-division multiplexed systems under realistic conditions using a comprehensive numerical model. Newly derived Manakov equations allow us to include birefringence effects for both multimode and multicore fibers.

articleTitle: Characterization of polarization insensitive FOPA using a polarization-maintaining highly non-linear fiber
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A polarization insensitive FOPA based on a PM-HNLF loop diversity scheme is demonstrated. Achieved ON-OFF gain was 19.2 dB whilst the polarization dependence was 0.7 dB across a signal wavelength range of 1544-1560 nm.

articleTitle: Recent progress in space-division multiplexed transmission technologies
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Recent development of transmission technologies based on space-division multiplexing is described with future perspectives including a recent achievement of one Pb/s transmission in a single strand of fiber.

articleTitle: Toward deeply virtualized elastic optical networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We discuss the virtualization in optical networks from the elastic networking level to sliceable equipment level. We propose a novel transport system architecture based on equipment level virtualization that achieves fine granular sub-port level grooming in the optical domain.

articleTitle: Full system simulation of optically interconnected chip multiprocessors using gem5
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: By extending the cycle accurate gem5 computer system simulator with optical network models, we demonstrate chip multiprocessor performance improvements of up to 18% using a wavelength striped optical crossbar interconnect and determine optimum optical parameters.

articleTitle: Compact fiber grating coupler on SOI for coupling of higher order fiber modes
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A single standard sized fiber grating coupler capable of exciting several LP fiber modes simultaneously in both TE and TM polarizations is presented. Simulations show a high overlap between the emitted field and fiber modes.

articleTitle: Intersymbol interference penalties for OOK and 4-PAM in short-range optical communications
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Intersymbol interference penalties of OOK and 4-PAM were compared in the context of short-range optical links with directly modulated VCSELs. The maximum achieved bit rate with 4-PAM was 38 Gbps and 32 Gbps with OOK.

articleTitle: Optical inverse fourier transform generated 11.2-Tbit/s no-guard-interval all-optical OFDM transmission
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a flexible method of generating wide bandwidth OFDM superchannels using a software-programmable wavelength selective switch to combine modulated pulses. We transmit 279 × 40 Gbit/s over 400 km as a proof of concept.

articleTitle: Extending network virtualization into the optical domain
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: After server and storage virtualization, network virtualization adds the missing piece to the cloud computing puzzle. This paper discusses prospects, challenges and solutions for extending network virtualization into the optical domain.

articleTitle: Noise performance of a multi-sideband parametric multicasting mixer with normal dispersion
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We, for the first time, demonstrate localization of noise coupling between sidebands in a multi-stage parametric multicasting mixer. A noise performance improvement of up to 2 dB, compared to the single-stage case, was observed experimentally.

articleTitle: Heterogeneous integration of InP PDs on silica-based PLCs
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: The heterogeneous integration of InP PDs fabricated on silica-based PLCs is demonstrated. By using a 2.5%-Δ PLC, we realized a compact high performance DP-QPSK receiver with eight heterogeneously integrated high-speed PDs.

articleTitle: Completely cyclic flat-top optical multi/demultiplexer for multi-carrier transceiver
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We devised a completely cyclic flat-top multi/demultiplexer with a novel MZI-based structure for a multi-carrier transceiver. The insertion loss and 0.5-dB bandwidth of the 50-GHz-spaced four-port multi/demultiplexer with silica-based waveguides were 3.2 dB and 38 GHz, respectively.

articleTitle: Experimental validation of digital filter back-propagation to suppress SOA-induced nonlinearities in 16-QAM
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the performance of a computationally efficient digital filter back-propagation scheme for post-compensating SOA nonlinearities in coherent detection of 16-QAM signal at 16 Gbaud, and compare the results with simulations.

articleTitle: Next Generation ROADM architecture and design
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Next Generation ROADM design that supports Colorless Directionless and Contentionless (CDC) architecture and supports Flexible grid is described. Benefits of CDC Flexible grid ROADM architecture are discussed. Tradeoffs between different aspects of design are presented.

articleTitle: Coherent optical and radio seamless transmission based on DSP-aided radio-over-fiber technology
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a coherent optical and radio seamless transmission system for enhancing network resilience. By using radio-over-fiber technology with digital-signal-processing-aided coherent detection, high capacity optical/radio transmission can be achieved.

articleTitle: A novel method to mitigate LED nonlinearity distortions in optical wireless OFDM systems
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: Compensating signal clipping distortions due to light-emitting diode (LED) operational constrains in optical wireless communication (OWC) systems based on orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) modulation is achieved through the use of iterative signal clipping (ISC) and multiple LED transmitters.

articleTitle: Compact and power-efficient 100-Gbps CMOS-based transceiver
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: A compact 4 25-Gbps optical transceiver for short-reach communications using optical interconnects was developed. Its total power consumption is 2.2 W. A transmission experiment with the transceiver was successfully conducted at 25-Gbps data rate.

articleTitle: Evolution of the architecture and technology of data centers towards exascale and beyond
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: The continual growth of data centers cannot be maintained through incremental advances in today's technologies and architectures. An alternative architecture based on reconfigurable WDM optical networking technology is presented for realizing future, exascale, elastic data centers.

articleTitle: WSS requirements in next-generation Wavelength Switched Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We investigate how the WSS port-count requirement scales with traffic, transmission technologies, fiber types and amplification schemes in future WSONs. The highest benefits come with the Hybrid-EDFA implementation.

articleTitle: FOPA with flat 21-dB gain and NF less than 4-dB using alternately concatenated pump-phase shifters and HNLFs
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate a single-pumped fiber optical parametric amplifier using alternately concatenated highly nonlinear fibers and pump-phase shifters for quasi-phase matching. Gain bandwidth with 1-dB flatness is 25 nm. Noise figure is less than 4 dB.

articleTitle: Tracking excess noise from a monolithic tunable laser in coherent communication systems
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We demonstrate the tracking of white-FM noise and 1/f<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">α</sup> excess noise from a SGDBR laser in a coherent system. The performance of 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup>-order phase-locked loop was experimentally examined in 16-QAM system at 16 Gbaud.

articleTitle: Experimental validation of dynamic restoration in GMPLS-controlled multi-layer networks using PCE-based global concurrent optimization
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: An experimental validation of a PCE-based GCO architecture for dynamic restoration in GMPLS multi-layer networks is presented. This solution better addresses the concurrence of multiple connection requests favoring grooming objectives and attaining higher restorability.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation of coded optical subcarrier index modulation OFDM format
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We compare the performance of coded subcarrier index modulation for coherent optical OFDM transmission. An improvement over standard QPSK is confirmed at the lower SE, though for equal SE cases coded performance gets worse.

articleTitle: A traffic intensity model for flexgrid optical network planning under dynamic traffic operation
publicationTitle: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
abstract: We obtain a model to estimate the highest traffic intensity that a flexgrid-based network can support in dynamic scenarios. A design problem is introduced to illustrate its application. Numerical results validate both accuracy and utility.
